tshog /'chi med bsgrub pa zhes bya ba/⑫sha /'chi med grub pa bya ba yod/ ma /rgya gar skad du/ sa sbo nyi sing ti na ma/ bod skad du/ 'chi med bsgrub pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lte ba mdzes pa'i thig le gnas/ /de nyid dri ma med pa ②las/ /kun la khyab pa nyi ma'i 'od/ /'khor ba rnams la de nyid ces/ /khams gsum gnas pa'i sems can la/ /chos dang chos 'od khyad 'phags shing / /de'i nang nas lam gsum bstan/ /lam gsum gcig tu 'dzin mdzad pa/ /dbu med zhabs dang bral ba'o/ /khyad 'phags gnas dang bstod pa'i yul/ /ye shes gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'joms mdzad pa/ /rnal 'byor ma'i phyag rgya yin/ /phyag 'tshal dpal ldan rnyir ba la/ /phyag 'tshal bla ma'i rgyud 'dzin pas / /'gal rkyen thams cad zhi gyur cig /nges par chos 'dis dngos grub thob/ /rmongs 48—126

༄ga /'chi med bsgrub pa zhes bya ba/①༄/ /'chi med grub pa bya ba yod/ ༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ a thra ti sing ti na ma/ bod skad du/ 'chi med bsgrub pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lte ba mdzes pa'i thig le gnas/ /de nyid dri ma med pa ⑦las/ /kun la khyab pa nyi ma'i 'od/ /'khor ba rnams la de nyid ces/ /khams gsum gnas pa'i sems can la/ /chos dang chos 'od khyad 'phags shing / /de'i nang nas lam gsum bstan/ /lam gsum gcig tu 'dzin mdzad pa/ /dbu med zhabs dang bral ba'o/ /khyad 'phags gnas dang bstod pa'i yul/ /ye shes gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'joms mdzad pa/ /rnal 'byor ma'i phyag rgya yin/ /phyag 'tshal dpal ldan bhir ba la/ /phyag 'tshal bla ma'i rgyud 'dzin pas①/ /'gal rkyen thams cad zhi gyur cig /nges par chos 'dis dngos grub thob/ /zongs 48—126

pas dug zos gnyid log la/ /ye shes chu rgyun bzhin du blud/ /'tsho byed sman pa'i mchog gyur pa/ /dpal ldan zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /go rtogs can gyi man ngag 'di/ /skyes bu la ni bstan byas na/ /'chi med bsgrub pa'i de nyid las/ /rin chen mtshan nyid rtogs gyur nas/ /zhi ba las ni spros med zhing / /zung 'das med cing yang dag gnas/ /zhi ba las ni yang dag ldan1 /ye shes sna tshogs rab gsal ba/ /yon tan du ma rab ldan zhing / /gzhan don sna tshogs 'byung 'gyur ro/ /ye shes las ni sdig pa che/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /zongs pa las ni sdug bsngal che/ /skyon yon grol zhing bdag gis bshad/ /ye shes yid kyi khyad par las/ /bden pa'i don ni rab bstan zhing / /nges pa las ni don rnams 'byung / /gong ma rnams kyis nges par bshad/ /ro rnams dag pa nyer len dang / /rin chen dag pa rin chen dang / /don rnams dag pa don dang ldan/ /don rtags rtog pa khyad 'phags so/ /bla ma'i bka' drin khyad par gyis/ /rgyud sde rnams ni rab bstan pa/ /sgyu ma lha bu'i ye shes las/ /'gro ba la sokas de las 'byung / /baspub pa las ni rab brtson pa/ /brtson pa las ni yang dag ldan/ /rigs ngan rnams dang 'dris par bya/ /rtsa ba'i spros pa mtha' dag chod/ /gang zhig thabs la 'jug pa ni/ /zab mo'i lam ni thabs kyi mchog /rdo rje'i don la 'jug pa'i phyir/ /lam gyi de nyid 'bras bu'o/ /las dang smon lam khyad par gyis/ /'jug pa la ni yang dag ldan/ /phun sum tshogs pa 'di nyid las/ /nges par don rnams de las 'byung / /rnal 'byor tshogs gnyis sogs pa ni/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo byas pa yis//48—127

pas dug zos gnyid log la/ /ye shes chu rgyun bzhin du blud/ /'tsho byed sman pa'i mchog gyur pa/ /dpal ldan zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /go rtogs can gyi man ngag 'di/ /skyes bu la ni bstan byas na/ /'chi med bsgrub pa'i de nyid las/ /rin chen mtshan nyid rtogs gyur nas/ /zhi ba las ni spros med zhing / /rgyang 'das med cing yang dag gnas/ /zhi ba las ni yang dag ldan/ /ye shes sna tshogs rab gsal ba/ /yon tan du ma rab ldan zhing / /gzhan don sna tshogs 'byung 'gyur ro/ /ye shes las ni snyig pa che/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /rmongs pa las ni sdug bsngal che/ /skyon yon grol zhing bdag gis bshad/ /ye shes yid kyi khyad par las/ /bden pa'i don ni rab bstan zhing / /nges pa las ni don rnams 'byung / /gong ma rnams kyis nges par bshad/ /ro rnams dag pa nyer len dang / /rin chen dag pa rin chen dang / /don rnams dag pa don dang ldan/ /don rtags rtog pa khyad 'phags so/ /bla ma'i bka' drin khyad par gyis/ /rgyud sde rnams ni rab bstan pa/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ye shes las/ /'gro ba la sogs de las 'byung / /bsgrub pa las ni rab brtson pa/ /brtson pa las ni yang dag ldan/ /rigs ngan rnams dang 'dris par bya/ /rtsa ba'i spros pa mtha' dag chod/ /gang zhig thabs la 'jug pa ni/ /zab mo'i lam ri thabs kyi mchog /rdo rje'i don la 'jug pa'i phyir/ /lam gyi de nyid 'bras bu'o/ /las dang smon lam khyad par gyis/ /'jug pa la ni yang dag ldan/ /phun sum tshogs pa 'di nyid las/ /nges par don rnams de las 'byung / /rnal 'byor tshogs gnyis sogs pa ni/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo byas pa yis//48—127

tshogs kyi mchog dang ldan par 'gyur/ /skyes bu sdig sgrib sbyong ba yis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /khams gsum gnas pa'i sems can gyi/ /sdig sgrib thams cad dag 'gyur ro/ /skye ba bye ba stong dag tu/ /tshogs bzang du ma bsags gyur pas/ /las bzang khyad par rab ldan zhing / /rnal 'byor pa ni pha rol 'gro/ /yang dag phyag rgya chen po ni/ /thams cad don gyi khyad 'phags so/ /de dang ldan pa'i sems can gyis/ /bskor ba'i tshul gyis de nyid chod/ /thabs kyi don dang ldan pa yis/ /gang zag dbang po rnam gsum la/ /tshad ldan mchog gi zhal dag las/ /nges par 'bras bu 'byung 'gyur ro/ /sku gnyis rab tu bstan pa ni/ /nges par lam gyi rjes 'jug pas//gzugs sku rdo rje'i mtshan nyid de/ /de nyid rang bzhin med pa ni/ /chos sku rdo rje'i mtshan nyid do/ /dben pa'i khyad par ⑫bstan pa/ /lus dang rtsa dang thig le dang / /rlung dang sems dang zla ba dang / /nyi ma bye brag dben pa'o/ /bla ma mchog gi zhal dag las/ /rtsa mdud ②rnams ni rab grol bas/ /sa lam la sogs de las 'byung / /de nyid yang dag 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di baspub skyes bu gang yin pa/ /dben pa bsten zhing bsgrub brtson pas/ /bgegs rnams sgrod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /tshe 'di nyid la rnal 'byor 'gro/ /srung ②bya rnams ni rab bstan pa/ /lus ngag yid gsum nges ldan spang / /mi mthun rdzas rnams spang bya zhing / /de rnams spangs pas gnad rnams 'byung / /lus kun rdzas kyis byug par bya/ /gnas gsum gtso ru bstan pa dang / /kun la mnye zhing thim byas pas/ /de ni mnyen pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /rgyu dang rkyen dang rnam shes gsum/ /de'i dbang gis khams lngar shar/ /rgyu ba'i dus dang 48—128

tshogs kyi mchog dang ldan par 'gyur/ /skyes bu sdig sgrib sbyong ba yis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /khams gsum gnas pa'i sems can kyi/ /sdig sgrib thams cad dag 'gyur ro/ /skye ba bye ba stong dag tu/ /tshogs bzang du ma bsags gyur pas/ /las bzang khyad par rab ldan zhing / /rnal 'byor pa ni pha rol 'gro/ /yang dag phyag rgya chen po ni/ /thams cad don gyi khyad 'phags so/ /de dang ldan pa'i sems can gyis/ /bskor ba'i tshul gyis de nyid chod/ /thabs kyi don dang ldan pa yis/ /gang zag dbang po rnam gsum la/ /tshad ldan mchog gi zhal dag las/ /nges par 'bras bu 'byung 'gyur ro/ /sgu gnyis rab tu bstan pa ni/ /nges par lam byi rjes 'jug pas//gzugs sku rdo rje'i mtshan nyid de/ /de nyid rang bzhin med pa ni/ /chos sku rdo rje'i mtshan nyid do/ /dbe+en pa'i khyad par kyebastan pa/ /lus dang rtsa dang thig le dang / /rlung dang sems dang zla ba dang / /nyi ma bye brag dben pa'o/ /bla ma mchog gi zhal dag las/ /rtsa mdud ⑤rnams ni rab grol bas/ /sa lam la sogs de las 'byung / /de nyid yang dag 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di bsgrub skyes bu gang yin pa/ /dben pa bsten zhing bsgrub brtson pas/ /bgegs rnams sgod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /tshe 'di nyid la rnal 'byor 'gro/ /srung gebya rnams ni rab bstan pa/ /lus ngag yid gsum nges ldan spang / /mi mthun rdzas rnams spang bya zhing / /de rnams spangs pas gnad rnams 'byung / /lus kun rdzos kyis byug par bya/ /gnas gsum gtso ru bstan pa dang / /kun la mnye zhing thim byas pas/ /de ni mnyen pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /rgyu dang rkyen dang rnam shes gsum/ /de'i dbang gis khams lngar shar/ /rgyu ba'i dus dang 48—128

mtshan ma'i rtags/ /nges byed dang ni 'bras bu'o/ /rags pa sdam pa rab bstan pa/ /'byung bzhi rims kyis rnam gsum ste/ /nam mkha' spyi mthun gnas pa dang / /sdom pa yis ni rags pa 'dulasde/ /lus kyi gnad rnams rab bstan pa/ /'phrang nyid bco brgyad phrag gnyis dang / /sdom pa dang ni dngos gzhi dang / /rtsa mdud 2 rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o/ /rlung gi 'jug pa drug las kyang / /rlung gi de nyid bum pa can/ /bum pa can la bslab par bya/ /rlung gi don rnams de las 'byung / /'khor lo'i rnam grangs bstan pa ni/ /bde chen ye shes longs spyod dang / /chos dang sprul pa yid bzhin dang / /sa bon las ni yig 'bru drug /rkang g.yon stobs bskyed 'jo ni la/ /zhabs kyi rtsa bas drag tu bsdam/ /lus sprug 'og rlung then byas nas/ /ro stod drag tu brkyang bar bya/ /rkang g.yas drag tu brkyang byas te/ /zhabs kyi rtse mo bsdam kyebyas pas/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed then byas nas/ /stan la legs par 'dug par bya/ /srog 'dzin drag por then byas te/ /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /lus kyi khyad par dwangs ma rnams/ /sgo dgu dag kyang dgag par bya/ /rlung sgo drag por gcun byas te/ /dmigs pa gsal zhing bstan pa yis—/ /stobs dang stobs nyid bskyed byas nas/ /srog 'dzin nyid la snyam par bya/ /rtsol ba'i gnas ni dran byas/ zhing / /zla ba nyid la brtan byas te/ /de nyid mnyam pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rlung gi rtog pa rab tu zhi/ /yang dag sdom pa chen po ni/ /lus spyi las ni srog gces pa/ /khyad par sdom pa nges pa las/ /nad rnams med cing don rnams 'byung / /'jo ni sdam pa lha mo ste/ /mgrin pa sdom pa lha yin no/ /dgang pa can dang bum pa can/ /de la 'jug cing 48—129

mtshan ma'i rtags/ /nges byed dang ni 'bras bu'o/ /rags pa sdam pa rab bstan pa/ /'byung bzhi rims kyis rnam gsum ste/ /nam mkha' spyi mthun gnas pa dang / /sdom pa yis ni rags pa 'dul⑫/ /lus kyi gnad rnams rab bstan pa/ /'phrang nyid bco brgyad phrag gnyis dang / /sdom pa dang ni dngos gzhi dang / /rtsa mdud ②rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o/ /rlung gi 'jug pa drug las kyang / /rlung gi de nyid bum pa can/ /bum pa can la bslab par bya/ /rlung gi don rnams de las 'byung / /'khor lo'i rnam grangs bstan pa ni/ /bde chen ye shes longs spyod dang / /chos dang sprul pa yid bzhin dang / /sa bon las ni yig 'bru drug /rkang g.yon stobs bskyed 'jo ni la/ /zhabs kyi rtsa bas drag tu bsdam/ /lus sprug 'og rlung then byas nas/ /ro stod drag tu brkyang bar bya/ /rkang g.yas drag tu brkyang byas te/ /zhabs kyi rtse mo bsdam ②byas pas/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed then byas nas/ /stan la legs par 'dug par bya/ /srog 'dzin drag por then byas te/ /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /lus kyi khyad par dwangs ma rnams/ /sgo dgu dag kyang dgag par bya/ /rlung sgo drag por gcun byas te/ /dmigs pa gsal zhing bstan pa yis—/ /stobs dang stobs nyid bskyed byas nas/ /srog 'dzin nyid la snyam par bya/ /rtsol ba'i gnas ni dran byas zhing / /zla ba nyid la brtan byas te/ /de nyid mnyam pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rlung gi rtog pa rab tu zhi/ /yang dag sdom pa chen po ni/ /lus spyi las ni srog gces pa/ /khyad par sdom pa nges pa las/ /nad rnams med cing don rnams 'byung / /'jo ni sdam pa lha mo ste/ /mgrin pa sdom pa lha yin no/ /dgang pa can dang bum pa can/ /de la 'jug cing 48—129

bstan pa yis/ /phyag rgya bzung ba rnam par bca'/ /'jigs dang bar chad med pa dang / /gsang ba'i gnas ni gyen du drang / /sprul pa dag tu bsnyam par bya/ /dus tshod dag bcug byas pas/ /de ni gsang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /nges pa las ni dpag tshad stong / /'di nyid rnal 'byor chos nyid de/ /de ltar lus nyid mthar phyin pas/ /grub pa'i lam nyid 'dir bshad do/ /dngos po gsang zhing bsgrub bya ste/ /rlung gi don rnams mthar phyin pas/ /rlung gi rdo rje mi shigs shing / /mkha' dang de nyid sbyor ba'o/ /skyes bu nges shes khyad 'phags pa/ /'di la 'jug cing mos pa yis/ /bsgrub pa'i mchog dang mi ldan yang / /thos pa tsam byis dngos grub 'byung / /nges par stobs can mthar phyin pas/ /rlung nyid sems dang gnyis med cing / /de nyid rab tu rtogs gyur pas/ /zung 'jug don dang ldan 'gyur ro/ /yum mchog dpal ldan rnal 'byor mas/ /dngos grub rjes su gnang ba yis/ /dpal ldan bir ba'i zhal dag nas/ /'chi med bsgrub pa'i de nyid gsungs/ /'gro ba mtha' dag ma lus pa/ /man ngag 'di dang phrad gyur cig /'di dang phrad pa'i las can kyis/ /'gro ba mtha' dag ma lus pa/ /'dren pa'i stobs dang ldan par shog /slob dpon chen po bir ba pas mdzad pa'i 'chi med grub pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so // //hu/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug a mo gha badz+ras/ bod yul du rang 'gyur du mdzad cing gsungs pa'o// // ④ 48—130

bstan pa yis/ /phyag rgya bzung ba rnam par bca'/ /'jigs dang bar chad med pa dang / /gsang ba'i gnas ni gyen du drang / /sprul pa dag tu bsnyam par bya/ /dus tshod dag bcug byas pas/ /de ni gsang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /nges pa las ni dpag tshad stong / /'di nyid rnal 'byor chos nyid de/ /de ltar lus nyid mthar phyin pas/ /grub pa'i lam nyid 'dir bshad do/ /dngos po gsang zhing bsgrub bya ste/ /rlung gi don rnams mthar phyin pas/ /rlung gi rdo rje mi shigs shing / /mkha' dang de nyid sbyor ba'o/ /skyes bu nges shes khyad 'phags pa/ /'di la 'jug cing mos pa yis/ /bsgrub pa'i mchog dang mi ldan yang / /thos pa tsam gyis dngos grub 'byung / /nges par stobs can mthar phyin pas/ /rlung nyid sems dang gnyis med cing / /de nyid rab tu rtogs gyur pas/ /zung 'jug don dang ldan 'akyur ro/ /yum mchog dpal ldan rnal 'byor mas/ /dngos grub rjes su gnang ba yis/ /dpal ldan jir ba'i zhal dag nas/ /'chi med bsgrub pa'i de nyid gsungs/ /'gro ba mtha' dag ma lus pa/ /man ngag 'di dang phrad gyur cig /'di dang phrad pa'i las can gyis/ /'gro ba mtha' dag ma lus pa/ /'dren pa'i stobs dang ldan par shog /slob dpon chen po jir ba pas mdzad pa'i 'chi med grub pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so // //⑫rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug a mo lha badz+ras/ bod yul du rang 'gyur du mdzad cing gsungs pa'o// //② 48—130

phag /'chi med kyi 'phrang sel bathugs so//①ma / /dpal rdo rje dal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po zhi gnas 'phrang gi ni/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi ⑫rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas khu tshur bcang byas te/ /stobs bskyed gyen la brkyang byas nas/ /lag g.yon thal mos bshad byas shing ⑫/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'//pus mo sa la gzugs bya ste/ /lag gnyis rgyab tu sgom byas nas/ /rbe sha gnyis ni bsdams byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung cung zad mnan byas pas/ /spyi bo sa la gzugs byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /48—132

༄ga /'chi rmed kyi 'phrang sel bzhugs so//①༄4/ /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po zhi gnas 'phrang gi ni/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi khrurjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas khu tshur bcang byas te/ /stobs bskyed gyen la brkyang byas nas/ /lag g.yon thal mos bshad byas shing ①/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i khrul krung bca'//pus mo sa la gzugs bya ste/ /lag gnyis rgyab tu snol byas nas/ /rbe sha gnyis ni bsdams byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung cung zad mnan byas pas/ /spyi bo sa la gzugs byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /48—132

gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag g.yon khu tshur bcang byas te/ /stobs bskyed g.yon du brkyang byas shing / /lag g.yas khu tshur bcang byas pas/ /gzhu 'gengs tshul gyis then byas nas/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa lhag par mthong ba yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /cog gu'i tshul gyis 'dug byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i thal mo yis/ /mchan tshur sogs pa gnyis dag ni/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsdam par bya /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i ①rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil grung bca'—/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams bstan byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /lag gnyis mnyam bzhag phyag rgya bca'/ /steng 'og rlung gnyis sprad byas te/ /'jam rlung tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas nas/ /rkang gnyis mgul pa snol bya ste/ /mthil zur gnyis ni sa la gzugs/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i thal mo yis/ /pus mo gnyis ni bsdam byas te/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya /gsum pa 'dod yon bkag pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /48—133

gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag g.yon khu tshur bcang byas te/ /stobs bskyed g.yon du brkyang byas shing / /laka g.yas khu tshur bcang byas pas/ /gzhu 'gengs tshul gyis then byas nas/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ / gnyis pa lhag par mthong ba yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /cog gu'i tshul gyis 'dug byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i thal mo yis/ /mchad tshur sogs pa gnyis dag ni/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsdam par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i⑥rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bca'| /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams bstan byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /lag gnyis mnyam bzhag phyag rgya bca'/ /steng 'og rlung gnyis sprad byas te/ /'jam rlung tshul kyis bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas nas//rkang gnyis mgul pa snol bya ste/ /mthil zur gnyis ni sa la gzugs/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i thal mo yis/ /pus mo gnyis ni bsdam byas te/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya /gsum pa 'dod yon bkag pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /48—133

sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i byas krung bca'/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /byas krung nang du bzhug ①byas te/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing sa la gzugs/ /lag gnyis dag la phyid bskur ④nas/ /skyil krung nam mkhar gdeg par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i khrul krung bca'//pad+ma gyen la blang bya ste/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams bstan byas nas/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed sbyor ba yis/ /sgyid khug gnyis su gzhug ①byas la/ /sgal tshigs rab tu bsrang bya ste/ /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /lag gnyis thal mo sbyar byas shing / /dpral bar rab tu gtug byas nas/ /steng 'og rlung gnyis sbyar byas te/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i khrul krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas bkug pa'i thal mo yis /g.yas pa'i dpung mgo bzung byas nas/ /lan bdun bar du bskor byas te/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /zang zing mchog tu 'dzin pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas te/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing phyir la brkyang / /nang du dgug cing phyir la bstan/ /snying ga dag tu mnan byas te/ /lan bdun bar du de bzhin no/ /48—1 34

sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i sprul krung bca'/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /sprul krung nang du bzhug ②byas te/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing sa la gzugs/ /lag gnyis dag la sprud bskur ②nas/ /skyil krung nam mkhar gdeg par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'//pad+ma gyen la blang bya ste/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams bstan byas nas/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed sbyor ba yis/ /skyid khug gnyis su gzhug ②byas la/ /sgal tshigs rab tu bsrang bya ste/ /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /lag gnyis thal mo sbyar byas shing / /dpral bar rab tu gtug byas nas/ /steng 'og rlung gnyis sbyar byas te/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas bkug pa'i thal mo yis/ /g.yas pa'i dpung mgo bzung byas nas/ /lan bdun bar du bskor byas te/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /zang zing mchog tu 'dzin pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas te/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing phyir la brkyang / /nang du dgug cing phyir la bstan/ /snying ga dag tu mnan byas te/ /lan bdun bar du de bzhin no/ /48—1 34

gnyis pa dngos bzhi ①rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis—/ /brang pa sa la gzugs byas te/ /rting pa gnyis ni gshibs pa yis/ /tsos po gnyis ni bteg 1 byas shing / /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /ngar gdong 'og tu bcug byas nas/ /ngar gdong gnyis kyis mnan te/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed then byas pas/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dguga'og rlung drag por then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag por mnan par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung cung zad then byas te/ /'jam rlung dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /lag g.yas stobs bskyed khu tshur bcang / /tshigs gsum bskor zhing lan bdun sprug /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gzhan don 'jug 'dod rtsa langs kyi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe//sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs shing brtan byas nas/ /cog gu'i tshud gyes 'dug byas te/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed sa la gzugs/ /sor bcu rtse mo sprad byas nas/ /lus spyi nam mkha' lding byas te/ /mdun rgyab gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun bar du mchong bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /pad+ma gyen la bslang byas te/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan ③byas nas/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed sbyor ba yis/ /sgyid khug gnyis su gzhug khyobyas te/ /sgal tshigs ⑤bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsgol byas pas//48—135

gnyis pa dngos bzhi ⑫rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis| /brang pa sa la gzugs byas te/ /rting pa gnyis ni gshibs pa yis/ /tsos po gnyis ni bteg ②byas shing / /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /ngar gdong 'og tu bcug byas nas/ /ngar gdong gnyis kyis mnan te/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed then byas pas/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dguga'og rlung drag por then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag por mnan par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i sprul krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung cung zad then byas te/ /'jam rlung dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /lag g.yas stobs bskyed khu tshur bcang / /tshigs gsum bskor zhing lan bdun sprug /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gzhan don 'jug 'dod rtsa langs kyi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe//sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs shing brtan byas nas/ /cog gu'i tshul gyis 'dug byas te/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed sa la gzugs/ /sor bcu rtse mo sprad byas nas/ /lus spyi nam mkha' lding byas te/ /mdun rgyab gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun bar du mchong bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /pad+ma gyen la basbang byas te/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan ②byas nas/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed sbyor ba yis/ /sgyid khug gnyis su gzhug ④byas te/ /sgal tshigs ⑤bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsgom byas pas//48—136

mgrin pa rab tu bsdam byas nas/ /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams bstan byas te/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol ba ni/ /sa la btsugs pa'i steng dag tu/ /zhabs gnyis brtan par bzhag byas nas/ /cog gu'i tshul gyis 'dug byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /brang khog dag gi sbyor ba yis /g.yas g.yon dag tu bsrang byas te/ /gzhungs pa lan bdun bsrang bar bya/ /rgyu 'bras shes pa'i rig pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba la/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /skyil krung rgyu zhabs bar dag tu/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed gzhug byas te/ /khu tshur rab tu bcang byas nas/ /sa la btsugs shing brtan byas pas/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug/byang khog dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /g.yas g.yon rab tu 'greng byas te/ /lan bdun bar du sprugs par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'//pus mo gnyis ni sa la gzugs/ /rkang gnyis 'gul ba'i sa mtshams nas/ /mtho do sor bzhi gzhal0byas nas/ /sa mtshams legs par brtag byas te/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas shing / /phyir bzlog ②sa la gzugs byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung drag po then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /lte ba bskor zhing bsgom par bya/ /48—136

mgrin pa rab tu bsdam byas nas/ /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mabyedas bstan byas te/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol ba ni/ /sa la btsugs pa'i steng dag tu/ /zhabs gnyis brtan par bzhag byas nas/ /cog gu'i tshul rmis 'dug byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /brang khog dag gi sbyor ba yis /g.yas g.yon dag tu bsrang byas te/ /gzhungs pa lan bdun bsrang bar bya/ /rgyu 'bras shes pa'i rig pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba la/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /skyil krung rgyu zhabs bar dag tu/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed gzhug byas te/ /khu tshur rab tu bcang byas nas/ /sa la btsugs shing brtan byas pas/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug/byang khog dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /g.yas g.yon rab tu 'greng byas te/ /lan bdun bar du sprugs par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i dngo krung bca'//pus mo gnyis ni sa la gzugs/ /rkang gnyis 'gul ba'i sa mtshadas nas/ /mtho do sor bzhi gzhal ①byas nas/ /sa mtshalas legs par brtag byas te/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas shing / /phyir bzlog ②sa la gzugs byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung drag po then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /lte ba bskor zhing bsgom par bya/ /48—136

gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis rgyab tu bsnol byas nas/ /deb sha gnyis ni bsdams byas te/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas nas/ /pad+ma gyen la bslang byas te/ /yar kyi tshigs pa bdun pa ni| /lag ngar gnyis la lcid bskur te/ /sa la brtan por gzugs byas nas/ /stod smad gnyis ni stobs bskyed de/ /gyen la lan bdun dgug par bya/ /rgyu 'bras stong par snang ba yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed thal mo yis/ /brla sha gnyis ni mnan byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /gsang gnas gyen la drang byas shing / /mgrin pa dra dmig sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun gyen la bsgreng bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i0rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i sprul krung bca'//tshigs pa'i mar mtshams bstan byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug/lag gnyis rnam snang phyag rgya bca'/ /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /'greng ba'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed byas te/ /rkang g.yas sa la btsugs byas nas/ /rkang g.yon bskyis pa'i mthil dag gis/ /g.yas pa'i bol gong mnan byas shing / /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas//rkang g.yon pus gong mtshams dag tu/ /drag po'i tshul gyis mnan byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /brtan pa'i tshul gyis gnas byas te/ /48—137

gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i khrul krung bca'/ /lag gnyis rgyab tu bsdol byas nas/ /deb sha gnyis ni bsdams byas te/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas nas/ /pad+ma gyen la bslang byas te/ /yar gyi tshigs pa bdun pa ni—/ /lag ngar gnyis la phyid bskur te/ /sa la brtan por gzugs byas nas/ /stod smad gnyis ni stobs bskyed de/ /gyen la lan bdun dgug par bya/ /rgyu 'bras stong par snang ba yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyi krung bca'/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed thal mo yis/ /brla sha gnyis ni mnan byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /gsang gnas gyen la drang byas shing / /mgrin pa dra dmig sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun gyen la bgreng bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i ①rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas bstan byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug/lag gnyis rnam snang phyag rgya bca'/ /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /'greng ba'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed byas te/ /rkang g.yas sa la btsugs byas nas/ /rkang g.yon bskyis pa'i mthil dag gis/ /g.yas pa'i bol gong mnan byas shing / /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /rkang g.yon pus gong mtshalas dag tu/ /drag bo'i tshul byis mnan byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /brtan pa'i tshul gyis gnas byas te/ /48—137

g.yon pa la yang de bzhin no/ /thos dang bsam pa'i las byed kyi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas te/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /mdun du rab tu brkyang byas te/ /mthe bong gnyis ni mdud byas pas/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas te/ /stobs bskyed mdun du brkyang bar bya /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams dhibartan byas te/ /rkang mgo gshibs pa'i byin pa gnyis/ /gru mo gnyis la phyid bskur nas—/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /rkang gnyis mgul pa bsdams byas te/ /stobs bskyed rkang gnyis brkyang byas shing / /lag gnyis stobs bskyed then byas pas/ /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /mgrin pa rab tu dgug byas nas/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i khrul krung bca'/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed thal mo ni/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis su sa la gzugs/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /khong pa rab tu bskor bar bya/ /chos rnams kun la smad pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs 48—138

g.yon pa la yang de bzhin no/ /thos dang bsam pa'i las byed kyi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas te/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /mdun du rab tu brkyang byas te/ /mthe bong gnyis ni mdud byas pas/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas te/ /stobs bskyed mdun du brkyang bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams ⑫brtan byas te/ /rkang mgo gshibs pa'i byin pa gnyis/ /gru mo gnyis la rtsid bskur nas—/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bstob byas pas/ /rkang gnyis mgul pa bsdams byas te/ /stobs bskyed rkang gnyis brkyang byas shing / /lag gnyis stobs bskyed then byas pas/ /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /mgrin pa rab tu dgug byas nas/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed thal mo ni/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis su sa la gzugs/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /khong pa rab tu bskor bar bya /chos rnams kun la smad pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs 48—138

ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis rbe sha bsdams byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang ba'i sbyor ba la/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i lag ngar gyis⑫/ /ltag zur dag ni mnan byas te/ /dang po g.yas phyogs sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun rims kyis bskor byas shing / /g.yas pa la yang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'//pad+ma gyen la bsgang byas nas/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas te/ /lag gnyis mgul pa bsdams byas shing / /sprul krung bcug la bsdam byas nas//sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung drag por then byas nas/ /steng rlung cung zad mnan par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis ngar gdong sa la gzugs/ /gsang sgo dag gi mtshams dag tu/ /zhabs gnyis rtsa bas drag tu bsdam/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i thal mo yis/ /mchan khung rab tu bsdam byas nas/ /lag ngar gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /brla rkang gnyis ni mnan byas shing / /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed byas nas/ /yan lag dang po dgug par bya/ /chos rnams rjes su 'dzin pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas mdun du brkyang byas te/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing khu tshur bcang / /khrig mgul dag gi 'khor lo ni/ /nyi shu dag tu bskor byas shing / /stobs rnams bskyed cing sprugs byas te/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /48—139

ni pad+ma'i byas krung bca'/ /lag gnyis rbe sha bsdams byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang ba'i sbyor ba la/ /lag gnyis bsgol ba'i lag ngar byis①/ /ltag zur dag ni mnan byas te/ /dang po g.yas phyogs sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun rims kyis bskor byas shing / /g.yas pa la yang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i byas krung bca'//pad+ma gyen la bslang byas nas/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas te/ /lag gnyis mgul pa bsdams byas shing / /skyil krung bcug la bsdam byas nas/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung drag por then byas nas/ /steng rlung cung zad mnan par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis ngar gdong sa la gzugs/ /gsang sgo dag gi mtshams dag tu/ /zhabs gnyis rtsa bas drag tu bsdam/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i thal mo yis/ /mchan khung rab tu bsdam byas nas/ /lag ngar gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /brla rkang gnyis ni mnan byas shing / /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed byas nas/ /yan lag dang po dgug par bya/ /chos rnams rjes su 'dzin pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i byas krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas mdun du brkyang byas te/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing khu tshur bcang / /khrig mgul dag gi 'khor lo ni/ /nyi shu dag tu bskor byas shing / /stobs rnams bskyed cing sprugs byas te/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /48—139

gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs g.yon stobs bskyed dzo ni la//zhabs kyi rtsa bas drag tu bsdam/ /zhabs g.yas skum pa'i long bu yis/ /g.yon pa'i brla dag mnan byas te/ /lag g.yon phyir la bkug pa yi/ /gru mo rkang g.yas bol gong bsdam/ /lag g.yas rgyab tu bkug byas shing / /khu tshur dag ni bcang byas te/ /lag g.yon stobs babyed thal mo yis/ lag g.yas mgul pa bsdam byas pas/ /'og rlung drag por then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /stobs rnams bskyed cing bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas shing / /stobs bskyed gyen la bsgreng byas te/ /rtsa rnams snyoms pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sku stod dag ni bskor bar bya/ /sems can kun la brnyas pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i byas krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /mar gyi tshigs pa dgu pa ru/ /lag g.yas rgyab tu dkris byas nas/ /lag g.yon rba sha bsdam byas te/ /g.yon pa khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /pho ba dag la sbyar byas te/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing bsdam ①byas nas/ /g.yas pa la yang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'//tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas bstan⑧byas te/ /lag gnyis rgyab tu bsnol byas nas/ /48—140

gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs g.yon stobs bskyed dzo ni la//zhabs kyi rtsa bas drag tu bsdam/ /zhabs g.yas skum pa'i long bu yis/ /g.yon pa'i brla dag mnan byas te/ /lag g.yon phyir la bkug pa yi/ /gru mo rkang g.yas bol gong bsdam/ /lag g.yas rgyab tu bkug byas shing / /khu tshur dag ni bcang byas te/ /lag g.yon stobs bskyed thal mo yis/ /lag g.yas mgul pa bsdam byas pas/ /'og rlung drag por then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /stobs rnams bskyed cing bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas shing / /stobs bskyed gyen la bsgrong byas te/ /rtsa rnams snyoms pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sku stod dag ni bskor bar bya/ /sems can kun la brnyas pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i sprul krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /mar gyi tshigs pa dgu pa ru/ /lag g.yas rgyab tu dkris byas nas/ /lag g.yon rba sha bsdam byas te/ /g.yon pa khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /pho ba dag la sbyar byas te/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing bsdam ①byas nas/ /g.yas pa la yang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'//tshigs pa'i mar mtshams bstanakubyas te/ /lag gnyis rgyab tu bsnol byas nas//48—140

stobs bskyed khu tshur sa la gzugs/ /sgal tshigs bsrang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /'og rlung drag por then byas te①/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas te/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsdam par bya/ /kasum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas nas//rkang g.yon cog gur 'dug byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsgom byas pas/ /stobs bskyed phyir la brkyang ba la/ /rkang g.yas drag tu brkyang ba yis/ /sor bcu rgyab gtad phul byas te/ /g.yon pa de yang de bzhin no// //lung rigs gtso bor 'dod pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /gan ②rkyal dag tu nyal byas shing / /yar gyi tshigs pa gsum pa la/ /lus kyi sprud rnams bskur byas shing / /lag gnyis gyen la brkyang byas te/ /rkang gnyis gyen la bskum pa yi/ /mthe bong gnyis nas bzung byas shing / /stobs rnams bskyed cing brkyang bar bya// //gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i sprul krung bca'/ /lag gnyis gyen la bsgreng byas te/ /lag g.yas mthil lag g.yon gyi/ /rgyab gtad sor bcu bsnol byas te/ /sgal tshigs mgrin pa bsrang byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung cung zhig mnan byas nas/ /'greng ba'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams bstan byas te/ /48nga 141

stobs bskyed khu tshur sa la gzugs/ /sgal tshigs bsrang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /'og rlung drag por then byas te①/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas te/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsdam par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas nas//rkang g.yon cog gur 'dug byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /stobs bskyed phyir la brkyang ba la/ /rkang g.yas drag tu brkyang ba yis/ /sor bcu rgyab gtad phul byas te/ /g.yon pa de yang de bzhin no// //lung rigs gtso bor 'dod pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /gan ②rkyal dag tu nyal byas shing / /yar gyi tshigs pa gsum pa la/ /lus kyi phyid rnams bskur byas shing / /lag gnyis gyen la brkyang byas te/ /rkang gnyis gyen la bskum pa yi/ /mthe bong gnyis nas bzung byas shing / /stobs rnams bskyed cing brkyang bar bya// //gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis gyen la bsgreng byas te/ /lag g.yas mthil lag g.yon gyi/ /rgyab gtad sor bcu bsnol byas te/ /sgal tshigs mgrin pa bsrang byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung cung zhig mnan byas nas/ /'greng ba'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams bstan byas te/ /48—141

rkang g.yas bkug pa'i mgul pa ni/ /mjing pa dag la rgal byas te/ /rkang g.yas stobs bskyed langs byas shing / /thugs kar thal mo sbyar byas te/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no// //lha spyod sgom pas grub pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i spyi krung bca'/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas te/ /phyir bzlog gru mo gdeg byas shing / /sgal ⑫tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed byas nas/ /srong ba'i tshul gyis sgom par bya /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas nas/ /rkang gnyis mgul pa bsnol byas te/ /cog gu'i tshul gyis 'dug byas shing / /lag gnyis rba sha bsdams byas pas/ /pus mo gnyis ni gzhug byas te/ /mthil zur gnyis ni sa la gzugs/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /steng rlung drag por mnan byas te/ /'og rlung cung zad then byas nas—/ /sbyor ba'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed khu tshur bcang / /ri rab 'phul ②ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed byas shing / /brang khog dag kyang bsrang bar bya // //⑫rigs dang rigs min spong ba yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngo na 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /rkang 48—142

rkang g.yas bkug pa'i mgul pa ni/ /mjing pa dag la rgal byas te/ /rkang g.yas stobs babyed langs byas shing / /thugs kar thal mo sbyar byas te/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no// //lta spyod sgom pas grub pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil/ krung bca'/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas te/ /phyir bzlog gru mo gdeg byas shing / /sgal ①tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed byas nas/ /srong ba'i tshul gyis sgom par bya /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan byas nas| /rkang gnyis mgul pa bsnol byas te/ /cog gu'i tshul gyis 'dug byas shing / /lag gnyis rba sha bsdams byas pas/ /pus mo gnyis ni gzhug byas te/ /mthil zur gnyis ni sa la gzugs/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /steng rlung drag por mnan byas te/ /'og rlung cung zad then byas nas—/ /sbyor ba'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis stobs babyed khu tshur bcang / /ri rab 'phul ①ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed byas shing / /brang khog dag kyang bsrang bar bya // // —rigs dang rigs min spong ba yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /rkang 48—142

gnyis bsnol ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bol gong sa la btsugs byas te/ /rting pa gnyis kyis tsos po bsdams/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /phyir zlog sa la gzugs byas te/ /ngar gdong gnyis kyis mnan byas shing / /stobs babyed rab tu bsgom par bya /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas bstan byas nas—/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /sa la brtan par gzugs byas la/ /rkang gnyis bsnol ba'i mthil dag gis/ /lag gnyis mgul pa brkyang byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung cung zad mnan byas nas/ /sdom pa'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas bstan byas te/ /rkang gnyis bsnol ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /rkang g.yas g.yon du brkyang byas te/ /rkang g.yon g.yas su brkyang byas pas/ /lag gnyis stobs skyed ①thal mo yis /rkang gnyis sor mo bsdams byas te/ /khong pa dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /rims kyis g.yas su bcus byas te/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no// //bag chags gtso bor 'dod pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis②/ /sa la brtan por gzugs byas te/ /rkang gnyis sor bcu'i rtse mo ni/ /lag gnyis mthil la gtad byas te/ /stobs babyed rab tu bsdams byas pas/ /bsrang ba'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /mar gyi tshigs pa bstan byas te/ /48—143

gnyis bsnol ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bol gong sa la btsugs byas te/ /rteng pa gnyis kyis tsos po bsdams/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /phyir zlog sa la gzugs byas te/ /ngar gdong gnyis kyis mnan byas shing / /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams bstan byas nas—/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /sa la brtan par gzugs byas la/ /rkang kanyis bsnol ba'i mthil dag gis/ /lag gnyis mgul pa brkyang byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung cung zad mnan byas nas/ /sdom pa'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams bstan byas te/ /rkang gnyis bsnol ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /rkang g.yas g.yon du brkyang byas te/ /rkang g.yon g.yas su brkyang byas pas/ /lag gnyis stobs skyed ①thal mo yis/ /rkang gnyis sor mo bsdams byas te/ /khong pa dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /rims kyis g.yas su bcus byas te/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no// //bag chags gtso bor 'dod pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis / /sa la brtan por gzugs byas te/ /rkang gnyis sor bcu'i rtse mo ni/ /lag gnyis mthil la gtad byas te/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsdams byas pas/ /bsrang ba'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /mar gyi tshigs pa bstan byas te/ /48—143

rkang gnyis bsnol ba'i rteng pa yis/ /phyi zur gnyis ni bsdams byas te/ /rkang mgul gnyis kyi sa mtshams nas/ /mtho gang sor bzhi gzhal byas shing / /lag g.yas khu tshur brtan por gzugs/ /lag g.yon stobs bskyed thal mo yis//g.yas pa'i mgul pa drag tu bsdam/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyid krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis stobs bskyed khu tshur ni/ /g.yas g.yon dag tu sa la gzugs/ /skyil krung gyen la bteg byas shing / /nam mkhar rab tu lding bar bya// //rnal 'byor gzhan don med pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams bstan byas te/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i brkyang byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /rbe sha phul ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /pho ba dag ni bsdam par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /pad+ma gyen la bslang byas te/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams bstan byas nas/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed sbyor ba ni/ /sgyid khug gnyis su gzhung byas te/ /khu tshur sa la brtan por gzugs/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /48—144

rkang gnyis bsnol ba'i rting pa yis/ /phyi zur gnyis ni bsdams byas te/ /rkang mgul gnyis kyi sa mtshalas nas/ /mtho gang sor bzhi gzhal byas shing / /lag g.yas khya tshur brtan por gzugs/ /lag g.yon stobs babyed thal mo yis//g.yas pa'i mgul pa drag tu bsdam/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis stobs bskyed khu tshur ni/ /g.yas g.yon dag tu sa la gzugs/ /bya krung gyen la bteg byas shing / /nam mkhar rab tu lding bar bya// //rnal 'byor gzhan don med pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas bstan byas te/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i brkyang byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /rbe sha phul ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /pho ba dag ni bsdam par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /pad+ma gyen la bslang byas te/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas bstan byas nas/ /lag gnyis stobs babyed sbyor ba ni/ /sgyid khug gnyis su gzhung byas te/ /khu tshur sa la brtan por gzugs/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /'og rlung drag por zen byas te/ /48—144

stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /rkang pa gnyis ni gshibs pa yi/ /brang pa sa la gzugs byas te/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas pas/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing sa la gzugs/ /rteng pa gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /tsos po gnyis ni bsdams byas nas/ /pus mo phyir la brkyang byas shing / /stod rnams gseng zhing bsgom par bya// //khams gsum dag tu 'dzin pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /mar gyi tshigs pa gsum pa la/ /lus kyi ldid rnams bkur ②byas te/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /phyir la bzlog pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rkang gnyis brla sha bsdam byas la/ /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /stobs rnams bskyed pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun bar du sprug par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /rkang g.yas stobs bskyed 'dzo ②ni la//zhabs kyi rtsa bas drag tu bsdams/ /rkang g.yon bskum pa'i bol gong gis/ /rkang g.yas brla sgang mnan byas shing / /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas te/ /pus mo gnyis ni gzhug byas nas/ /lag ngar gnyis kyis bsdams byas shing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung cung zad mnan byas nas/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i sprul krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis stobs bskyed khu tshur bcang / /48—146

phyir la brkyang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun bar du sprugs par bya/ /nang du bkug pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dpung pa gnyis la gdeg par bya// //ma dmigs dmigs pas baspub pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe//sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i sprul krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lto ba skyod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas te/ /stobs bskyed phyir la brkyang byas nas/ /klum po dbyibs kyi rnam bzhag gis/ /lan bdun bar du bskor bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i nom bzhag ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i sprul krung bca'//tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas te/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /mchad 'oka gnyis ni drag por bsdam/ /sgal ⑫tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug/'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /mdun rgyab g.yom zhing sgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas te/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing sa la gzugs/ /skyil krung pus mo g.yas bcug nas/ /stobs bskyed sor bcu mnan byas nas/ /nu mjing stod kyi sbyor ba yis/ /g.yon nas dag tu gcusakubyas shing / /drag po'i tshul gyis bsdamababyas te/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no// //nang gi bde gsal mi rtog gi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /48—146

sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i bya krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis stobs bskyed khu tshur bcang / /rgyab tu bkug pa'i sbyor ba yis yar gyi sgal tshigs dang po la/ /re mos dag gis sbyor ba yis/ /bcu bzhi bar du brdeg byas shing / /bsgrags pa dag kyang rab gdon ①no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /ngar gdong gnyis ni sa la btsugs//zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i rting pa yis/ /gsang sgo rab tu bsdams byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas khu tshur gyen la bgreng / /lag g.yon thal mos lag g.yas kyi/ /gru tshigs bsdams pa'i lag ngar gyis/ /spyi gtsug rab tu mnan byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /g.yas g.yon bsrang zhing bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /mar byi tshigs pa brtan byas shing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /rkang gnyis dag dang lag gnyis ni/ /nam mkha' dag la gdeng byas te/ /lam/ bdun bar du sprugs par bya// //ting 'dzin rnam par 'chang ba yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ / gan rkyal ④dag tu nyal byas nas/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /gyen la rab tu bsgreng byas te/ /yar gyi tshigs pa dang po la/ /lus kyi ljid rnams bskur byas te/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed stod du brkyang / /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /stobs rnams rab tu babyed par bya/ /48—147

sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i sgrib krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis stobs bskyed khu tshur bcang / /rgyab tu bkug pa'i sbyor ba yis yar gyi sgal tshigs dang po la/ /re mos dag gis sbyor ba yis/ /bcu bzhi bar du brdeg byas shing / /bsgrags pa dag kyang rab gdon ①no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /ngar gdong gnyis ni sa la btsugs//zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i rteng pa yis/ /gsang sgo rab tu bsdams byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas khu tshur gyen la bsgrong / /lag g.yon thal mos lag g.yas kyi/ /gru tshigs bsdams pa'i lag ngar gyis/ /byi gtsug rab tu mnan byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /g.yas g.yon bsrang zhing bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /mar gyi tshigs pa brtan byas shing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /rkang gnyis dag dang lag gnyis ni/ /nam mkha' dag la gdeng byas te/ /lan bdun bar du sprugs par bya// //ting 'dzin rnam par 'chang ba yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ / gan rkyal ②dag tu nyal byas nas/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /gyen la rab tu bsgreng byas te/ /yar gyi tshigs pa dang po la/ /lus kyi smid rnams bskur byas te/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed stod du brkyang / /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed par bya/ /48—147

gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'//lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas te/ /lag ngar gnyis ni sa la btsugs/ /lus spyi ⑫mkha' la lding byas nas/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgomakupar bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /lag g.yas sa la btsugs byas te/ /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed byas shing / /lus byikumakha' la lding byas nas/ /rdza mkhan dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor byas te/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no// //bden pas grub pa'i gnyis med kyi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed thal mo dang / /spyi bo sa la btsugs byas te/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha' dag la 'greng bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'//lag gnyis rgyab tu bad ba yi/ /lag mthil gnyis kyis gru mo bsdams/ /lag ngar gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /mar gyi tshigs pa bdun pa ru/ /bsdams pa'i tshul gyis mnan byas shing / /rbe sha gnyis ni stobs bskyed nas/ /rtsibs log gnyis ni bsdams byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams bstan byas te/ /48nga 148

lag gnyis stobs bskyed thal mo ni/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis pu sa la btsugs/ /rkang gnyis stobs bskyed rting pa ni/ /re mos dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /brla sha gnyis la brdeg par bya// //yul dang yul gyi dmigs ldan gyi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams bstan byas te/ /lag gnyis rbe sha bsdams pa yi/ /lag ngar gnyis kyis sbyor ba yis/ /pho ba dag ni gnas byas shing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /zhabs gnyis stobs bskyed phul bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'//pad+ma gyen la bslang bya ste/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas bstan byas nas/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i lag mthil gyis/ /ltag zur gnyis ni bsdams byas shing / /sgal tshigs mgrin pa bsrang byas shing / /'og rlung cung zad then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas te/ /stobs babyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas bstan byas te//sgal tshigs mgrin pa dgug byas shing / /rkang g.yas drag tu brkyang byas nas/ /rkang g.yon bskum pa'i bol gong gis/ /rkang g.yas brla sgang ①mnan byas te/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed brkyang byas nas/ /rkang g.yas 'og tu bcug byas te/ /sor bcu rab tu bsgol byas pas/ /phyir bzlog stobs rnams bskyed par bya// //sems dang sems kyi khyad par gyi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /48—149

sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /pus mo sa la gzugs byas la/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yon mdun du mnyam bzhag nas/ /lag g.yas khu tshur bcang byas te/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar g.yob byed cing / /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i ①rim pa ni/ /rkang g.yon brang pa sa la btsugasog//rkang g.yas bskum pa'i bol gong gis/ /g.yon pa'i brla sgang mnan byas te/ /zhabs g.yon rting pa stobs bskyed nas/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brdeg byas shing / /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas nas/ /sa la rab tu btsugs byas te//sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung cung zad then byas shing / /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis ngar gdong sa la gzugs/ /gsang sgo dag gi mtshams dag tu/ /zhabs gnyis rtsa ba drag tu bsnams/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed sa la gzugs/ /sor bcu bsnol ba'i mtshams dag tu//rang gdong dag ni mnan byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /g.yas g.yon gnyis dang thad ka ru/ /lan bdun bar du bsrang bar bya// //bden bsgrub 'dod legs nges pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe//sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag g.yon stobs bskyed sa la gzugs/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /laka g.yas khu tshur bcang byas te/ /48—160

klad la bskor ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun bar du sprugs byas shing / /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /rkang g.yon brtan por sa la btsugs//'greng ba'i tshul gyi langs byas te/ /lag g.yon phyir bkug gru mo yis/ /rkang g.yas bol gong g.yon pa'i bzasgang nas tshur btang ba bsdams byas te/ /lag g.yas phyir bkug khu tshung bcang / /lag g.yon stobs babyed thal mo yis/ /g.yas pa'i mgul pa bsdams byas shing / /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /steng rlung cung zad mnan byas shing / /'og sgo drag por then byas te/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /mar gyi tshigs pa bstan byas te/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pas mdun du brkyang / /lag gnyis gyen la bgreng byas te//lag g.yas stobs babyed bcang ba yis/ /lag g.yon sor mo bsdams byas te/ /khong pa dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor byas shing / /g.yas pa dag kyang de bzhin no// //nyams rnams mtshan mar stsong byed kyi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe//sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /tshad dang ldan pa'i dbyug pa ni/ /ldang shing tshul gyis nam mkha' la/ /brtan par rab tu gzung byas te/ /pho ba dag ni dgal byas shing / /rkang pa gnyis dang lag pa gnyis/ /mtho gang sa mtshams nam mkha' la/ /stobs babyed rab tu lding bar bya/ /48byed151

gnyis pad+ma'i byas krung bca'/ /lag gnyis stobs babyed thal mo yis/ /zhabs gnyis sor mo bsdams byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug/gsegs pa'i tshul byi bsgom par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /pus mo sa la btsugs byas te/ /mtho do gcal ba'i sa mtshams su/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas te/ /lag ngar gshibs te sa la gzugs/ /mgo bo cung zad dgye ba la/ /sgal tshigs rab tu dgug byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas nas/ /steng rlung cung zad mnan byas te/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis mtheb mo mnan byas shing / /cog gu'i tshul gyis 'dug byas te/ /rkang pa'i mtheb mo'i mtshalas dag nas/ /mtho gang gcal ba'i sa mtshalas su/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu btsugs byas shing / /lag ngar gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /pus mo gnyis ni bsdams byas te/ /bsrang ba'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya// //skyes pa'i stobs kyis 'jug pa yi/ /skyon ni rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /stobs babyed rab tu langs byas shing / /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas nas/ /phyir zlog thur la brkyang byas te/ /zhabs g.yas bcug pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun bar du 'gong byas shing / /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /48—154

lag gnyis khu tshur bcang ba yi/ /lag ngar gnyis dang spyi bo ni/ /sa la brtan por gzugs byas te/ /skyil krung nam mkhar lding byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /stobs babyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas pas/ /pad+ma'i byas krung bcas byas nas/ /pad ma gyen la bslang byas te/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas shing / /mgrin pa rab tu dgug byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu ldang bar bya// //mtshan rnams rjes su bsgrub pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /rkang g.yas stobs bskyed sa la gzugs/ /rkang g.yon gyen la bltab byas te/ /lag g.yon thur la brkyang byas nas/ /rkang g.yon mgul pa then byas shing / /lag g.yas khu tshur bcang byas pas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bskor byas te/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /ljon shing dag la 'dzeg byas nas/ /mgo bo thur du brtan byas te/ /lag pa gnyis dang rkang pa gnyis/ /ljon shing dag la 'khyud byas shing / /pang par btab pa'i tshul dag gis/ /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /stobs babyed rab tu bsgom par bya /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /48—155

lag gnyis khu tshur bcang ba yi/ /laka ngar gnyis dang spyi bo ni/ /sa la brtan por gzugs byas te/ /skyil krung nam mkhar lding byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas pas/ /pad+ma'i skyil krung bcas byas nas/ /pad ma gyen la basbang byas te/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas shing / /mgrin pa rab tu dgug byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu ldang bar bya// //mtshan rnams rjes su baspub pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /rkang g.yas stobs bskyed sa la gzugs/ /rkang g.yon gyen la bltab byas te/ /lag g.yon thur la brkyang byas nas/ /rkang g.yon mgul pa then byas shing / /lag g.yas khu tshur bcang byas pas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bskor byas te/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /ljon shing dag la 'dzeg byas nas/ /mgo bo thur du brtan byas te/ /lag pa gnyis dang rkang pa gnyis/ /ljon shing dag la 'khyud byas shing / /pang par btab pa'i tshul dag gis/ /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /48—155

sa la brtan por gzugs byas te/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas pas/ /'greng ba'i tshul gyis ldang byas nas①/ /ri rab phul sneba'i sbyor ba yis /lan bdun bar du sprug par bya// //khams bzhi zil byis gnon pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i byas krung bca'/ /lag gnyis rgyab tu bsnol byas nas/ /rbe sha gnyis ni bsdams byas shing / /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas te/ /yar gyi tshigs pa gsum pa la/ /lus kyi ljid rnams bskur byas te/ /khong pa dag ni bsrang byas te/ /skyil krung nam mkhar phyar bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'//lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /spu mtshams dag tu mnan byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /rtsib ma rab tu bsrang byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung cung zad mnan byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /pad+ma gyen la babe+eng byas te/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas te/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /snying ga rab tu mnan byas te/ /lus rnams bkug cing bsgom par bya// //de nyid bsgrub pa'i zlos sems kyi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /48—156

sa la brtan por gzugs byas te/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas pas /'greng ba'i tshul gyis ldang byas nas / /ri rab phulakuba'i sbyor ba yis /lan bdun bar du sprug par bya// //khams bzhi zil gyis gnon pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis rgyab tu bsnol byas nas/ /rbe sha gnyis ni bsdams byas shing / /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas te/ /yar kyi tshigs pa gsum pa la/ /lus kyi lngid rnams bskur byas te/ /khong pa dag ni bsrang byas te/ /skyil krung nam mkhar phyar bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'//lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /spu mtshams dag tu mnan byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /rtsib ma rab tu bsrang byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung cung zad mnan byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i sprul krung bca'/ /pad+ma gyen la basbang byas te/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas te/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /snying ga rab tu mnan byas te/ /lus rnams bkug cing bsgom par bya// //de nyid baspub pa'i rlom sems kyi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /48—166

sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan byas te/ /rkang mgo gshibs ①pa'i sbyor ba yi/ /nam mkha' dag la brdeg byas shing / /lag gnyis stobs babyed gru mo yis/ /rkang gnyis byin pa brten byas nas/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /bol gong mgul pa bsdam par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yi//ngar gdong sa la btsugs byas te/ /lag pa gnyis dang rkang gnyis kyi/ /sor bcu rab tu bsnol byas te/ /rkang pa gnyis kyis ②bol gong gis/ /lag mthil gnyis ni mnan byas te/ /sgal tshigs mgrin pa dgug byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /rkang gnyis gshibs te sa la gzugs/ /rkang sor gnyis kyi rtse mo nas/ /sor bzhi gzhal ba'i sa mtshalas su/ /lag gnyis khu tshur gshibs la gzugs/ /rkang gnyis long bu g.yas g.yon nas/ /khru re gzhal ba'i sa mtshalas su/ /rkang gnyis stobs bskyed g.yas g.yon du/ /'gyed dang sdud pa'i spyor ba yis/ /lan bdun bar du mchong bar bya// //gzhan sems shes pa'i stobs ldan gyi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe//sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i ①byas krung bca'/ /lag gnyis stobs babyed sbyor ba yis/ /rkang gnyis sor bcu bsdams byas te/ /sgal tshigs rnams ni bsrang byas shing //48—157

sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas te/ /rkang mgo gshibs ⑫pa'i sbyor ba yi/ /nam mkha' dag la bdeg byas shing / /lag gnyis stobs bskyed gru mo yis/ /rkang gnyis byin pa brten byas nas/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /bol gong mgul pa bsdam par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yi//ngar gdong sa la btsugs byas te/ /lag pa gnyis dang rkang gnyis kyi/ /sor bcu rab tu bsnol byas te/ /rkang pa gnyis kyis ②bol gong gis/ /lag mthil gnyis ni mnan byas te/ /sgal tshigs mgrin pa dgug byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /rkang gnyis gshibs te sa la gzugs/ /rkang sor gnyis kyi rtse mo nas/ /sor bzhi gzhal ba'i sa mtshams su/ /lag gnyis khu tshur gshibs la gzugs/ /rkang gnyis long du g.yas g.yon nas/ /khru re gzhal ba'i sa mtshams su/ /rkang gnyis stobs bskyed g.yas g.yon du/ /'gyed dang sdud pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun bar du mchong bar bya// //gzhan sems shes pa'i stobs ldan gyi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe//sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i ②skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed sbyor ba yis/ /rkang gnyis sor bcu bsdams byas te/ /sgal tshigs rnams ni bsrang byas shing //48—167

mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /long bu gnyis la ldid bskur te/ /lus spyi stobs rnams rab bskyed nas/ /mdun rgyab dag tu sding bar bya /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad ma'i skyil krung bca'//lag gnyis stobs bskyed thal mo yis/ /mkhal khung gnyis ni bsdams byas shing //sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /sprul pa dag tu basprul byas nas/ /lto ba bskor zhing bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas nas/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed thal mo yis| /brla sgang gnyis ni mnan byas shing / /khong pa dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /longs spyod 'khor lo bskor bar bya// //lta ba snyoms pa'i bden 'dzin gyi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos kazhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis rbe sha bsdams byas te/ /gyen la rab tu phyar ba yi/ /byi gtsug dag ni mnan byas shing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lus kyi stobs rnams bskyed par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis 'gug pa bsnol byas te//mthil zur gnyis ni sa la btsugs①/ /rkang gnyis mgul pa'i mtshams dag nas—/ /mtho do gcal ba'i sa mtshams su/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas te—/ /stobs bskyed sa la gzugs byas shing / /lag ngar gnyis ni stobs 48—158

mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /long bu gnyis la ljid bskur te/ /lus spyi stobs rnams rab bskyed nas/ /mdun rgyab dag tu lding bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad ma'i skyil krung bca'//lag gnyis stobs babyed thal mo yis/ /mkhal khung gnyis ni bsdams byas shing //sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /sprul pa dag tu bakhrul byas nas/ /lto ba bskor zhing bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan byas nas/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed thal mo yis—/ /brla sgang gnyis ni mnan byas shing / /khong pa dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /longs spyod 'khor lo bskor bar bya// //lta ba snyoms pa'i bden 'dzin byi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis rbe sha bsdams byas te/ /gyen la rab tu phyar ba yi/ /spyi gtsug dag ni mnan byas shing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lus kyi stobs rnams bskyed par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa no/ /zhabs gnyis 'gug pa bsnol byas te//mthil zur gnyis ni sa la btsugs①/ /rkang gnyis mgul pa'i mtshalas dag nas / /mtho do gcal ba'i sa mtshalas su/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas te—/ /stobs bskyed sa la gzugs byas shing / /lag ngar gnyis ni stobs 48—158

bskyed nas/ /pus mo dag ni bsdams byas te②/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung cung zad then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas te/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /snying kha rab tu mnan byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /rkang g.yon drag tu brkyang byas shing / /rkang g.yas bskum pa'i long bu yis/ /rkang g.yon rtsa chen bshad byas shing / /g.yas pa dag kyang de bzhin no// //thugs rje rlom sems dang 'brel gyi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag 'khru lta bu'i sbyor ba yis/ /lus kyi stobs rnams bskyed par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad ma'i sprul krung bca'//lag gnyis rgyab tu bsnol byas te/ /tre sha gnyis ni bsdams byas shing / /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i lag ngar gyis/ /tshigs pa bdun pa mnan byas shing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'oka rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis ngar gdong sa la gzugs/ /rting pa gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /tsos po gnyis ni bsdams byas pas/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas te/ /48nga 169

babyed nas/ /pus mo dag ni bsdams byas te①/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung cung zad then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan byas te/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /snying kha rab tu mnan byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /rkang g.yon drag tu brkyang byas shing / /rkang g.yas bskum pa'i long bu yis/ /rkang g.yon rtsa chen bshad byas shing / /g.yas pa dag kyang de bzhin no// //thugs rje rlom sems dang 'brel gyi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i khrul krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag 'khru lta bu'i sbyor ba yis/ /lus kyi stobs rnams bskyed par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad ma'i skyil krung bca'//lag gnyis rgyab tu bsnol byas te/ /rbe sha gnyis ni bsdams byas shing / /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i lag ngar gyis/ /tshigs pa bdun pa mnan byas shing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis ngar gdong sa la gzugs/ /rting pa gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /tsos po gnyis ni bsdams byas pas/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsgol byas te/ /48—159

mjing pa dag ni bsdams byas shing / /lag gnyis gru mo mnye bar bya// //zag med sgrubs pas ①'dzin pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi ⑤rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /mdzub mo lug rgyud sbyor ba yi/ /g.yas pa'i gru mo bteg byas pas/ /mchan khung dag ni stobs bskyed nas/ /g.yon pa'i lag ngar mnan byas shing / /g.yas pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bca'//lag g.yon mnyam bzhag phyag rgya dang / /lag g.yas mchod sbyin phyag rgya bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung cung zad then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas shing / /byas krung gyen la bslang byas te/ /yar gyi tshigs pa gsum pa la/ /lus kyi ljid rnams bskur nga byas shing / /lag gnyis stobs bskyed sbyor ba yis/ /rked pa dag ni brten par bya// //slob dpon chen po 'bir wa pas mdzad pa'i 'chi med grub pa'i 'phrang sum cu rtsa drug gi 'khrul 'khor byi yig sna/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug a mo gha badz+ras mdzad pa/ rdzogs so// //48—160
