ston /'chi med grub pa'i sdom pa bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor gyi yig sna/①༄pha /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rags pa sdom pa rnam bzhi las/ /sa yi sdom pa'i rim pa ni/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas la/ /mthe bong lug rgyud bsnol byas pa'i/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa brkyang byas te/ /lag gnyis gshibs pas stod du brkyang / /khu tshul rab tu bcang byas te/ /lan bdun bar du ldang bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'//pad ma gyen la bslang byas te/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams bstan byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas nas/ /sgom thag tshul gyi sbyor ba yis/ /skyil/ grung drag tu bsdam bya ste/ /'og rlung drag tu then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag tu mnan byas shing / /stobs bskyed 48—163

tshog /'chi rmed grub pa'i sdom pa bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor gyi yig sna/⑫ra /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rags pa sdom pa rnam bzhi las/ /sa yi sdom pa'i rim pa ni/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas la/ /mthe bong lug rgyud bsnol byas pa'i/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa brkyang byas te/ /lag gnyis gshibs pas stod du brkyang / /khu tshur rab tu bcang byas te/ /lan bdun bar du ldang bar bya/ /kanyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'//pad ma gyen la bslang byas te/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams bstan byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas nas/ /sgom thag tshul gyi sbyor ba yis/ /skyil krung drag tu bsdam bya ste/ /'og rlung drag tu then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag tu mdan byas shing / /stobs bskyed 48nga 163

rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas te/ /stobs bskyed sa la btsugs byas shing / /'greng ba'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas te/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas//phyir bzlog gyen la bgreng byas nas/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /stobs bskyed lan bdun 'phra bar bya// //chu yi sdom pa'i rnam bzhag ①la/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /cog gu'i tshul gyis 'dug byas te/ /lag g.yon khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /yar gyi tshigs pa gsum pa ru/ /stobs babyed rab tu mnan byas shing / /lag g.yas khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /stobs babyed mdun du brkyang byas te/ /g.yon ngos dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan zhu/byas te/ /sgal tshig ⑦bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i thal mo yis/ /mchan 'og gnyis ni bsdams byas shing / /'og rlung cung zad then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /ro stod 0rab tu brgyang byas shing / /gsegs ⑤pa'i tshul rmis bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal 48—164

rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas te/ /stobs bskyed sa la btsugs byas shing / /'greng ba'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas te/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas//phyir bzlog gyen la bsgrong byas nas/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /stobs bskyed lan bdun 'phra bar bya// //chu yi sdom pa'i rnam bzhag ⑫la/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /cog gu'i tshul gyis 'dug byas te/ /lag g.yon khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /yar gyi tshigs pa gsum pa ru/ /stobs bskyed rab tu mnan byas shing / /lag g.yas khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /stobs bskyed mdun du brkyang byas te/ /g.yon ngos dag lhong de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan ②byas te/ /sgal tshig ②bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i thal mo yis/ /mchar 'og gnyis ni bsdams byas shing / /'og rlung cung zad then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /ro stod 0rab tu brgyang byas shing / /gsigs ⑤pa'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal 48—164

tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /snying ga rab tu mnan byas te/ /stobs bskyed khong pa bskor bar bya/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i byas krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /mdzub mo lug rgyud sbyor ba la/ /yan lag dang po gzhug byas shing / /mgrin pa dag la ljid bsgur nas/ /g.yas g.yon bsrang zhing bsgom par bya// //me yi sdom pa'i rnam bzhag la/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /bar snang gnas pa'i shing dag la/ /thag pa'i sna gnyis btags byas pas/ /thag pa khug pa'i sbyor ba la/ /zhabs gnyis mthil ni gzhug byas te/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed thag pa la⑨/ /bcang ba'i tshul gyis gzung ④bya ste/ /nam mkhar ①rab tu lding bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ri pad+ma'i skyil grung bca'/ /rkang gnyis mgul pa'i sa mtshams nas/ /mtho do sor bzhi gcal byas pa'i/ /sa mtshalas nges par brtag byas te/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /sa la brtan por gzugs byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /zo chu 'khor lo'i sbyor ba yis/ /stobs babyed rab tu bsgom par bya /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i khrul krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis mtheb mo bsgol byas te/ /phyir bzlog mdun du brkyang byas shing / /stobs rnams bskyed cing bsgom par bya//zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /48—165

tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /snying ga rab tu mnan byas te/ /stobs bskyed khong pa bskor bar bya/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /mdzub mo lug rgyud sbyor ba la/ /yan lag dang po gzhug byas shing / /mgrin pa dag la ldid bskur nas/ /g.yas g.yon bsrang zhing bsgom par bya// //me yi sdom pa'i rnam bzhag la/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /bar snang gnas pa'i shing dag la/ /thag pa'i sna gnyis btags byas pas/ /thag pa khug pa'i sbyor ba la/ /zhabs gnyis mthil ni gzhug byas te/ /lag gnyis stobs babyed thag pa la⑫/ /bcang ba'i tshul byis gzung ②bya ste/ /nam mkhar ②rab tu lding bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i sprul krung bca'/ /rkang gnyis mgul pa'i sa mtshams nas/ /mtho do sor bzhi gcal byas pa'i/ /sa mtshams nges par brtag byas te/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /sa la brtan por gzugs byas shing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /zo chu 'khor lo'i sbyor ba yis/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis mtheb mo bsnol byas te/ /phyir bzlog mdun du brkyang byas shing / /stobs rnams bskyed cing bsgom par bya//zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /48—165

lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas te/ /snying ga dag tu brten byas nas/ /mdun du phul ba'i sbyor ba yi/ /stobs bskyed lan bdun mchong bar bya// //rlung gi sdom pa'i rnam bzhag la/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas te/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha' dag la 'greng byas shing / /lag gnyis stobs rnams bskyed bya ste/ /rkang gnyis mtheb mos then bya ste/ /yar gyi tshigs pa bdun pa la/ /lus kyi byād rnams bkur ①bya ste/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pas langs byas nas/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /rkang pa'i mtheb mo gnyis bzung ⑧nas/ /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /lag gnyis stobs bskyed then byas nas/ /sgal tshigs mgrin pa dgug byas shing / /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /pus mgo gnyis kyi steng dag tu/ /lag gnyis mtheb mo gzugs bya ste/ /mtho gnyis sprad pa'i nang dag tu/ /yan lag dang po gzhug par bya/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i spyil krung bca'/ /skyil krung gyen la bslang bya ste/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas nas/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis gshibs la khu tshur bcang / /stobs babyed mdun du brkyang bar bya'o// //48—166

lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas te/ /snying ga dag tu brten byas nas/ /mdun du phul ba'i sbyor ba yi/ /stobs bskyed lan bdun mchong bar bya// //rlung gi sdom pa'i rnam bzhag la/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas te/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha' dag la 'greng byas shing / /lag gnyis stobs rnams bskyed bya ste/ /rkang gnyis mtheb mos then bya ste/ /yar gyi tshigs pa bdun pa la/ /lus kyi lngid rnams bkur ⑫bya ste/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pas langs byas nas/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /rkang pa'i mtheb mo gnyis bzung⑫nas/ /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /lag gnyis stobs bskyed then byas nas/ /sgal tshigs mgrin pa dgug byas shing / /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i sprul krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /pus mgo gnyis kyi steng dag tu/ /lag gnyis mtheb mo gzugs bya ste/ /mtho gnyis sprad pa'i nang dag tu/ /yan lag dang po gzhug par bya/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /skyil krung gyen la bslad bya ste/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas nas/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis gshibs la khu tshur bcang / /stobs bskyed mdun du brkyang bar bya'o// //48nga 166

slob dpon chen po 'ber wa pas mdzad pa'i 'chi med grub pa'i sdom pa bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor gyi yig sna/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug a mo gha badz+ras mdzad pa ①rdzogs so//② //bsdur mchan/162 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogasabyang las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉kho /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug a mo snya badz+ras mdzad pa bzhugs//164 ①〈〈pe 〉〉dzinag ②〈〈pe 〉〉bstan/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉stathugag du〈〈pe 〉〉bstod/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉bsrigs/165 ①〈〈pe 〉ra/ ②〈〈pe 〉thazung / ②〈〈pe 〉stabakha'/166 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bskur/ ②〈〈pe 〉stanazung /167 ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〉// // ②〈〈pe 〉〉ngamaṅgas+t+waṃbasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2816)48—167

slob dpon chen po 'ber wa pas mdzad pa'i 'chi med grub pa'i sdom pa bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor gyi yig sna/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug a mo gha badz+ras mdzad pa ①rdzogs so//② //bsdur mchan/162 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogasabyang las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉kho /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug a mo snya badz+ras mdzad pa bzhugs//164 ①〈〈pe 〉〉dzinag ②〈〈pe 〉thastan/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉stathugag du〈〈pe 〉〉bstod/ ⑤〈6pe 〉〉bsrigs/165 ①〈〈pe 〉ra/ ②〈〈pe 〉thazung / ②〈〈pe 〉zabakha'/166 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bskur/ ②〈〈pe 〉stanazung /167 ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〉// // ②〈〈pe 〉rigabaṅga s+t+waṃbasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2816)48—167

tshog /'chi rmed kyi dngos gzhi bcu ngadun gyi rnam gzhag bzhugs so//⑫ma / /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi dang po'i rnam gzhag ni/ /bum pa can la bsgab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag g.yon gyen la bsgrong bya ste/ /khu tshur dag ni bcang byas nas/ /lag g.yas stobs bskyed thal mo yis/ /g.yon pa'i phrag gdong dag la ni/ /lan bdun bar du mnan byas shing / /g.yas pa la yang de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis rgyab tu bsnol byas pas/ /rbe sha gnyis ni drag tu bsdam/ /yar gyi tshigs pa bdun pa ru/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i lag ngar gyis/ /lan bdun bar du mdun du dbul/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang bya ste/ /mdun du rab tu stobs 48—168

dzo /'chi med kyi dngos gaji bachu bdun gyi rjam gzhag bzugs so//①༄4/ /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi dang po'i rnam gzhag ni/ /bum pa can la bslab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag g.yon gyen la bsgreng bya ste/ /khu tshur dag ni bcang byas nas/ /lag g.yas stobs bskyed thal mo yis/ /g.yon pa'i phrag gdong dag la ni/ /lan bdun bar du mnan byas shing / /g.yas pa la yang de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis rgyab tu bsnol byas pas/ /rbe sha gnyis ni drag tu bsdam/ /yar gyi tshigs pa bdun pa ru/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i lag ngar gyis/ /lan bdun bar du mdun du dbul/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang bya ste/ /mdun du rab tu stobs 48—168

babyed nas/ /lan bdun brkyang la sprug par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /rkang g.yon stobs bskyed dzo ni la/ /zhabs kyi rtsa bas drag tu bsdam/ /lus sprug 'og rlung then byas nas/ /ro stod dag tu dgang bar bya/ /rkang g.yon mgul pa'i sa mtshams nas/ /mtho do sor bzhi gzhal ba yi/ /sa mtshams nges par brtag bya ste/ /rkang g.yas drag tu brkyang byas nas/ /zhabs kyi rtse mo bsdam byas te/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed then byas nas/ /stan la legs par 'dug byas nas/ /srog 'dzin drag por 'then bya ste/ /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /lus kyi khyad par dngas ma rnams/ /sgo dgu dag kyang dgag par bya/ /rlung rgod drag por gcun ②bya ste/ /dmigs pa gsal zhing brtan pa yis②/ /stobs dang stobs nyid bskyed byas nas/ /srog 'dzin nyid la mnyam par bya/ /rtsol ba'i gnas ni drang byas nas/ /zla ba nyid la blta bya ste/ /de nyid mnyam pa'i sbyor ba yis//rlung gi rtog pa rab tu zhi/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /rkang g.yas drag tu brkyang byas pa②/ /sor bzhi nang du bsnur byas te/ /zhabs kyi rtse mo bsdam byas pas/ /lus po 'phyar ④zhing bdeg par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis bsnol zhing rbe sha bsdams/ /gyen la bzlog cing brdeg par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyid krung bca'/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i rbe sha bsdam/ /gyen la bdeg pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /yan lag dang po gzhug bya zhing / /spyi gtsug phyar zhing bdeg par bya/ /'di keng pa'ind r+ṣa gan rkyal dag tu brnyes byas shing / /lag gnyis sa la btsugs byas pas/ /lus po nam mkhar lding byas la//48nga 169

babyed nas/ /lan bdun brkyang la sprug par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /rkang g.yon stobs babyed dzo rgo la/ /zhabs kyi rtsa bas drag tu bsdam/ /lus sprug 'og rlung then byas nas/ /ro stod dag tu dgang bar bya/ /rkang g.yon mgul pa'i sa mtshalas nas/ /mtho do sor bzhi gzhal ba yi/ /sa mtshalas nges par brtag bya ste/ /rkang g.yas drag tu brkyang byas nas/ /zhabs kyi rtse mo bsdam byas te/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed then byas nas/ /stan la legs par 'dug byas nas/ /srog 'dzin drag por 'then bya ste/ /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /lus kyi khyad par dngas ma rnams/ /sgo dgu dag kyang dgag par bya/ /rlung rgod drag por gcun ①bya ste/ /dmigs pa gsal zhing brtan pa yisakhru/ /stobs dang stobs nyid bskyed byas nas/ /srog 'dzin nyid la mnyam par bya/ /rtsol ba'i gnas ni drang byas nas/ /zla ba nyid la blta bya ste/ /de nyid mnyam pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rlung gi rtog pa rab tu zhi/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /rkang g.yas drag tu brkyang byas pa①/ /sor bzhi nang du bsnur byas te/ /zhabs kyi rtse mo bsdam byas pas/ /lus po 'phyar ⑦zhing brdeg par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis bsnol zhing rbe sha bsdams/ /gyen la bzlog cing brdeg par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i byas krung bca'/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i rbe sha bsdam/ /gyen la bdeg pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /yan lag dang po gzhug bya zhing / /spyi gtsug phyar zhing brdeg par bya/ /'dis rkang pa'i nad r+ṣa gan rkyal dag tu brnyes byas shing / /lag gnyis sa la btsugs byas pas/ /lus po nam mkhar lding byas la//48—169

rkang g.yas mdun du lan bdun sprug /g.yon pa yang ni de bzhin no/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas te/ /lag mthil gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis/ /stobs rnams babyed cing mkha' la brtan/ /'phul ba'i tshul gyis ldang bar bya/ /dngos gzhi dang po'o// // ༄ga /①dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi gnyis pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /bum pa can la bslab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad ma'i mazhu ba 'khru ba thang chad pa sel :ngo krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas te/ /stobs rnams babyed cing phyir la brkyang //nang du dgug cing phyir la bstan/ /snying ga dag tu gnas bya ste/ /lan bdun bar du de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung cung zad then bya ste/ /'jam rlung dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /lag g.yas stobs bskyed khu tshung bcang / /tshigs gsum bskor zhing lan bdun sprug /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i bya krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lto ba bskyod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas te/ /stobs bskyed phyir la brkyang byas nas/ /klum po'i dbyibs kyi rnam gzhag gis/ /lan bdun bar du bskor bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnam gzhag ni/ /zhabs ni pad ma'i skyil krung bca'—/ /lag gnyis rbe sha bsdam bya ste/ /gru mo gnyis kyis spyi zur mnan/ /48—170

rkang g.yas mdun du lan bdun sprug /g.yon pa yang ni de bzhin no/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas te/ /lag mthil gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing mkha' la brtan/ /'phul ba'i tshul gyis ldang bar bya/ /dngos gzhi dang po'o// // sha /①dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi gnyis pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /bum pa can la bslab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad ma'i mnu ba dka ba thang chad pa chel skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrid pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas te/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing phyir la brkyang //nang du dgug cing phyir la bstan/ /snying ga dag tu gnas bya ste/ /lan bdun bar du de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung cung zad then bya ste/ /'jam rlung dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /lag g.yas stobs bskyed khu tshur bcang / /tshigs gsum bskor zhing lan bdun sprug /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /sto ba bskyod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas te/ /stobs bskyed phyir la brkyang byas nas/ /klum po'i dbyibs kyi rnam gzhag gis/ /lan bdun bar du bskor bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnam gzhag ni/ /zhabs ni pad ma'i skyil krung bca'| /lag gnyis tre sha bsdam bya ste/ /gru mo gnyis kyis spyi zur mnan/ /48—170

lag ngar gnyis ni bsnol ba yis/ /zhabs gnyis rtsa ba mnan byas pas/ /sgal tshigs mgrin pa dgug byas nas/ /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas pas/ /sprul pa dag tu bgyil bya ste/ /gsigs⑪pa'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas te/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing sa la gzugs/ /skyil krung pus mo g.yas bcuka ste/ /stobs bskyed sor bcu mnan byas nas/ /nu mjing stod kyi sbyor ba yis/ /g.yas g.yon dag tu gcus byas shing / /drag po'i tshul gyis bsdams byas te/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug/lag gnyis stobs bskyed khu tshur bcang / /rgyab tu bkug pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sgal tshigs dang po'i sa mtshams su/ /re mos dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /bcu bzhi'i bar du bdeg byas shing / /sgrog pa dag kyang rab gdon no/ /mar gyi tshigs pa brtan byas shing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /rkang gnyis dag dang lag kanyis ni/ /nam mkha' dag la gdeng byas te/ /lan bdun bar du sprug par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi gnyis ‘1'o// spru //ga /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi gsum pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /gang ba can la bslab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /rkang g.yon stobs bskyed dzo ni la/ /zhabs kyi rtsa bas drag tu bsdams/ /rkang g.yas drag tu 48—171

lag ngar gnyis ni bsnol ba yis/ /zhabs gnyis rtsa ba mnan byas pas/ /sgal tshigs mgrin pa dgug byas nas/ /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas pas/ /sprul pa dag tu bsgyil bya ste/ /gsigs ①pa'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas te/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing sa la gzugs/ /skyil krung pus mo g.yas bcug ste/ /stobs bskyed sor bcu mnan byas nas/ /nu mjing stod kyi sbyor ba yis/ /g.yas g.yon dag tu gcus byas shing / /drag po'i tshul gyis bsdams byas te/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i khrul krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug/lag gnyis stobs bskyed khu tshur bcang / /rgyab tu bkug pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sgal tshigs dang po'i sa mtshalas su/ /re mos dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /bcu bzhi'i bar du brdeg byas shing / /gregs pa dag kyang rab gdon no/ /mar gyi tshigs pa brtan byas shing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /rkang gnyis dag dang lag gnyis ni/ /nam mkha' dag la gdeng byas te/ /lan bdun bar du sprug par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi gnyis ‘/'o// sbi //ga /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi gsum pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /gang ba can la basbab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /rkang g.yon stobs bskyed dzo ni la/ /zhabs kyi rtsa bas drag tu bsdams/ /rkang g.yas drag tu 48—171

brkyang bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis bsnol zhing rbe sha bsdam/ /gyen la rab tu phyar bya ste/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing stod du brkyang / /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yon gyen la bsgreng byas te/ /stobs rnams bskyed la khu tshur bcang / /lag g.yas stobs bskyed thal mo yis/ /lag g.yon mgul pa bcang byas te/ /lan bdun bar du bsdam bya zhing / /g.yas pa la yang de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i stobatsazamago bo'i nad sel skyid krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /ltag tshigs cung zhig dgye ba la/ /dal ba'i tshul gyis bsdam byas pas/ /dbugs rab bdun du gnas par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /pad ma'i skyil krung mtshams dag nas/ /mtho gang sor brgyad gzhal bya ste/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas nas/ /phyir la bzlog cing brkyang bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung drag por then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas pas/ /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed bya ste/ /dgang ba'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang zhing mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis bsnol zhing bskris byas nas—/ /sor bcu bsnol zhing bsdam byas pas/ /brang khog dag gi sbyor ba la//'og rlung then zhing mnan byas nas/ /lan bdun bar du brdog par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i sprul krung bca'/ /lag gnyis gyen la bsgrong bya ste/ /khu tshur dag ni bcang byas nas/ /'og rlung then zhing tshigs rnams ni/ /lan 48—172

brkyang bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis bsdol zhing rbe sha bsdam/ /gyen la rab tu phyar bya ste/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing stod du brkyang / /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yon gyen la bgreng byas te/ /stobs rnams babyed la khu tshur bcang / /lag g.yas stobs bskyed thal mo yis/ /lag g.yon mgul pa bcang byas te/ /lan bdun bar du bsdam bya zhing / /g.yas pa la yang de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i stobs che mgo bo'i nad sel spyi krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /ltag tshigs cung zhig dgye ba la/ /dal ba'i tshul gyis bsdam byas pas/ /dbugs rab bdun du gnas par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'| /pad ma'i skyil krung mtshams dag nas/ /mtho gang sor brgyad gzhal bya ste/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas nas/ /phyir la bzlog cing brkyang bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung drag por then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas pas/ /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed bya ste/ /dgang ba'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang zhing mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis bsgol zhing bakhrus byas nas—/ /sor bcu bsgol zhing bsdam byas pas/ /brang khog dag gi sbyor ba la//'og rlung then zhing mnan byas nas/ /lan bdun bar du brdeg par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis gyen la bgreng bya ste/ /khu tshur dag ni bcang byas nas/ /'og rlung then zhing tshigs rnams ni/ /lan 48—172

bdun bar du gseng bar bya/ /zhabs gnyis gshib⑥cing brtan byas nas/ /cog gu'i tshul gyis 'dug byas te/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed gyen la bsgrong / /khu tshur dag ni bcang byas nas/ /lus spyi stobs kyis brkyang byas te/ /lan bdun bar du ldang bar bya'o/ /dngos gzhi gsum pa'o// sbi //sha /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi bzhi pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /shing rta 'khor lo'i sbyor ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag gi bslab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs shing brtan byas nas/ /cog gu'i tshul byis 'dug byas te/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed sa la gzugs/ /sor bcu'i rtse mo sprad byas nas/ /lus spyi mkha' la lding bya ste/ /mdun rgyab gnyis kyi sbyor ba yi| /lan bdun bar du 'chong bar bya/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas te/ /lagakuganyis sa la btsugs byas nas/ /sor bcu bsnol ba'i steng dag tu/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs la brtan byas nas/ /cog gu'i tshul gyis 'dug bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /brang khog dag gi sbyor ba yis—/ /g.yas g.yon rab tu bsrang bya ste/ /gzhungs pa lan bdun bsrang bar bya| /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /mar gyi tshigs pa dgu pa ru/ /lag g.yas rgyab tu bskyis byas nas/ /lag g.yon rbe sha bsdams byas te/ /g.yon pa khu tshur bcang byas pas/ /pho ba dag la sbyar byas te/ /sgal tshigs mgrin pa dgug bya zhing / /stobs rnams bskyed cing bsdam byas te②/ /g.yas pa la yang de bzhin no/ /48nga 173

bdun bar du gseng bar bya/ /zhabs gnyis gshib ①cing brtan byas nas/ /cog gu'i tshul gyis 'dug byas te/ /lag gnyis stobs babyed gyen la bgreng / /khu tshur dag ni bcang byas nas/ /lus spyi stobs kyis brkyang byas te/ /lan bdun bar du ldang bar bya'o/ /dngos gzhi gsum pa'o// spri //ga /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi bzhi pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /shing rta 'khor lo'i sbyor ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag gi bslab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs shing brtan byas nas/ /cog gu'i tshul rmis 'dug byas te/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed sa la gzugs/ /sor bcu'i rtse mo sprad byas nas/ /lus spyi mkha' la lding bya ste/ /mdun rgyab gnyis kyi sbyor ba yi—/ /lan bdun bar du 'chong bar bya/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan byas te/ /lag ②gnyis sa la btsugs byas nas/ /sor bcu bsnol ba'i steng dag tu/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs la brtan byas nas/ /cog gu'i tshul gyes 'dug bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /brang khog dag gi sbyor ba yis—/ /g.yas g.yon rab tu bsrang bya ste/ /gzhungs pa lan bdun bsrang bar bya—/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i byas krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /mar rmi tshigs pa dgu pa ru/ /lag g.yas rgyab tu ba—sa byas nas/ /lag g.yon rbe sha bsdams byas te/ /g.yon pa khu tshul bcang byas pas/ /pho ba dag la sbyar byas te/ /sgal tshigs mgrin pa dgug bya zhing / /stobs rnams bskyed cing bsdam byas tesne/ /g.yas pa la yang de bzhin no/ /48—173

gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i stobs ldan gyi/ /brang pa sa la btsugs bya ste/ /zhabs gnyis rtsa ba bteg byas nas/ /dang po byin gnyis brla la sbyar/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i thal mo yis /mchan gnyis dag nas bsdams byas shing / /tshigs pa bsrang zhing mgrin pa dgug/'og rlung drag por then bya ste/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed bya ste/ /stod smad dag tu bsdams byas shing / /sku smad dag la ljag bskur nas/ /'greng ba'i tshul gyis ldang bar bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan byas te/ /rkang g.yon cog gur 'dug bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang zhing mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas nas/ /stobs bskyed phyir bzlog brkyang ba la/ /rkang g.yas drag tu brkyang byas shing / /sor bcu'i rgyab gtad phul byas te/ /rkang g.yon dag kyang de bzhin no/ /mar rmi tshigs pa gsum pa la/ /lus kyi lngid ni bskur byas te/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /phyir la bzlog pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rkang gnyis brla sha bsdams byas pas/ /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /stobs rnams bskyed pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun bar du sprug par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyi krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis stobs bskyed khu tshur bcang / /phyir la brkyang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun bar du sprug par bya/ /nang du bkug pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dpung mgo gnyis la brdeg par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi bzhi pa'o// sbi //48—174

gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i stobs ldan gyi/ /brang pa sa la btsugs bya ste/ /zhabs gnyis rtsa ba bteg byas nas/ /dang po byin gnyis brla la sbyar/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i thal mo yis/ /mchan gnyis dag nas bsdams byas shing / /tshigs pa bsrang zhing mgrin pa dgug/'og rlung drag por then bya ste/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed bya ste/ /stod smad dag tu bsdams byas shing / /sku smad dag la ljag bskur nas/ /'greng ba'i tshul gyis ldang bar bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas te/ /rkang g.yon cog gur 'dug bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang zhing mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas nas/ /stobs bskyed phyir bzlog brkyang ba la/ /rkang g.yas drag tu brkyang byas shing / /sor bcu'i rgyab gtad phul byas te/ /rkang g.yon dag kyang de bzhin no/ /mar gyi tshigs pa gsum pa la/ /lus kyi ljid ni bskur byas te/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsgom byas pas/ /pyir la bzlog pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rkang gnyis brla sha bsdams byas pas/ /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /stobs rnams bskyed pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun bar du sprug par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i sprul krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis stobs bskyed khu tshur bcang / /phyir la brkyang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun bar du sprug par bya/ /nang du bkug pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dpung mgo gnyis la bdeg par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi bzhi pa'o// spru //48—174

༄na /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi lnga pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /bum pa can la bslab par bya/ /sngon 'go dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis 'dis yang nad thams cad r+ṣa lo pad ma'i byas krung bca'/ /skyil krung rgyu zhabs bar dag tu/ /lag gnyis stobs babyed gzhug bya ste/ /khu tshur rab tu bcang byas te/ /sa la btsugs shing bstan ①byas pas/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /brang khog dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /g.yas g.yon rab tu 'greng bya ste/ /lan bdun bar du sprug par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'itsāgamigasko ba r+ṣa byas krung bca'—/ /lag gnyis rgyab tu bsnol byas nas/ /rbe sha rab tu bsdam bya ste/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas nas/ /pad ma gyen du babe+eng bya ste/ /yar gyi tshigs pa bdun pa ni/ /lag ngar gnyis la ljid bskur nas/ /sa la brtan por gzugs byas te/ /stod smad gnyis ni stobs bskyed nas/ /gyen la lan bdun dgug par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil grung bca'//stan la legs par 'dug bya ste/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed lag mthil gyis/ /brla sgang gnyis la brdeg bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /drag po'i las la sbyor ba'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas nas/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /gyen la rab tu greng ①byas te/ /yar gyi tshigs pa dang po la/ /ljid rnams rab tu bskur bya ste/ /lag gnyis stobs 48—175

ga /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi lnga pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /dum pa can la bablab par bya/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis 'dis lang nad thams cad r+ṣa lo pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /skyil krung rgyu zhabs bar dag tu/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed gzhug bya ste/ /khu tshur rab tu bcang byas te/ /sa la btsugs shing bstan⑥byas pas/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /brang khog dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /g.yas g.yon rab tu 'greng bya ste/ /lan bdun bar du sprug par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'itsāg migs ba sa skyil/ krung bca'1 /lag gnyis rgyab tu bsnol byas nas/ /rbe sha rab tu bsdam bya ste/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas nas/ /pad ma gyen du bsgang bya ste/ /yar gyi tshigs pa bdun pa ni/ /lag ngar gnyis la ldid bskur nas/ /sa la brtan por gzugs byas te/ /stod smad gnyis ni stobs bskyed nas/ /gyen la lan bdun dgug bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'//stan la legs par 'dug bya ste/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed lag mthil gyis/ /brla sgang gnyis la brdeg bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /drag po'i las la sbyor ba'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas nas/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /gyen la rab tu sgrongayibyas te/ /yar gyi tshigs pa dang po la/ /lngid rnams rab tu bskur bya ste/ /lag gnyis stobs 48nga 176

bskyed stod du brkyang / /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed par bya/ /lag g.yas sa la btsugs bya ste/ /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed byas pas/ /lus spyi ②mkha' la lding byas te/ /rdza mkhan dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor bya ste/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /dngos gzhi lnga pa'o// sbi //sha /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi drug pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /mgo thur dbyug pa'i sbyor ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag gis bsgab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad ma'i po'i ka ba sel bad kun sel sprul krung bca'/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed thal mo yis/ /brla sha gnyis ni mnan byas nas/ /sgal tshikas bsrang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /gsang gnas gyen la drang bya ste/ /mgrin pa dra dmig sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun gyen la bsgrong bar bya/ /stobs rnams rab tu babyed bya ste/ /rkang g.yas drod tsheb dang yo nad r+ṣa0sa la btsugs⑫byas nas/ /rkang g.yon bsgris pa'i mthil dag gis/ /g.yas pa'i bol gong mnan bya zhing //lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas nas/ /rkang g.yon pus gong mtshams dag tu/ /drag po'i tshul gyis mnan bya zhing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /brtan pa'i tshul gyis mnan byas te/ /g.yon pa la yang de bzhin no1 /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i mgul pa ru//dha'u ris rab tu dbrel byas nas/ /nam mkhar rab tu gdags byas shing / /mtho gang mtshams su lding byas pas/ /thabs dang mthun pa'i dbyug pa ni/ /48—176

bskyed stod du brkyang / /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed par bya/ /lag g.yas sa la btsugs bya ste/ /stobs rnams rab tu babyed byas pas/ /lus spyi ①mkha' la lding byas te/ /rdza mkhan dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor bya ste/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /dngos gzhi lnga pa'o// spri //༄ /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi drug pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /mgo thur dbyug pa'i sbyor ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag gis bslab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad ma'i ṣ+pe'i sba ba sel bad gon sel :ngo krung bca'/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed thal mo yis/ /brla sha gnyis ni mnan byas nas/ /sgal tshigs bsrang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /gsang gnas gyen la drang bya ste/ /mgrin pa dra dmig sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun gyen la bgreng bar bya/ /stobs rnams rab tu babyed bya ste/ /rkang g.yas drod che ba dang ⑫ nad r+ṣakhyas la btsugs ①byas nas/ /rkang g.yon bsgris pa'i mthil dag gis/ /g.yas pa'i bol gong mnan bya zhing //lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas nas/ /rkang g.yon pus gong mtshalas dag tu/ /drag po'i tshul gyis mnan bya zhing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /brtan pa'i tshul gyis mnan byas te/ /g.yon pa la yang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i mgul pa ru//dha'u ris rab tu dbyel byas nas/ /nam mkhar rab tu gdags byas shing / /mtho gang mtshalas su lding byas pas/ /thabs dang mthun pa'i dbyug pa ni/ /48—176

khru gang sor bzhi'i tshad ldan pa/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed bzung byas nas/ /'og rlung drag por then bya ste/ /steng rlung drag por mnan bya zhing / /lus spyi rab tu dgang bya ste/ /sgal tshigs mgrin pa dgug byas pas/ /'greng ba'i tshul gyis ldang bar bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan byas nas//zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /mdun du rab tu brkyang bya ste/ /mthe bong gnyis kyi mdud byas pas/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /stobs babyed mdun du brkyang bar bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed thal mo ni/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis su btsugs bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /khong pa rab tu bskor bar bya'o/ /dngos gzhi drug pa'o// spri //༄/ /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi bdun pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /rtsa stong 'khyil pa'i sbyor ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag gi bslab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i byas krung bca'/ /lag gnyis rbe sha bsdam byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang ba'i sbyor ba la/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i lag ngar gyis/ /ltag zur dag ni mnan bya ste/ /dang po g.yas phyogs sbyor ba las/ /rim gyis lan bdun bskor bya zhing / /g.yon pa la yang de bzhin no—/ /zhabs gnyis ngar gdong sa la gzugs phoba'akhrol ba sel/ /gsang sgo dag gi mtshalas dag tu/ /zhabs gnyis rtsa bas bsdam byas te/ /lag gnyis 48—177

bsnol ba'i thal mo yis/ /mchad khung rab tu bsdam bya zhing / /lag ngar gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /brla sgang gnyis ni mnan bya zhing / /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed byas nas/ /yan lag lnga po dgug par bya/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed thal mo dang / /spyi bo sa la btsugs bya ste/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha' dag la 'greng bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /rtsa bshal btang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed sor bcu dang / /rkang gnyis sor bcu bsnol ba yis/ /drag por bsdam zhing mnan byas nas/ /'og rlung drag por then bya ste/ /steng rlung drag por mnan bya zhing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lus kyi stobs rnams bskyed bya ste/ /g.yob pa'i tshul gyis 'bad par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas mdun du brkyang bya ste/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing khu tshur bcang / /khrig 'gul dag gi 'khor lo ni/ /nyi shu dag tu bskor bya zhing / /stobs rnams bskyed cing sprug bya ste/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol bya zhing / /stobs bskyed gyen la bsgrong bya ste/ /rtsa rnams snyoms pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sku stod dag ni bskor bar bya/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan0bya zhing / /lag gnyis rbe sha bsdam pa yi/ /lag ngar gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /pho ba dag ni mnan bya zhing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /zhabs 48—178

gnyis stobs bskyed phul bar bya'o/ /dngos gzhi bdun pa'o// spri //dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi brgyad pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /bum pa can la basbab bya ba/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan bya ste/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed thal mo ni/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis su sa la btsugs| /rkang gnyis stobs bskyed rting pa ni/ /re mos dag gi sbyor ba yis| /brla sha gnyis la brdeg par bya/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan bya ste/ /sgal tshigs mgrin pa dgug bya zhing / /rkang g.yas drag tu brkyang bya ste—/ /rkang g.yon bskum pa'i bol gong gis/ /g.yas pa'i brla sgang mnan bya ste/ /lag gnyis stobs babyed brkyang byas nas/ /rkang g.yas 'og tu bcug byas shing / /sor bcu rab tu bsnol bya ste/ /phyir bzlog stobs rnams bskyed par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /pus mo sa la btsugs bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yon mdun du mnyam bzhag nas/ /g.yas pa stobs babyed khu tshur bca'/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar g.yob byed cing / /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'—/ /pus mo sa la btsugs bya ste/ /lag gnyis rbe sha bsdam byas nas/ /zhabs gnyis mgul pa'i thad so nas/ /mtho gang gcal ba'i sa mtshalas su/ /gru mo gnyis ni btsugs bya ste/ /'og rlung drag por then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag por mnan bya zhing / /sgal tshigs mgrin pa dgug bya ste/ /stobs 48—179

bskyed drag por mnan par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis ngar gdong sa la btsugs/ /gsang sgo dag gi mtshams dag tu/ /zhabs gnyis rtsa bas drag tu bsdam/ /lag gnyis stobs babyed sa la btsugs/ /sor bcu bsnol ba'i mtshams dag tu/ /ngar gdong dag gis mnan bya zhing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /g.yas g.yon gnyis dang thad ka ru/ /lan bdun bar du bsrang bar bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag g.yon stobs bskyed sa la gzugs—/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas khu tshur bcang bya ste/ /k+kad la bskor ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun bar du sprug bya zhing / /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /mar gyi tshigs pa brtan bya zhing / /zhabs gnyis gshibs pas mdun du brkyang / /lag gnyis gyen la bsgrong bya ste//lag g.yas stobs babyed chang pa yis/ /lag g.yon sor mo bsdam bya ste/ /khong pa dag gi sbyor ba yi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor bya ste/ /g.yas pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas la/ /mthe bong lug rgyud bsnol byas pa'i/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pas bskyang bya ste/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed stod du brkyang / /khu tshur rab tu bcang bya ste/ /lan bdun bar du ldang bar bya'o/ /dngos gzhi brgyad pa'o// sbi gsang //sha /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi dgu pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /mgo thur dbyug pa'i sbyor ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag gi bablab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim 48—180

babyed drag por mnan par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis ngar gdong sa la btsugs/ /gsang sgo dag gi mtshams dag tu/ /zhabs gnyis rtsa bas drag tu bsdam/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed sa la btsugs/ /sor bcu bsnol ba'i mtshams dag tu/ /ngar gdong dag gis mnan bya zhing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /g.yas g.yon gnyis dang thad ka ru/ /lan bdun bar du bsrang bar bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i byas krung bca'/ /lag g.yon stobs bskyed sa la gzugs—/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas khu tshur bcang bya ste/ /klad la bskor ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun bar du sprug bya zhing / /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /mar gyi tshigs pa brtan bya zhing / /zhabs gnyis gshibs pas mdun du brkyang / /lag gnyis gyen la bgreng bya ste//lag g.yas stobs bskyed chang pa yis/ /lag g.yon sor mo bsdam bya ste/ /khong pa dag gi sbyor ba yi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor bya ste/ /g.yas pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas la/ /mthe bong lug rgyud bsnol byas pa'i/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pas bskyang bya ste/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed stod du brkyang / /khu tshur rab tu bcang bya ste/ /lan bdun bar du ldang bar bya'o/ /dngos gzhi brgyad pa'o// sbi gsang //sto /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi dgu pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /mgo thur dbyug pa'i sbyor ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag gi bslab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim 48—180

pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i sprul krung bca' 'dis kyang nad thams cad chel/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /jig krung nang du gzhug byas te/ /stobs dmas bskyed cing sa la gzugs/ /lag pa dag la lngid bskur nas/ /sprul krung gyen la 'degs par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas bkug pa'i thal mo yis /g.yas pa'i dpung pa bzung bya zhing / /stobs bskyed lan bdun bskor bar bya//g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal bya zhing / /yar gyi tshigs pa gsum pa la/ /lus kyi ldid rnams bskur bya ste/ /lag gnyis gyen la brkyang byas pas/ /rkang gnyis gyen la bkug pa yi/ /mthe bong gnyis nas bzung bya zhingaka /stobs rnams bskyed cing brkyang bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'| /sprul krung zhabs gnyis mgul pa ru/ /dha'u ris rab tu sbrel byas nas—/ /nam mkhar ⑫rab tu btags byas nas/ /mtho gang mtshams su lding bya zhing / /thabs dang mthun pa'i dbyug pa ni/ /khru gang sor bzhi tshad ldan pa| /lag gnyis stobs bskyed bzung byas nas/ /'og rlung drag por then bya zhing / /steng rlung drag por mnan byas pas/ /sgal tshigs mgrin pa dgug byas la/ /'greng ba'i tshul gyis ldang bar bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan bya ste/ /rkang g.yas bkug pa'i mgul pa ni/ /mjing pa dag la rgal bya ste/ /rkang g.yon stobs bskyed langs bya zhing / /thugs kar thal mo sbyar byas te/ /g.yon pa yang ni de bzhin no/ /tshad dang ldan pa'i dbyug pa ni/ /ldang zhing 48—181

pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i :kha krung bca' 'dis kyang nad thams cad sel /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /skyil grung nang du gzhug byas te/ /stobs rnams babyed cing sa la gzugs/ /lag pa dag la ljid bskur nas/ /spyil krung gyen la 'degs par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i bya krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas bkug pa'i thal mo yis /g.yas pa'i dpung pa bzung bya zhing / /stobs bskyed lan bdun bskor bar bya/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal bya zhing / /yar gyi tshigs pa gsum pa la/ /lus kyi ljid rnams bskur bya ste/ /lag gnyis gyen la brkyang byas pas/ /rkang gnyis gyen la bkug pa yi/ /mthe bong gnyis nas bzung bya zhing / /stobs rnams bskyed cing brkyang bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'—/ /khrul krung zhabs gnyis mgul pa ru/ /dha'u ris rab tu dz+rel byas nas—/ /nam mkhar ①rab tu btags byas nas/ /mtho gang mtshams su lding bya zhing / /thabs dang mthun pa'i dbyug pa ni/ /khru gang sor bzhi tshad ldan pa—/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed bzung byas nas/ /'og rlung drag por then bya zhing / /steng rlung drag por mnan byas pas/ /sgal tshigs mgrin pa dgug byas la/ /'greng ba'i tshul gyis ldang bar bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan bya ste/ /rkang g.yas bkug pa'i mgul pa ni/ /mjing pa dag la rgal bya ste/ /rkang g.yon stobs bskyed langs bya zhing / /thugs kar thal mo sbyar byas te/ /g.yon pa yang ni de bzhin no/ /tshad dang ldan pa'i dbyug pa ni/ /ldang zhing 48—181

tshul gyis nam mkha' la/ /brtan par rab tu gzugs bya ste/ /pho ba dag ni rgal bya zhing / /rkang pa gnyis dang lag pa gnyis/ /mtho gang sa mtshams nam mkha' la/ /stobs bskyed rab tu ldeng bar bya/ /rkang gnyis gshibs la bsgrong bya ste/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed khu tshur bcang / /byi dmigs gnyis la brdeg bya ste/ /de rjes lag gnyis khu tshur ni/ /re mos mdun du g.yug bya zhing / /gyen la rab tu brgyug par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi dgu pa'o// sbi //sha /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi bcu pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /gang ba can la bslab bya ba/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i sprul krung bca'/ /lag gnyis rgyab tu thal mo sbyar/ /tshigs pa bdun pa mnan bya ste1 /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /stobs rnams rab tu babyed byas nas/ /bstan pa'i tshul gyis gnas par bya1 /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan bya ste/ /rkang gnyis bkug pa'i mgul pa ni/ /mjing pa dag la rgal bya zhing / /lag gnyis sa la btsugs byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu lding bar bya/ /rkang g.yon rteng pas gsang sgo mnan/ /rkang g.yas bskum pa'i bol gong gis/ /g.yon pa'i brla sgang mnan bya zhing / /lag g.yon sa la btsugs byas nas/ /rkang g.yas mtheb mo brten byas pas/ /lag g.yas khu tshur gyen la brkyang / /lan bdun bar du bskor bya ste/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung 48—182

gnyis sor bcu bsnol bya ste/ /phyir bzlog gru mo bteg byas nas/ /dag tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed bya zhing / /srong ba'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed khu tshur bcang / /ri rab phul ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed byas pas/ /brang khog dag kyang bsrang bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'| /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /spyi krung 'og tu gzhug bya ste/ /stobs bskyed skyil krung gis mnan zhing / /'og rlung drag por then bya ste/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas pas/ /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan| /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed bya zhing / /bum pa gang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /kha chod rab tu brtan par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /stobs bskyed rab tu langs bya zhing / /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /phyir bzlog thur la brkyang bya zhing / /zhabs g.yas bcug pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun bar du 'gong bya ste/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas nas/ /pad+ma'i sprul krung bcas byas la/ /pad+ma gyen la bslang bya ste/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed khu tshur bcang / /mgrin pa rab tu dgug byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu ldang bar bya'o/ /dngos gzhi bcu gcig pa'o// spru //ga /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi bcu gnyis rnam gzhag ni/ /re dza ka'i sbyor ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag gis bslab 48—184

bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /rkang gnyis bsnol ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bol gong sa la btsugs bya ste/ /rteng pa gnyis ni stobs bskyed nas/ /tsos po gnyis ni bsdam byas pas/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol bya zhing / /phyir bzlog sa la btsugs byas nas/ /ngar gdong gnyis kyi mnan bya ste/ /stobs bskyed rab tu 'greng bar bya/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan bya zhing / /rkang gnyis bsnol ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /rkang g.yas g.yon du brkyang bya zhing / /rkang g.yon g.yas su brkyang byas pas/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed thal mo yis/ /rkang gnyis sor mo bsdam bya ste/ /khong pa dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /rim gyis g.yas su gcus byas te/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas pas/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa brkyang bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang bya ste/ /rbe sha 'phul ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /pho ba dag ni bsdam par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang bya ste/ /stobs skye sa la gzugs bya zhing / /'greng ba'i tshul gyis bsigs ⑫par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis bsnol bas mchan 'og bsdam/ /'og rlung drag por then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag por mnan bya zhing / /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /thad kar bdeg cing bsnun pa dang / /g.yas g.yon bsnun zhing bdeg byas pas/ /mgrin pa bskor ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /mgrin pa bdeg cing brdzun pa dang / /mgrin pa g.yas g.yon de bzhin no/ /48—186

bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /rkang gnyis bsnol ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bol gong sa la btsugs bya ste/ /rting pa gnyis ni stobs bskyed nas/ /tsos po gnyis ni bsdam byas pas/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol bya zhing / /phyir bzlog sa la btsugs byas nas/ /ngar gdong gnyis kyi mnan bya ste/ /stobs bskyed rab tu 'greng bar bya/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan bya zhing / /rkang gnyis bsnol ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /rkang g.yas g.yon du brkyang bya zhing / /rkang g.yon g.yas su brkyang byas pas/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed thal mo yis/ /rkang gnyis sor mo bsdam bya ste/ /khong pa dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /rim gyis g.yas su gcus byas te/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan byas pas/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa brkyang bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang bya ste/ /rbe sha 'phul ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /pho ba dag ni bsdam par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i byas krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang bya ste/ /stobs skye sa la gzugs bya zhing / /'greng ba'i tshul gyis bsigs ①par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i byas krung bca'—/ /lag gnyis bsnol bas mchan 'og bsdam/ /'og rlung drag por then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag por mnan bya zhing / /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /thad kar brdeg cing bsnun pa dang / /g.yas g.yon bsnun zhing brdeg byas pas/ /mgrin pa bskor ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /mgrin pa brdeg cing bsnun pa dang / /mgrin pa g.yas g.yon de bzhin no/ /48—185

gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sa la brtan por gzugs bya ste/ /rkang gnyis sor bcu'i rtse mo ni/ /lag mthil gnyis la gtad bya zhing / /stobs bskyed rab tu bsdam byas pas/ /srong ba'i tshul gyis ldang bar bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis stobs bskyed khu tshur ni/ /g.yas g.yon dag tu sa la gzugs/ /sprul krung gyen la bteg bya zhing / /nam mkhar rab tu lding bar bya/ /rkang pa gnyis ni gshibs bya ste/ /brang pa sa la gzugs bya zhing / /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas pas/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing sa la gzugs/ /rteng pa gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /tsos po gnyis ni bsdam byas pas/ /pus mo phyir la brkyang bya zhing / /stod rnams gseng zhing bsgom par bya/ /rkang g.yas stobs bskyed sa la gzugs/ /rkang g.yon gyen la balhab bya ste/ /lag g.yon thur la brkyang byas nas/ /rkang g.yon mgul pa then bya ste/ /lag g.yas khu tshur bcang byas pas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bskor bya zhing / /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sa la brtan por gzugs bya ste/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas pas/ /'greng ba'i tshul gyis ldang byas nas/ /ri rab 'phul ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun bar du sprugs par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi bcu gnyis pa'o// spru //go /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi bcu gsum rnam gzhag ni/ /rtsa dgu bcings pa'i sbyor ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag 48—186

gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sa la brtan por gzugs bya ste/ /rkang gnyis sor bcu'i rtse mo ni/ /lag mthil gnyis la gtad bya zhing / /stobs babyed rab tu bsdam byas pas/ /srong ba'i tshul gyis ldang bar bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis stobs babyed khu tshur ni/ /g.yas g.yon dag tu sa la gzugs/ /:kha krung gyen la bteg bya zhing / /nam mkhar rab tu lding bar bya/ /rkang pa gnyis ni gshibs bya ste/ /brang pa sa la gzugs bya zhing / /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas pas/ /stobs rnams babyed cing sa la gzugs/ /rting pa gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /tsos po gnyis ni bsdam byas pas/ /pus mo phyir la brkyang bya zhing / /stod rnams gseng zhing bsgom par bya/ /rkang g.yas stobs babyed sa la gzugs/ /rkang g.yon gyen la bltab bya ste/ /lag g.yon thur la brkyang byas nas/ /rkang g.yon mgul pa then bya ste/ /lag g.yas khu tshur bcang byas pas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bskor bya zhing / /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sa la brtan por gzugs bya ste/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas pas/ /'greng ba'i tshul gyis ldang byas nas/ /ri rab 'phul ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun bar du sprugs par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi bcu gnyis pa'o// sbi //ga /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi bcu gsum rnam gzhag ni/ /rtsa dgu bcings pa'i sbyor ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag 48—186

gis bslab bya ba/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i spyi grung bca'/ /lag gnyis rgyab tu bsnol byas nas/ /rbe sha gnyis ni bsdam byas pas/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal bya ste/ /yar gyi tshigs pa gsum pa la/ /lus kyi ljid rnams bskur bya ste/ /khong pa dag ni bsrang byas nas/ /skyil krung nam mkhar phyar bar bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil/ krung bca'/ /pad ma gyen la bslang bya ste/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan bya zhing / /lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /snying ga rab tu mnan byas nas/ /lus rnams bkug cing bsgom par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /nad thams cad sel zhing khyad par du rkang nad sel zhabs gnyis pad ma'i khrul grung bca'/ /lag gnyis rgyab tu bsgol byas pas/ /rkang gnyis mtheb mo bzung bya ste/ /'og rlung drag por then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /srog shing dgu yi sbyor ba yis/ /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed byas nas/ /rim gyis lus bkug dpral ba ni/ /stan la lan gsum gtug par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan bya ste/ /rkang mgo gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha' dag la bteg byas shing / /lag gnyis stobs babyed gru mo yis/ /rkang gnyis byin pa brten byas nas/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /bol gong mgul bar bsdam pa ①bya/ /rkang gnyis gshibs te sa la gzugs/ /rkang sor gnyis kyi rtse mo nas/ /sor bzhi gzhal ba'i sa mtshalas su/ /lag gnyis khya tshur gshibs la gzugs/ /rkang gnyis long bu g.yas g.yon nasadze+e/ /khru re gcal ba'i sa mtshalas su/ /48—187

gis bablab bya ba/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil grung bca'/ /lag gnyis rgyab tu bsnol byas nas/ /rbe sha gnyis ni bsdam byas pas/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal bya ste/ /yar gyi tshigs pa gsum pa la/ /lus kyi ljid rnams bskur bya ste/ /khong pa dag ni bsrang byas nas/ /skyil krung nam mkhar phyar bar bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /pad ma gyen la bslang bya ste/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan bya zhing / /lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /snying ga rab tu mnan byas nas/ /lus rnams bkug cing bsgom par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /nad zams cad zhel zhing khyad par du rkang nad sel zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis rgyab tu bsgol byas pas/ /rkang gnyis mtheb mo bzung bya ste/ /'og rlung drag por then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /srog shing dgu yi sbyor ba yis/ /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed byas nas/ /rim gyis lus bkug dpra ba ni/ /stan la lan gsum gtug par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan bya ste/ /rkang mgo gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha' dag la bteka byas shing / /lag gnyis stobs bskyed gru mo yis/ /rkang gnyis byin pa brten byas nas/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /bol gong mgul bar bsdam pa⑥bya/ /rkang gnyis gshibs te sa la gzugs/ /rkang sor gnyis kyi rtse mo nas/ /sor bzhi gzhal ba'i sa mtshams su/ /lag gnyis khu tshur gshibs la gzugs/ /rkang gnyis long bu g.yas g.yon nas / /khru re gcal ba'i sa mtshams su/ /48—187

rkang gnyis stobs bskyed g.yas g.yon du/ /dgye dang sdud pa'i sbyor ba yis /lan bdun bar du mchong bar bya'o/ /dngos gzhi bcu gsum pa'o// spru //dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi bcu bzhi'i rnam gzhag ni/ /rgya mtsho'i ri rab sbyar ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag gis bslab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis sprul krung bcas byas la/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed sbyor ba yis /rkang gnyis sor bcu bsdam byas shing / /sgal tshigs rnams ni bsrang bya ste/ /mgrin pa dgug cing snying ga mnan/ /long bu gnyis la ldid bskur te/ /lus spyi ⑫stobs rnams rab bskyed de/ /mdun rgyab dag tu ling bar bya/ /kha matso②dang mgo nad thams cad r+ṣa zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan bya ste/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed thal mo yis/ /brla sgang gnyis ni mnan bya zhing / /khong pa dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /longs spyod 'khor lo bskor bar bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis tre sha bsdam bya ste/ /gyen la rab tu phyar ba yis/ /spyi gtsug dag ni mnan bya zhing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lus kyi stobs rnams bskyed par bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i ra nad dang lto ba'i nad thams cad ba skyid krung bca'/ /lag gnyis stobs bskyed thal mo yis/ /brla sgang gnyis ni mnan bya ste/ /rgya mtsho ri rab sbyar byas pas/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /'og rlung drag por then bya ste/ /steng rlung drag por mnan bya zhing / /stod du brgyang zhing bsdam byas pas/ /stobs 48—188

rnams rab tu bskyed bya ste/ /lus sprug bsigs ①pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan bya ste/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /phyir bzlog gyen la bsgrong byas nas/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /stobs bskyed lan bdun 'phra bar bya/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /tsug gu dag tu 'dug bya zhing / /lag g.yon khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /stobs bskyed mdun du brkyang bya ste/ /lag g.yas khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /yar gyi tshigs pa gsum pa ru/ /stobs bskyed rab tu mnan bya zhing / /g.yon ngos dag kyang de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'adang pa'i nad thams cad r+ṣa lo/ /sgal tshigs bsrad la mgrin pa dgug /lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /snying gar rab tu mnan bya ste/ /stobs bskyed khong pa bskor bar bya'o/ /dngos gzhi bcu bzhi pa'o// sbi //ga /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi bco lnga pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /gtum mo dag gi sbyor ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag gis basbab bya ba/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas khu tshur bcang bya ste/ /stobs bskyed gyen la brkyang byas nas/ /lag g.yon thal mo bshang bya zhing / /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca' bde bab skyond thams cad chog /lag g.yon khu tshur bcang bya ste/ /stobs bskyed g.yon du brkyang byas pas/ /48nga 189

rnams rab tu bskyed bya ste/ /lus sprug bsigs ①pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan bya ste/ /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas pas/ /phyir bzlog gyen la bgreng byas nas/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /stobs bskyed lan bdun 'phra bar bya/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /tsug gu dag tu 'dug bya zhing / /lag g.yon khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /stobs bskyed mdun du brkyang bya ste/ /lag g.yas khu tshur bcang byas nas/ /yar gyi tshigs pa gsum pa ru/ /stobs babyed rab tu mnan bya zhing / /g.yon ngos dag kyang de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i bya krung bca' khong pa'i nad thams cad sel lo/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /snying gar rab tu mnan bya ste/ /stobs bskyed khong pa bskor bar bya'o/ /dngos gzhi bcu bzhi pa'o// sbi //༄/ /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi bco lnga pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /gtum mo dag gi sbyor ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag gis bslab bya ba/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i byudzi krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas khu tshur bcang bya ste/ /stobs babyung gyen la brkyang byas nas/ /lag g.yon thal mo bshang bya zhing / /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i bya krung bca' bde bsal skyend thams cad sel/ /lag g.yon khu tshur bcang bya ste/ /stobs bskyed g.yon du brkyang byas pas/ /48—189

lag g.yas khu tshur bcang bya ste/ /gzhu 'gengs tshul gyis then byas nas/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan bya ste/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /snying ga dag ni mnan bya zhing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /rkang g.yon drag tu brkyang bya ste/ /rkang g.yas bskum pa'i long bu yis/ /rkang g.yon rtsa chen bshad bya zhing / /g.yas pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis rtsa bas gsang sgo bsdam//lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /u rgyan dag ni mnan bya ste/ /rin chen tshigs pa drang bar bya/ /mgrin pa dag kyang dgug bya zhing / /sgo lcags dag kyang gzhug par bya/ /steng rlung drag por mnan bya zhing / /'og rlung cung zad then bya ste/ /sprul pa dag tu bskyil byas nas/ /dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag 'khru lta bu'i sbyor ba yis/ /lus kyi stobs rnams babyed par bya/ /zhabs gnyis ngar gdong sa la gzugs/ /rting pa gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /tsos po gnyis ni bteg byas la/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol bya ste/ /mjing pa dag ni bsdam bya zhing / /lag gnyis gru mo mnye bar bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /mdzub mo lug rgyud sbyor ba yis/ /g.yas pa'i gru mo bdeg byas pas/ /mchan khung dag gi stobs bskyed nas/ /g.yon pa'i lag ngar mnan bya zhing / /g.yas pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /dngos gzhi bco lnga pa'o// spri //48—190

lag g.yas khu tshur bcang bya ste/ /gzhu 'gengs tshul gyis then byas nas/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan bya ste/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /snying ga dag ni mnan bya zhing / /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /rkang g.yon drag tu brkyang bya ste/ /rkang g.yas bskum pa'i long bu yis/ /rkang g.yon rtsa chen bshad bya zhing / /g.yas pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /kanyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis rtsa bas gsang sgo bsdam//lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /lha rgyan dag ni mnan bya ste/ /rin chen tshigs pa drang bar bya/ /mgrin pa dag kyang dgug bya zhing / /sgo lcags dag kyang gzhug par bya/ /steng rlung drag por mnan bya zhing / /'og rlung cung zad then bya ste/ /sprul pa dag tu bskyil byas nas/ /dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag 'khru lta du'i sbyor ba yis/ /lus kyi stobs rnams bskyed par bya/ /zhabs gnyis ngar gdong sa la gzugs/ /rting pa gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /tsos po gnyis ni bteg byas la/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu brnol bya ste/ /mjing pa dag ni bsdam bya zhing / /lag gnyis gru mo mnye bar bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsras la mgrin pa dgug /mdzub mo lug rgyud sbyor ba yis/ /g.yas pa'i gru mo bdeg byas pas/ /mchan khung dag gi stobs bskyed nas/ /g.yon pa'i lag ngar mnan bya zhing / /g.yas pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /dngos gzhi bco lnga pa'o// spru //48—190

ga /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi bcu drug pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /shing rta 'khor lo'i sbyor ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag gis bslab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /mdzub mo lug rgyud sbyor ba la/ /yan lag dang po gzhug bya zhing / /mgrin pa dag la ljid bkur ①nas/ /g.yas g.yon bsrang zhing bsgom par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis stobs babyed khu tshur bcang / /snying ga dag tu brten bya ste/ /rim gyis g.yon nas brkyang bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i spyil krung bca'//pad ma gyen la bslang bya ste/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan byas nas/ /lag gnyis rbe sha bsdam bya zhing / /skyil krung bar du bsdam bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lus kyi stobs rnams bskyed bya ste/ /'og rlung cung zad then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag por mnan bya zhing / /bsnun pa'i las dang ldan par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal bya zhing / /skyil krung byen la bslang bya ste/ /yar gyi tshigs pa gsum pa la/ /lus kyi byād rnams bskur bya zhing / /lag gnyis stobs babyed sbyor ba yis/ /rked pa dag ni brten par bya/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yisasde/ /tsug gu'i tshul gyis 'dug byas te/ /sa las 48—191

ga /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi bcu drug pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /shing rta 'khor lo'i sbyor ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag gis basbab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /mdzub mo lug rgyud sbyor ba la/ /yan lag dang po gzhug bya zhing / /mgrin pa dag la ldid bkur ①nas/ /g.yas g.yon bsrang zhing bsgom par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis stobs bskyed khu tshur bcang / /snying ga dag tu brten bya ste/ /rim gyis g.yon nas brkyang bar bya/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'//pad ma gyen la bsgang bya ste/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan byas nas/ /lag gnyis rbe sha bsdam bya zhing / /skyil krung bar du bsdam bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lus kyi stobs rnams bskyed bya ste/ /'og rlung cung zad then byas nas/ /steng rlung drag por mnan bya zhing / /bsgrun pa'i las dang ldan par bya/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal bya zhing / /skyil krung gyen la bslang bya ste/ /yar gyi tshigs pa gsum pa la/ /lus kyi ldid rnams bskur bya zhing / /lag gnyis stobs bskyed sbyor ba yis/ /rted pa dag ni brten par bya/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis / /tsug gu'i tshul gyis 'dug byas te/ /sa las 48—191

khyud gang gzhal ba yi/ /nam mkha' dag gi mtshams dag tu/ /tshad dang ldan pa'i dbyug pa ni/ /lag gnyis stobs kyis 'phred du bzung / /lus byi mkha' la lding byas nas/ /lan bdun bar du mchong bar bya'o/ /dngos gzhi bcu drug pa'o// sbi //ro /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi bcu bdun pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /'ja' la dha ri'i sbyor ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag gis bslab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /bar snang gnas pa'i shing dag la/ /thag pa'i sna gnyis btags byas pas/ /thag pa rgyug pa'i sbyor ba la/ /zhabs gnyis mthil ni gzhug bya ste//lag gnyis stobs bskyed thag pa la/ /bcang ba'i tshul gyis bzung bya ste/ /nam mkhar rab tu lding bar bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis mtheb mo bsnol byas te/ /phyir bzlog mdun du brkyang byas pas/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing bsgom par bya /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug/lag gnyis khu tshur bcang bya ste/ /snying ga dag tu brten byas nas/ /mdun du 'phul ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /stobs bskyed lan bdun mchong bar bya/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal bya ste/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha' dag la 'greng bya zhing / /lag gnyis stobs rnams babyed bya ste/ /rkang gnyis mtheb mos 'then bya zhing / /yar gyi tshigs pa bdun pa la/ /lus kyi ldid rnams bkur ⑫bya ste/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing bsgom par bya/ /48—192

khyud gang gzhal ba yi/ /nam mkha' dag gi mtshalas dag tu/ /tshad dang ldan pa'i dbyug pa ni/ /lag gnyis stobs kyis 'phred du bzung / /lus spyi mkha' la lding byas nas/ /lan bdun bar du mchong bar bya'o/ /dngos gzhi bcu drug pa'o// spri //kho /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi bcu bdun pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /'ja' la dha ri'i sbyor ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag gis bslab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /bar snang gnas pa'i shing dag la/ /thag pa'i sna gnyis btags byas pas/ /thag pa rgyug pa'i sbyor ba la/ /zhabs gnyis mthil ni gzhug bya ste//lag gnyis stobs babyed thag pa la/ /bcang ba'i tshul gyis bzung bya ste/ /nam mkhar rab tu lding bar bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis mtheb mo bsnol byas te/ /phyir bzlog mdun du brkyang byas pas/ /stobs rnams bskyed cing bsgom par bya//zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug/lag gnyis khu tshur bcang bya ste/ /snying ga dag tu brten byas nas/ /mdun du 'phul ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /stobs babyed lan bdun mchong bar bya/ /gan rkyal dag tu nyal bya ste/ /rkang gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha' dag la 'greng bya zhing / /lag gnyis stobs rnams babyed bya ste/ /rkang gnyis mtheb mos 'then bya zhing / /yar gyi tshigs pa bdun pa la/ /lus kyi ljid rnams bkur ①bya ste/ /stobs rnams babyed cing bsgom par bya/ /48—192

gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i sbyor ba yis /stobs babyed sa la btsugs bya ste/ /phyag g.yon stobs babyed gru mo yis/ /zhabs g.yon gyen la bltab pa yi/ /mgul pa dag nas bsdam bya zhing / /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol ba yi/ /rdo rje phyed mgo'i phyag rgya yis/ /spyi gtsug ①dag tu btsugs byas nas/ /'og rlung drag por then bya ste/ /steng rlung drag por mnan bya zhing / /dra mig dgang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /brang khog mdun du bsgur byas pas/ /bde ba rab tu skye ba'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /dpung mgo gnyis kyi steng dag tu/ /lag gnyis mtheb mo gzugs byas te/ /mtho gnyis phrad pa'i nang dag tu/ /yan lag dang po gzhug par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /skyil krung gyen la bslang bya ste/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshalas brtan byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis gshibs la khu tshur bcang / /stobs bskyed mdun du brkyang bar bya/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis /tsog gu'i tshul rmis 'dug bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i thal mo yis/ /mchan zur sog pa gnyis dag ni/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsdam par bya/ /tshigs pa'i mar mtshams brtan bya ste/ /rkang gnyis mgul pa bsnol byas nas/ /mthil zur gnyis ni sa la gzugs/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis bsgol ba'i thal mo yis /pus mo gnyis ni bsdam byas te/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi bcu bdun pa'o/ /slob dpon chen po 'bir wa pas mdzad pa'i 'chih+phu48—193

tshog /'chi med grub pa'i rtsa mdud brgyad 'grol ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyi yig sna/⑫ma / /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtog par 'ching ba'i mdud pa yi/ /skyon rnams rab tu sel ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag g.yon gyen la bsgrong bya ste/ /khu tshur rab tu bcang byas nas—/ /lag g.yas stobs bskyed thal mo yis/ /g.yon pa'i phrag gong dag la ni/ /lan bdun bar du mnan par bya/ /g.yas pa la yang de bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis mnyam bzhag phyag rgya bca'//'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /stobs bskyed rab tu bsgom par bya /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /48—196
