mas /bum pa can gyi 'khrul 'khor bco lnga pa/⑫ra /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bum pa can la ⑫slab byas te/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag g.yon gyen la blang byas te/ /khu tshur dag ni bcang byas te/ /lag g.yas stobs skyed ②thal mo yis—/ /g.yon pa'i phrag 'go dag la ni/ /lan bdun bar du mnan bya zhing //g.yas pa la yang de bzhin no / /④zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis rgyab tu bsnol byas pas—/ /rbe sha gnyis ni drag tu bsdam/ /yar gyi tshigs pa bdun pa ru/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i lag ngar gyis/ /lan bdun bar du mdun du dbul / /⑤zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs srang ④la mgrin ④pa dgug /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas te/ /mdun du rab tu stobs skyed ⑧48—264

༄ga /bum pa can gyi 'khrul 'khor bco lnga pa/①༄pha /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bum pa can la khruslab byas te/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag g.yon gyen la blang byas te/ /khu tshur dag ni bcang byas te/ /lag g.yas stobs skyed ④thal mo yis—/ /g.yon pa'i phrag 'go dag la ni/ /lan bdun bar du mnan bya zhing / /g.yas pa la yang de bzhin no / /④zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil/ krung bca'/ /lag gnyis rgyab tu bsnol byas pas—/ /rbe sha gnyis ni drag tu bsdam/ /yar gyi tshigs pa bdun pa ru/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i lag ngar gyis/ /lan bdun bar du mdun du dbul / /⑤zhabs gnyis pad ma'i byas krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs srang 0la mgrin ⑦pa dgug /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas te/ /mdun du rab tu stobs skyed ⑧48byed264

nas| /lan bdun brkyang la sprug par bya / /⑫zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis bsnol cing rbe sha bsdam| /gyen la bzlog cing bsdig par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i sprul krung bca'/ /lag gnyis bsnol cing rbe sha bsdam/ /gyen la zlog pa'i sbyor ba yis| /yan lag dang po gzhug bya zhing / /spyi gtsug phyar zhing brdig par bya/ /gan rkyal dag tu bsnyes byas nas/ /lag gnyis sa la gtsugs ②byas pas/ /lus po nam mkhar lding byas nas/ /rkang g.yas mdun du lan bdun sprug /g.yon pa yang ni de bzhin no / /②gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas te/ /lag mthil gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis//stobs rnams skyed cing mkha' la stan/ /'phul ba'i tshul gyis ldang bar bya /④gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /gnas gsum stems nas bsgom par bya—/ /bca' ba lus kyi gnad dag dang / /bsgom pa dmigs pa'i gnad dag dang / /'byung ba rlung gi gnad dag go/ /bca' ba lus kyi gnad dag ni—/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i lag mthil ⑤gyis/ /mchan 'og gnyis ni bsdam byas te/ /pad ma gyen du bslang byas te/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i lag ngar gyis/ /dkyil dkyil dag ni brten byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang ④la mgrin pa dgug /os sgo dang kha mnan bya zhing //sgo lcags rab tu bcug byas te/ /tsos po'i 'khor lo bskor bar bya / /④bsgom pa dmikas pa gnad dag ni/ /rang lus yi dam rang bzhin la/ /spyi bor mi bskyod bsgom par bya/ /de rjes sgyu lus 'ja' tshon bsgom/ /rtsa lnga 48—266

nas—/ /lan bdun brkyang la sprug par bya / /①zhabs gnyis pad ma'i byas krung bca'/ /lag gnyis bsnol cing rbe sha bsdam| /gyen la bzlog cing bsdig par bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i sprul krung bca'/ /lag gnyis bsnol cing rbe sha bsdam/ /gyen la zlog pa'i sbyor ba yis—/ /yan lag dang po gzhug bya zhing / /spyi gtsug phyar zhing brdig par bya/ /gan rkyal dag tu bsnyes byas nas/ /lag gnyis sa la gtsugs ②byas pas/ /lus po nam mkhar lding byas nas/ /rkang g.yas mdun du lan bdun sprug /g.yon pa yang ni de bzhin no / /ṣ+pegan rkyal dag tu nyal byas te/ /lag mthil gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis//stobs rnams skyed cing mkha' la stan/ /'phul ba'i tshul gyis ldang bar bya / /④gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /gnas gsum stems nas bsgom par bya—/ /bca' ba lus kyi gnad dag dang / /bsgom pa dmigs pa'i gnad dag dang / /'byung ba rlung gi gnad dag go/ /bca' ba lus kyi gnad dag ni—/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i lag mthil ⑤gyis/ /mchan 'og gnyis ni bsdam byas te/ /pad ma gyen du bslang byas te/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i lag ngar gyis/ /dkyil dkyil dag ni brten byas te/ /sgal tshigs bsrang dul mgrin pa dgug /os sgo dang kha mnan bya zhing / /sgo lcags rab tu bcug byas te/ /tsos po'i 'khor lo bskor bar bya / /④bsgom pa dmigs pa gnad dag ni/ /rang lus yi dam rang bzhin la/ /spyi bor mi bskyod bsgom par bya/ /de rjes sgyu lus 'ja' tshon bsgom/ /rtsa lnga 48—265

yar sna bde chen du/ /a chen yi ge lnga kha zug /mar sna gsang gnas bde skyong du/ /ram̐ chen yig 'bru lnga la zug /re gyi 'od zer 'phros pa dang / /a chen rnams kyi 'od 'phros pa/ /lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo ru/ /de gnyis 'dzom pa'i stobs rnams kyis/ /srog rtsol gnyis dang 'khor 'das dang / /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med cing / /de nyid ngang la gnas par bya// //'byung ba rlung gi gnad dag ni/ /dang po glo gsum lu bar bya/ /srog rtsol gnyis kyi rlung rnams ni/ /phyi ru gsum gsum bud par bya/ /bsel drag nges pa bcu drug gis/ /kha'i sgra bcas brngub par bya/ /bum pa can byi sbyor ba yis/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas cing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /sprul pa dag tu bskyil bar bya/ /rlung gi de nyid de bzhin no/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas mdun du brkyang ①byas te/ /stobs rnams skyed ⑤cing phyir la brkyang sne/ /khrig 'gul dag gi ④ 'khor lo ni/ /nyi shu dag tu bskor byas cing / /stobs rnams bskyed cing sprug bya ste/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no / /⑤zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsgol byas shing ⑥/ /stobs skyed gyen la greng byas cing / /rtsa rnams snyoms pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sku stod dag ni bskor bar bya / /⑦zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /mar gye tshigs pa dgu pa ru/ /lag g.yas rgyab tu bsgril byas nas/ /48—266

yar sna bde chen du/ /a chen yi ge lnga kha zug /mar sna gsang gnas bde skyong du/ /re chen yig 'bru lnga la zug /re gyi 'od zer 'phros pa dang / /a chen rnams kyi 'od 'phros pa/ /lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo ru/ /de gnyis 'dzom pa'i stobs rnams kyis/ /srog rtsol gnyis dang 'khor 'das dang / /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med cing / /de nyid ngang la gnas par bya// //'byung ba rlung gi gnad dag ni/ /dang po glo gsum lu bar bya/ /srog rtsol gnyis kyi rlung rnams ni/ /phyi ru gsum gsum bud par bya/ /bsil drag nges pa bcu drug gis/ /kha'i sgra bcas brngub par bya/ /bum pa can gyi sbyor ba yis/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas cing / /'og rlung drag por then byas te/ /sprul pa dag tu bskyil bar bya/ /rlung gi de nyid de bzhin no/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs ni pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas mdun du brkyang ②byas te/ /stobs rnams byed ②cing phyir la brkyang ②/ /khrig 'gul dag gi ④'khor lo ni/ /nyi shu dka tu bskor byas cing / /stobs rnams bskyed cing sprug bya ste/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no / /⑤zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i sprul krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas shing ④/ /stobs skyed gyen la sgreng byas cing / /rtsa rnams snyoms pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sku stod dag ni bskor bar bya / /⑦zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /mar gyi tshigs pa dgu pa ru/ /lag g.yas rgyab tu bsgril byas nas/ /48—266

'byung ba rlung gi gnad dag go/ /bca' ba lus kyi gnad dag ni/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i mgul ①pa ru/ /rda'u ris rab tu sbrel byas nas/ /nam mkhar rab tu brtags byas zhing / /mtho gang mtshalas ②su lding byas nas/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i lag thil gyis/ /rbe sha gnyis ni bsdam bya ste/ /yan lag dang po bcug byas nas/ /'gying ba'i tshul gyis ldang bar bya / /④bsgom pa dmigs pa'i gnad dag ni/ /rang lus yi dam rang bzhin la//spyi bor mi skyod bsgom pa dang / /de rjes sgyu lus 'ja' tshon bsgom/ /rtsa lnga yar sna hri la zug /rtsa lnga mar sna gsang gnas su/ /'dab ma bzhi dang lte ba la—/ /rigs lnga'i sa bon thig ler zug /de gnyis log pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /lus spyi 'od kyis bkang byas te/ /dmigs pa de la brtan par bya// //'byung ba rlung gi gnad dag ni/ /dang po glo gsum lu bar bya/ /srog rtsol gnyis kyi rlung rnams ni/ /lan gsum phyir la phud par bya/ /sna nas sgra bcas bcu drug ni/ /rnal 'byor dag gis slab byas te/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas nas/ /'og rlung cung zad then byas te/ /srog 'dzin 'then pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /nying 'dzin rnam par rtan byas nas/ /rlung gi de nyid de bzhin no// //gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa —/ /zhabs ni pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis stobs skyed khu tshur bcang / /rgyab tu bkug pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /yar gyi tshigs pa dang po la/ /re mos dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /bcu bzhi'i bar du brdeg bya shing / /sgrags pa 48—271

chog /rtsa stong 'khyil pa'i 'khrul 'khor bco lnga ba/⑫ra / /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa stong 'khyel pa'i sbyong ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag gis slab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /'go nad ma nu ba sgyug pa 'dus pa'i nad thams cad sel zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i jig krung bca'/ /lag gnyis rbe sha sdam ②byas te—/ /sgal tshigs bsrang ba'i sbyor ba la/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i lag ngar gyis / /ltag zur dag ni mnan byas te/ /dang po g.yas phyogs sbyor ba las//rims kyis lan bdun bskor bya zhing / /g.yon pa la yang de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis ngar sdong sa la btsugs/ /gsang sgo dag gi 'tshams ②dag tu/ /zhabs gnyis rtsa bas bsdam bya ste/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i thal mo yis/ /mchan khung rab tu bsdam bya zhing / /lag ngar gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /brla sgang gnyis ni mnan bya zhing / /stobs rnams rab tu bskyed byas nas/ /yan 48—274

༄ga /rtsa stong 'khyil pa'i 'khrul 'khor bco lnga pa/①༄4/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa stong 'khyel pa'i sbyong ba la/ /rnal 'byor dag gis slab bya ste/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ /'go nad ma zhu ba skyug pa 'dus pa'i nad thams cad sel zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i :kha krung bca'/ /lag gnyis rbe sha sdam ②byas te—/ /sgal tshigs bsrang ba'i sbyor ba la/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i lag ngar gyis—/ /ltag zur dag ni mnan byas te/ /dang po g.yas phyogs sbyor ba las//rims kyis lan bdun bskor bya zhing / /g.yon pa la yang de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis ngar sdong sa la btsugs/ /gsang sgo dag gi 'tshalas ④dag tu/ /zhabs gnyis rtsa bas bsdam bya ste/ /lag gnyis bsnol ba'i thal mo yis/ /mchan khung rab tu bsdam bya zhing / /lag ngar gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /brla sgang gnyis ni mnan bya zhing / /stobs rnams rab tu babyed byas nas/ /yan 48—274

lag dang po dgug par bya/ /lag gnyis stobs byed thal mo dang / /spyi bo sa la btsugs byas te/ /rkang gnyis bshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha' dag ①tu bgreng bar bya / /④zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i khrul krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas mdun du brkyang byas te/ /stobs rnams byed cing khu tshur bcang / /'khrig 'gul dag gi 'khor lo ni/ /nyi shu dag tu bskor bar bya / /stobs rnams skyed cing sprug bya zhing / /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas zhing / /stobs skyed ①gyen la greng byas te/ /rtsa rnams snyoms pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sku stod dag ni bskor ④bar bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i byas krung bca'/ /lag gnyis stobs skyed thal mo yis| /brla sha gnyis ni mnan byas te/ /sgal tshigs srang ⑤ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /gsang gnas gyen du rjodrang byas shing / /mgrin pa dra mig ⑦sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun gyen la greng bar bya / /⑧tshigs pa'i mar 'tshalas brtan byas nas/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /mdun du rab tu bskyang ⑨byas te/ /mthe ⑩bong gnyis ni mdud bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas te/ /stobs skyed ⑪mdun du brkyang bar bya / /⑫gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i ⑫rim pa ni/ /gnad gsum stems la bsgom par bya| /bca' ba lus kyi gnad dag dang / /bsgom pa dmigs pa'i gnad 48—275

lag dang po dgug par bya/ /lag kanyis stobs skyed thal mo dang / /byi bo sa la btsugs byas te/ /rkang gnyis bshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha' dag ①tu bsgreng bar bya / /②zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag g.yas mdun du brkyang byas te/ /stobs rnams skyed cing khu tshur bcang / /'khrig 'gul dag gi 'khor lo ni/ /nyi shu dag tu bskor bar bya| /stobs rnams skyed cing sprug bya zhing / /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor bcu bsnol byas zhing / /stobs skyed ②gyen la sgreng byas te/ /rtsa rnams snyoms pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sku stod dag ni bskor ④bar bya/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyid krung bca'/ /lag gnyis stobs skyed thal mo yis| /brla sha gnyis ni mnan byas te/ /sgal tshigs srangakuba'i sbyor ba yis /gsang gnas gyen du 0drang byas shing / /mgrin pa dra mig0sbyor ba yis/ /lan bdun gyen la sgreng bar bya / /⑧tshigs pa'i mar 'tshams brtan byas nas/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /mdun du rab tu bskyang ⑫byas te/ /mthe ⑫bong gnyis ni mdud bya ste/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang byas te/ /stobs skyed ⑪mdun du brkyang bar bya ⑫gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i ⑫rim pa ni/ /gnad gsum stems la bsgom par bya| /bca' ba lus kyi gnad dag dang / /bsgom pa dmigs pa'i gnad 48—276

dag dang / /'byung ba rlung gi gnad dag dang / /go ca lus kyi gnad dag ni/ /mar gyi tshigs pa stan bya ste/ /rkang g.yas drag tu brkyang byas nas/ /rkang g.yon skum pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /g.yas pa'i rla ①rgang mnan bya ste/ /lag g.yon mdun du brkyang byas nas/ /rkang g.yas 'theb mo then byas te/ /lag g.yas bskum pa'i gru mo yis/ /g.yon pa'i bol gong gcud byas te/ /khu tshung bcang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /mas kyis gsal ba'i mdun sa la/ /stobs byed rab tu mnan bya ste/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /bsgom pa dmigs pa'i gnad dag ni/ /rang lus yi dam rang bzhin la//spyi bor mi skyod bsgom pa dang / /de rjes sgyu lus 'ja' tshon bsgom/ /rtsa lnga yar sna mgrin pa ru/ /rdza chen dmar mo'i mgo la zug /mar sna lte ba sprul pa zug—/ de gnyis 'dzom pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /don snying sna lnga la sogs la/ /lus bye gang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /dmigs pa de la gtad par bya / /④'byung ba rlung gi gnad dag ni/ /dang po glo gsum lu bar bya/ /srog rtsol gnyis kyi rlung rnams ni/ /phyi ru gsum gsum 'bud par bya/ /kha nas sgra bcas bcu drug ni/ /nang du bkug pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shing⑧/ /'og rlung drag por then byas nas/ /snying kha dag tu bskyil bar bya/ /rlung gi de nyid de bzhin no/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor mo bsnol byas te/ /stobs rnams byed cing phyir la skyang ④/ /nang du bkug cing phyir la stan/ /48—276

dag dang / /'byung ba rlung gi gnad dag dang / /go ca lus kyi gnad dag ni//mar gyi tshigs pa stan bya ste/ /rkang g.yas drag tu brkyang byas nas/ /rkang g.yon skum pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /g.yas pa'i rla ⑫rgang mnan bya ste/ /lag g.yon mdun du brkyang byas nas/ /rkang g.yas 'theb mo then byas te/ /lag g.yas bskum pa'i gru mo yis/ /g.yon pa'i bol gong gcud byas te/ /khu tshur bcang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /mas kyis gsal ba'i mdun sa la/ /stobs skyed rab tu mnan bya ste/ /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /bsgom pa dmigs pa'i gnad dag ni/ /rang lus yi dam rang bzhin la//byi bor mi skyod bsgom pa dang / /de rjes sgyu lus 'ja' tshon bsgom/ /rtsa lnga yar sna mgrin pa ru/ /ram̐ chen dmar mo'i mgo la zug /mar sna lte ba sprul pa zug1de gnyis 'dzom pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /don snying sna lnga la sogs la/ /lus spyi gang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /dmigs pa de la gtad par bya / /②'byung ba rlung gi gnad dag ni/ /dang po glo gsum lu bar bya/ /srog rtsol gnyis kyi rlung rnams ni/ /phyi ru gsum gsum 'dud par bya/ /kha nas sgra bcas bcu drug ni/ /nang du bkug pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /steng rlung drag por mnan byas shingaku/ /'og rlung drag por then byas nas/ /snying kha dag tu basprul bar bya/ /rlung gi de nyid de bzhin no/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad ma'i jig krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis sor mo bsgom byas te/ /stobs rnams skyed cing phyir la skyang ④/ /nang du bkug cing phyir la stan/ /48—276

snying kha dag tu mnan bya ste/ /lan bdun bar du de bzhin no / /①zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs srang la mgrin pa dguga'og rlung cung zad then byas te/ /'jam rlung dag gi ①sbyor ba yis lag g.yas stobs skyed khu tshur bca'/ /tshigs gsum bskor zhing lan bdun sprug /g.yon pa dag kyang de bzhin no / /①zhabs gnyis gshibs ④shing brtan byas nas/ /cog gu'i tshul gyis 'dug byas te/ /lag gnyis sa la gzugs byas nas/ /sor bcu'i rtse mo sprad byas nas/ /lus spyi mkha' la dulding bya ste/ /mdun rgyab gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis//lan bdun bar du mchong bar bya / /duzhabs gnyis pad ma'i skyil krung bca'/ /lag gnyis gyen la sgreng byas te//khu tshur dag ni rab bcangs nas/ /'og rlung then cing tshigs rnams ni/ /lan bdun bar du gseng bar bya / /⑦ gan rkyal dag tu nyal byas la/ /'the bong ⑧lug rgyud bsnol byas pa'i/ /zhabs gnyis gshibs pa rkyang byas te/ /lag gnyis gshibs pa stod du brkyang / /khya tshur rab tu bcang byas te/ /lan bdun bar du ldang bar bya ⑨zhabs gnyis pad ma'i byas krung bca'/ /sgal tshigs bsrang la mgrin pa dgug /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang bya ste/ /stobs skyed sa la gzugs byas cing / /'ging ba'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya / /⑩bar snang gnas pa'i shing dag la/ /thag pa'i sna gnyis btags byas pas /thag pa khug pa'i sbyor ba la/ /zhabs gnyis thil ni gzhug byas te/ /lag gnyis stobs skyed thag pa la/ /bcang ba'i tshul kyis gzung byas te/ /nam 48—277
