༄ga /zab lam thun mong ma yin pa gcig rjegs legs par bzhugs so//1༄ga /na maḥshrī gu ra we/ dpal ldan snying rje'i zla ba dri med 'od/ /klu sgrub lugs bzang nyi ma'i snang ba che/ /sha ba ra dbang mkha' la rtag 'char bas—/ /nags kyi rin chen snang 'di mchog 'dod skyes/ /'dir dpal ri khrod dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas/ phyag na pad+mo ②can gyi drin las mchog gi bde ba chen po'i gnas mngon du mdzad pas grol ba brnyes pa ni/ thog mar klu sgrub zhabs kyis rang byin gyis brlab pa'i lam du smin par mdzad pa las te/ de'i phyir rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud gnyis kyi nges pa mthar thug pa'i zung 'jug gi lam srol chen po yan lag drug gam rim pa lnga la sogs par phye ste rim gyis bkri ba'i tshul mtha' dag /dbang po rnon po las ches non po skal ba mchog las kyang mchog tu gyur pa dag la/ bsam gtan byi yan lag gam/ rang byin rlabs kyi rim pa gcig pus 'dod pa 'jo ba ni/ bla na med pa'i lam gyi snying 48—679

tshog /zab lam thun mong ma yin pa gcig rjogs legs par bzhugs so//⑫ra /na maḥshrī gu ra we/ dpal ldan snying rje'i zla ba dri med 'od/ /klu sgrub lugs bzang nyi ma'i snang ba che/ /sha ba ra dbang mkha' la rtag 'char bas—/ /nags kyi rin chen snang 'di mchog 'dod skyes/ /'dir dpal ri khrod dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas/ phyag na pad+mo ②can gyi drin las mchog gi bde ba chen po'i gnas mngon du mdzad pas grol ba brnyes pa ni/ thog mar klu sgrub zhabs kyis rang byin gyis brlab pa'i lam du smin par mdzad pa las te/ de'i phyir rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud gnyis kyi nges pa mthar thug pa'i zung 'jug gi lam srol chen po yan lag drug gam rim pa lnga la sogs par bye ste rim gyis bkri ba'i tshul mtha' dag /dbang po non po las ches non po skal ba mchog las kyang mchog tu gyur pa dag la/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag gam/ rang byin rlabs kyi rim pa gcig pus 'dod pa 'jo ba ni/ bla na med pa'i lam gyi snying 48nga 679

po ri khrod zhabs kyi thugs kyi bcud thun mong du ma gyur pa dag yin la/ 'di la yang lam gyi rtogs pa gcig chod kyi goms pas bsgrod pa shin tu spros med rgyud yongs su smin pa khyad par can gyi dbang du byas pa dang / yan lag gam rim pa gzhan rnams/ bsam gtan nam rang byin rlabs su rjes su mthun pa sgrub pa'i sgo las gnad bcings te gcig chod du bya ba cung zad spros pa dang bcas pa gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma'i dbang du mdzad de/ dang por mchog gi go 'phang mngon par 'dod pa thabs dang bcas pa'i nges pa la rten ⑫pa'i man ngag gi rtsa ba'i tshig gsung ba ni/ tsit+tasamāropitaduḥkha②dzamanakadzad+margyupidṛrnyi meti—/ tasmabloshurnyiḥparibardzarīyipitsarmitwaṣamastsokhyamamitai/ sems la sdug bsngal sa bon btab pa las/ /skye ba du ma rnams su 'phel 'grur ba/ /de phyir rnam par dag pas yongs spangs shing / /rnam par dpyad las bde mnyam 'dod pa bya/ /do li pa'i zhal snga nas so// 1 //gang gis sdug bsngal sa bon dang bcas pa sgong zhing / rang gi ngo bo nyid du rnam par dpyad pa las bde mnyam du 'grur ba'i rnam par dag pa'i lam de gang zhe na/ shin tu rnam dag gi lam mo zhes rtsa ba'i nges pa las gdams pa'i mdo ni/ nirbikaspran+dabudhahūṃsabekasprartsonotathā/ subisudhapari4 nādhabedebamatī②jishā—/ rnam mi rtog las sangs rgyas min/ /de bzhin rnam rtog bcas pas ④ kyang / /shin tu rnam dag yongs shes na/ /mkhas pa rnams ni 'gyur ba nyid/ /nag po spyod pa'i zhal lnga nas so// 2 //de'i phyir shin tu rnam dag gi lam gyi ngo bo yang rnam shes las 'das pa'i ye shes so zhes gol sa bcad pa las snang ba dang bcas pa'i mngon sum du 48—680

po ri khrod zhabs kyi thugs kyi bcud thun mong du ma gyur pa dag yin la/ 'di la yang lam rmi rtogs pa gcig chod kyi goms pas bsgod pa shin tu spros med rgyud yongs su smin pa khyad par can gyi dbang du byas pa dang / yan lag gam rim pa gzhan rnams/ bsam gtan nam rang byin rlabs su rjes su mthun pa sgrub pa'i sgo las gnad bcings te gcig chod du bya ba cung zad spros pa dang bcas pa gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma'i dbang du mdzad de/ dang por mchog gi go 'phang mngon par 'dod pa thabs dang bcas pa'i nges pa la rten ①pa'i man ngag gi rtsa ba'i tshig gsung ba ni/ tsit+tasamāropitaduḥkha④dzamanakadzad+margyupidṛrnyi meti—/ tasma྾shurnyiḥparibardzarīyopitsarlitwaṣamastsokhyamamitai/ sems la sdug bsngal sa bon btab pa las/ /skye ba du ma rnams su 'phel 'gyur ba/ /de phyir rnam par dag pas yongs spangs shing / /rnam par dpyad las bde mnyam 'dod pa bya/ /do li pa'i zhal snga nas so// 1 //gang gis sdug bsngal sa bon dang bcas pa spong zhing / rang gi ngo bo nyid du rnam par dpyad pa las bde mnyam du 'gyur ba'i rnam par dag pa'i lam de gang zhe na/ shin tu rnam dag gi lam mo zhes rtsa ba'i nges pa las gdams pa'i mdo ni/ nirbikaspran+dabudhatwosabikalbārtsonotathā/ subisurnyaparidz+nyā nār+bhabedebamabe+e ṣihūṃ—/ rnam mi rtog las sangs rgyas min/ /de bzhin rnam rtog bcas pas khyokyang / /shin tu rnam dag yongs shes na/ /mkhas pa rnams ni 'gyur ba nyid/ /nag po spyod pa'i zhal snga nas so// 2 //de'i phyir shin tu rnam dag gi lam gyi ngo bo yang rnam shes las 'das pa'i ye shes so zhes gol sa bcad pa las snang ba dang bcas pa'i mngon sum du 48byed680

gdams pa'i mdo ni/ atshwan①rnayatidz+nyānan+didrwadṛṣ+ṭan+tasādhitai/ isgriyopa raltayartsotshwarnabaibhāṣikasmataḥ—/ gal te ye shes snang med nyid yin na/ /gnyid 'thug lta bu bsgrub byar 'gyur ba ste/ /gang yang dbang po 'gog la ye shes ni/ /bye brag smra ba rnams kyi lugs yin no/ /dā ri ka pa'i zhabs kyis so// na //ji ltar snang ba dang bcas pa dpes bstan pa nyid kyis 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa rnam shes dang ye shes kyi snang ba tsam du gdams pa'i mdo ni/keshoṭushaṃyathākāshestemiromarkutedzanaḥtathāphobit+yātamanodzagadat+yan+tabālishaḥ—/shudhadṛṣ+ṭir+yathākeshā:terākāshalakhyetāḥ—/ bhāwābhārnyitathāsabyeyogilaḥshudhadadhi naḥji ltar rab rib can gyi skye bo yis/ /nam mkha' la ni skra shad chun po mthong / /de bzhin ma rig myun pas bkab pa yi/ /'gro ba rnams ni lhag par rmongs pa ste// 4 //rnam par dag pas nam mkha'i mtshan nyid las/ /skra shad 'khrul pa ji ltar mthong bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin rnam dag mig can rnal 'byor par/ /thams cad du yang dngos rnams mthong ba'o/ /a dwa ya badz+ra zhabs kyis so// 5 //de lta bas na skye ba can rnams kyi 'dod pas brtags pa'i rtog ge'i lam ji lta ba bzhin phyi rol yod na/ thams cad du rang rang gi 'dod pa ji lta bar tshad mas kyang nyams su stsong dgos pas don gyi gnas tshul mang po nyid du thal ches shing / don la ma grub pa'i rigs pas rnam shes rang nyid kyis stsong byar byas pa yang bden pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnas tshul la myong ba'i ngo bo nyid ni rang rig pa nam mkha' lta bu las gzhan srid pa ma yin no zhes snang tsam nyid 48—681

gdams pa'i mdo ni/ satshwan⑫ne+eyatitsānanidādṛṣ+ṭarnyasārnyite/ ijiyopa rateyartsotsādz+wabaibhājikamyutaḥ—/ gal te ye shes snang med nyid yin na/ /gnyid 'thug lha bu baspub byar 'gyur ba ste/ /gang yang dbang po 'gog la ye shes ni/ /bye brag smra ba rnams kyi lugs yin no/ /dā ri ka pa'i zhabs kyis so// da //ji ltar snang ba dang bcas pa dpes bstan pa nyid kyis 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa rnam shes dang ye shes kyi snang ba tsam du gdams pa'i mdo ni/keshoṭukeyathākāshetemiromakhutedzanaḥtadzā&jibyātamanodzagadat+yarnyabālishaḥ shudhadṛsnerlathākeshāhūṃterākāshalakhriṭāḥ| bhāwābhārnyitathāsabyeyogilaḥshudhadani naḥji ltar rab rib can gyi skye bo yis/ /nam mkha' la ni skra shad chun po mthong / /de bzhin ma rig mun pas bkab pa yi/ /'gro ba rnams ni lhag par rmongs pa ste// 4 //rnam par dag pas nam mkha'i mtshan nyid las/ /skra shad 'a la pa ji ltar mthong bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin rnam dag mig can rnal 'byor par/ /thams cad du yang dngos rnams mthong ba'o/ /sa dwa ya badz+ra zhabs kyis so// 5 //de lha bas na skye ba can rnams kyi 'dod pas brtags pa'i rtog ge'i lam ji lha ba bzhin phyi rol yod na/ thams cad du rang rang gi 'dod pa ji lta bar tshad mas kyang nyams su myong dgos pas don gyi gnas tshul mang po nyid du thal ches shing / don la ma grub pa'i rigs pas rnam shes rang nyid kyis myong byar byas pa yang bden pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnas tshul la myong ba'i ngo bo nyid ni rang rig pa nam mkha' lta bu las gzhan srid pa ma yin no zhes snang tsam nyid 48—681

rang bzhin gyi tshul las rang byin rlabs sam bsam gtan gyi sgrub gzhir gdams pa'i mdo ni/ yar+yaphywasnebahubidhamateshīkṛtertutabṛrdosasboṣāmapyanu bhawamatibastotesar+bhakālaḥ—/ tsātogrwahūṃyanganubhawanatwashīkṛterabyasat+ya kin+dakāshaṃbyupanatamitābhāshatesat+thadzasto—/ rang gi 'dod pas byas pa'i cho ga mang po zhig ni gal te'ang 'byung po'i tshogs yod na/ /thams cad dus su thams cad kyi ni 'dod pa kun nas nyams su sbong bar 'gyur ba ste/ /gzung bya ma yin pa gang nyams su spyong phyir 'di ni rang gis byas pa'ang bden pa min/ /skye ba can rnams kun la nam mkha' min na 'dir ni mngon par skabs yod snang ba ci/ /nang gi snying po brgya pa las te// 6 //snang ba rjes dran gyi man ngag gi rtsa bar yang 'gyur ro/ /rang rig pa'i sgyu ma de ni mi shigs pa'i nges pa nyid kyis rang gi lus la gnas kyang / rnam 'gyur blo bur gyi dri ma'i gzhan dbang can yin pa'i phyir/ thams cad la mngon du 'gyur ba ma yin pas/ thar pa bla na med pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i bsod nams stobs su gyur pa dag gi rtog ges ma bslad pa'i yang dag pa'i man ngag gi sgo las mngon du bya bar gdams pa'i mdo ni/ susaṃjit+yānyi sāmāyātārkikaṇamashotsar—/ nidzadehaṣ+ṭitātsāpimarnyapuṭīnalabh+yate/ rang rika nges pa'i sgyu ma de⑫/ /rtog ge rnams kyi spyod yul min/ /rang gi lus la gnas gyur kyang / /bsod nams dman pas de mi 'thob/ /ār+yakude ba'i zhal snga nas te// 7 //mi shigs pa rjes dran gyi man ngag gi rtsa ba yang yin no/ /de nas yang dag pa'i man ngag gi nges pa la/ thog mar so sor bsdud pa'am/ rdzogs 48—682

rang bzhin byi tshul las rang byin rlabs sam bsam gtan gyi sgrub gzhir gdams pa'i mdo ni/ yar+yapyuṣ+ṭibahubidhamateshīkṛtai2tadṛsdosabyeṣāmapyanu bhawamatibartatesazakālaḥ—/ nātogrwatram̐yanganubhawanatwashrīkṛterabyasat+ya kin+dakāshaṃkhyapanatamitābhāshatesat+thadzarnyo—/ rang gi 'dod pas byas pa'i cho ga mang po zhig ni gal te'ang 'byung po'i tshogs yod na/ /thams cad dus su thams cad kyi ni 'dod pa kun nas nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba ste/ /gzung bya ma yin pa gang nyams su myong phyir 'di ni rang gis byas pa'ang bden pa min/ /skye ba can rnams kun la nam mkha' min na 'dir ni mngon par skabs yod snang ba ci/ /nang gi snying po brgya pa las te// 6 //snang ba rjes dran gyi man ngag gi rtsa bar yang 'gyur ro/ /rang rig pa'i sgyu ma de ni mi shigs pa'i nges pa nyid kyis rang gi lus la gnas kyang / rnam 'gyur blo bur gyi dri ma'i gzhan dbang can yin pa'i phyir/ thams cad la mngon du 'gyur ba ma yin pas/ thar pa bla na med pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i bsod nams stobs su gyur pa dag gi rtog ges ma bslad pa'i yang dag pa'i man ngag gi sgo las mngon du bya bar gdams pa'i mdo ni/ swasaṃbit+yānyi sāmāyātārkikaṇamashotsar—/ nidzadehajitātsāpiman+dhapu:nalabh+yate/ rang rig nges pa'i sgyu ma de①/ /rtog ge rnams kyi spyod yul min/ /rang gi lus la gnas gyur kyang / /bsod nams dman pas de mi 'thob/ /ār+ya dze+ede ba'i zhal snga nas te// 7 //mi shigs pa rjes dran gyi man ngag gi rtsa ba yang yin no/ /de nas yang dag pa'i man ngag gi nges pa la/ thog mar so sor bsdud pa'am/ rdzogs 48—682

pa'i rim pa'i lus rnam par dbe+en pa'i ting nge 'dzin tsam la gdams pa'i mdo ni—/ bimalanabhasiyasmin+dirmitelotsanāsnyesbraradurukarūnān+d+radāshayādāshayāshatra/sangasadubhayabhāwābhāwanirber+yakasmradungayadakhilatsumār+yadz+wayaḥ shun+yatāyāḥ/ dri ma med pa'i nam mkha' gang la mig phyed gyen du btod nas ni/ /rnam par rtog pa zos las snying rje chen pos bdon zhing 'phro ba'i sems/ /yod med gnyis dang gnyi ga min pa ma lus myur du 'jig byed las/ /du ba la sogs stong pa nyid kyi mdon ma mtha' dag 'char bar 'gyur/ /nyi ma dpal ye shes kyi'o// 8 //tshul ji lta bu nyid kyis rnam par rtog pa zos te mi rtog pa nyid du bya ba'i man ngag gi mdo ni/ ut+paṣ+ṭatsamanomūlokṛtwashubyophothagh+raṣakhaṃ/ abit+yāti midzādz+nyānāmedzarnakimataḥparaḥ—/ sems kyi rtsa ba phyung byas nas/ /stong pa nyid la gnad du btad/ /ma rig rab rib kyis ldongs la/ /'di las mig sman mchog ci zhig /rābi shrī ye'o①// 9 //mi rtog pa'i snang ba la byed pa bcings pa las bsam gtan kyi yan lag gam lus dben khyad par can mngon du bya ba'i mdo ni/ nāsāgreninyitekalo tsanayunāsaṃyimyadzībānilodzihūṃtālutalābalamānagahūṃkṛtwadzharesaṃyatai—/ dz+nyānabyo titatarnyakārapaṭalotsadz+nyāshum+budzhaḥshubyekhrusazamanabilodzagatirdayagyarnyibyernyikāḥ—/mig gnyis sna rtser gcig tu gtad de lce yi rlung ni bkag nas lce/ /rkan gyi ngos la gtad pas gnas shing mchu la bar yod par byas nas/ /ye shes 'od kyi zla zer tshogs kyis mun pa 'joms pa la mkhas pa/ /rnam mi rtog las dgro 'di dri med thams cad stong par mthong bar 'gyur/ /'phags pa lha'i zhabs byedas te// 1༷ //48—683

pa'i rim pa'i lus rnam par dben pa'i ting nge 'dzin tsam la gdams pa'i mdo ni| jimalanabhasiyasminimitelotsatsārtespruradurukarūtsādrodāshayādāshayāshatra/sangasadubhayabhāwābhāwanirbedukasmradungayadakhilatsumādudz+wayaḥ shun+yatāyāḥ/ dri ma med pa'i nam mkha' gang la mig phyed gyen du btod nas ni/ /rnam par rtog pa zos las snying rje nga pos bcan zhing 'phro ba'i sems/ /yod med gnyis dang gnyi ga min pa ma lus myur du 'jig byed las/ /du ba la sogs stong pa nyid kyi mang ma mtha' dag 'char bar 'gyur/ /nyi ma dpal ye shes kyi'o// 8 //tshul ji lta bu nyid kyis rnam par rtog pa zos te mi rtog pa nyid du bya ba'i man ngag gi mdo ni/ ut+paṣ+ṭatsamanorūlokṛtwashubyo3thazaṣaṇi/ sajit+yāti midzātsātsāpaṃdzadz+wakimataḥparaḥ / sems kyi rtsa ba phyung byas nas/ /stong pa nyid la gnad du btad/ /ma rig rab rib kyis ldongs la/ /'di las mig sman mchog ci zhig /rāji ṭī ye'o⑫// ( //mi rtog pa'i snang ba la byed pa bcings pa las bsam gtan gyi yan lag gam lus dben khyad par can mngon du bya ba'i mdo ni/ nāsāgreninyitekalo tsanayuhūṃsaṃyimyadzībānilodzihūṃtālutalngabalamānagahūṃkṛtwadzharesaṃyate—/ 4nabyo nyitatarnyakārapaṭalotsahūṃshusbudzhaḥshurnyi②sazamanabilodzaganyirdayasurnyiṭīrnyikāḥ—/mig gnyis sna rtser gcig tu gtad de lce yi rlung ni bkag nas lce/ /rkan gyi ngos la gtad pas gnas shing mchu la bar yod par byas nas/ /ye shes 'od kyi zla zer tshogs kyis mun pa 'joms pa la mkhas pa/ /rnam mi rtog las 'gro 'di dri med thams cad stong par mthong bar nga ra/ /'phags pa lha'i zhabs kyis te// 1༷ //48—683

lce rtse rkan sbyar nā da'i gsang gnad kyi rtsa ba'o/ /ji ltar byed pa bcings pa las thabs shes dbyer med kyi lhag pa'i lha thog mar mngon du 'gyur ba'i rtsa ba'i mdo ni/ shātatsitradebatākāram̐bishwañcakrasprupāyaka/ pradz+nyātsashu n+yatāthrak+tasābyetādāṭ+wāka6te—/ bde ba'i sems kyi rnam pa lha/ /shes rab stong pa nyid du gsungs/ /sna tshogs 'khor lo'i thabs gyur pa/ /de yi bdag nyid 'dod bsgrub bya/ /gnyis med rdo rje'i zhal snga nas te// 11 //bskyed rdzogs dbyer med kyi nges pa yang 'di nyid las ①khong du chud par bya ba'i rtsa ba'o/ /'di nyid du rigs brgya'i dbye ba sogs gsang chen rigs gcig tu gcig chod du bya ba'i rtsa ba'i mdo ni/ pa.ā+oṃt+pakapañcarnyire babhūstedṛṣ+ṭinarāshānitaisharīre—/ tad+dhābabhābainiyataiswatsi:prabhāwayarnyaḥ prabhā brnyiburnyaḥ'abyung po lnga yi bdag nyid lnga rnams kyis/ /mthong ba mi rnams lus la 'dus pa ste/ /ngo bos de dngos 'dus pa rang gi sems/ /rab tu sgom par byed rnams sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /ār+ya de ba'i gsung las te// 12 //rdor sems gsang chen rigs gcig gi rtsa ba yang ngo / /'dir so sor bsdud pa dang bsam gtan ni rlung dang sngags kyi de kho na nyid mngon du byed pa'i nges pas rdo rje bzlas pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i phyir/ de'i yan lag tu bsdus pa'ang yin no/ /de nas 'di nyid du srog 'gog pa'i yan lag mthun pa'i rgyur byas te/ brdar gyur dang don dam pa'i rdo rje bzlas pa la btsan thabs su sbyor ba nā da rang byung gi gsang gnad kyi rtsa ba'i mdo ni/dātroshat+yātrata.iyogugyapad+mān+d+radzarnyishat+tar+sābhepradzatitsatsastuḥ ṣajipatād+makādz+dza trit+pad+mo3ṣ+ṭamaladalayutekaṇ+ḍahodāṣ+ṭapatregut+yāstsabheshirasitsatsatuḥ patrekebrah+maram̐dhe/48byed684

lce rtse rkan sbyar nā da'i gsang gnad kyi rtsa ba'o/ /ji ltar byed pa bcings pa las thabs shes dbyer med kyi lhag pa'i lha thog mar mngon du 'gyur ba'i rtsa ba'i mdo ni/ shātatsitradebatākārejishālcakrasprupāyaka/ pratshwatsashu n+yatāprok+tasātram̐tādāt+takabyute—/ bde ba'i sems kyi rnam pa lha/ /shes rab stong pa nyid du gsungs/ /sna tshogs 'khor lo'i thabs gyur pa/ /de yi bdag nyid 'dod bsgrub bya/ /gnyis med rdo rje'i zhal snga nas te// 11 //bskyed rdzogs dbyer med kyi nges pa yang 'di nyid las ⑫khong du chud par bya ba'i rtsa ba'o/ /'di nyid du rigs brgya'i dbye ba sogs gsang chen rigs gcig tu gcig chod du bya ba'i rtsa ba'i mdo ni/ padziblokepalcarnyire bskrutedṛṣ+ṭinarāhūṃnitesharīre—/ tatsābabhābainiyateswatsistiprabhāwayarnyaḥ prabhā brnyibudhaḥ'abyung po lnga yi bdag nyid lnga rnams kyis/ /mthong ba mi rnams lus la 'dus pa ste/ /ngo bos de dngos 'dus pa rang gi sems/ /rab tu sgom par byed rnams sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /cad de ba'i gsung las te// 12 //rdor sems gsang chen rigs gcig gi rtsa ba yang ngo / /'dir so sor bsdud pa dang bsam gtan ni rlung dang sngags kyi de kho na nyid mngon du byed pa'i nges pas rdo rje bzlas pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i phyir/ de'i yan lag tu bsdus pa'ang yin no/ /de nas 'di nyid du srog 'gog pa'i yan laka mthun pa'i rgyur byas te/ brdar gyur dang don dam pa'i rdo rje bzlas pa la btsan thabs su sbyor ba nā da rang byung gi gsang gnad kyi rtsa ba'i mdo ni/dātrishat+yātrata.iyigugyapaṅgājidzaṭīshat+taṭāsnyepradzatitsatsastuḥ ṣaṣ+ṭipatāt+pakārdze trit+pad+mo3ṣ+ṭamaladalayutekaṇ+ḍahodāṣ+ṭapatregusgyustsasnyeshirasitsatsatuḥ patrekebramiredhe/48—684

so gnyis 'dab ldan gsang ba'i pad+ma dag las 'di ni nus pas gyen 'gro zhing / /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i 'dab ma'i bdag nyid lte ba'i chu skyes las kyang steng du ste/ /dri med 'dab ma brgyad ldan snying ga'i pad+ma mgrin pa brgyad gnyis 'dab can dang / /mgo bo gsang ba mtshungs pa dag ni 'dab ma bzhi pa tshangs pa'i bug pa la'o/ /spyod pa'i mdzod las so// 1na //de ltar shes nas zla nyi rang lam du bcings te nā da sgra gcan gyi lam du bzhengs pa'i srog rtsol gyi sbyor ba rlung sngags gnyis med kyi de kho na nyid mthar thug pa la gdams pa'i rtsa ba'i mdo ni/ bar+sāpad+māsanamadharatobāyumākṛpyagā sgodatāhastadwanyiyamarutoghāṇabastebiṅgāya—/ dordaṭ+wādz+nyāsnranayugalakesteḍite masgyewāhāsgaṭa kar+ṣaduparipunaruṭ+wāmyatemāṇabāta/ pad+ma'i gdan ni bcing zhing de las mthu yis 'og gi rlung bkug nas/ /rlung rnams la ni lag gnyis byin te sna dang mchu dag sdams nas ni/ /lag ngar gnyis kyis nu ma zung la 'thems par gtod de dbugs kyi rgyun/ /steng du drag por phyir zhing bkug las srog rlung yon po 'pho bar 'gyur/ /bi bud+dhā ka ra'i zhal snga nas te// 24 //btsan thabs thun mong ma yin pa la pad+ma'i gdan zhes pa 'og gi pad+ma'i gnas bcing ba sogs so/ /de'i phyir phyag rgya srog rtsol gyi yan lag gi rtsa ba yang ngo / /de ltar srog rtsol lam rdo rje bzlas pa'i sbyor ba thun mong ma yin pas nyi zla sgra gcan byi lto bar btsan thabs su rengs pa de nyid du/ srog thur gyi byed pa nye bar gnas pa'i dbang las me chu'i bya ba bzlog ①par dka' ba dag /btsan thabs su gong bur bya ba'i sbyor ba 'dzin pa'am sems dben gcig chod kyi nges pa la sbyar bar bya ba la/ dang po nyid du rten kyi gnad nges par bya ba'i 48—685

so gnyis 'dab ldan gsang ba'i pad+ma dag las 'di ni nus pas gyen 'gro zhing / /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i 'dab ma'i bdag nyid lte ba'i chu skyes las kyang steng du ste/ /dri med 'dab ma brgyad ldan snying ga'i pad+ma mgrin pa brgyad gnyis 'dab can dang / /mgo bo gsang ba mtshungs pa dag ni 'dab ma bzhi pa tshangs pa'i bug pa la'o/ /spyod pa'i mdzod las so// 1da //de ltar shes nas zla nyi rang lam du bcings te tsā da sgra gcan gyi lam du bzhengs pa'i srog rtsol gyi sbyor ba rlung sngags gnyis med kyi de kho na nyid mthar thug pa la gdams pa'i rtsa ba'i mdo ni/ bsgyupad+māsanamadharatobāyumākṛpyagā dhedatāhastadwanyiyamarutosgyuṇabakajiṅgāya—/ dordabhāsgyusgyunayugalakedreḍite margyawāhārgaṭa kar+ṣaduparipunaruṅgāmyatepāṇabāta/ pad+ma'i gdan ni bcing zhing de las mthu yis 'og gi rlung bkug nas/ /rlung rnams la ni lag gnyis byin te sna dang mchu dag sdams nas ni/ /lag ngar gnyis kyis nu ma zung la 'thems par gtod de dbugs kyi rgyun/ /steng du drag por phyir zhing bkug las srog rlung yon po 'pho bar 'gyur/ /bi busgyu ka ra'i zhal snga nas te// 24 //btsan thabs thun mong ma yin pa la pad+ma'i gdan zhes pa 'oka gi pad+ma'i gnas bcing ba sogs so/ /de'i phyir phyag rgya srog rtsol gyi yan lag gi rtsa ba yang ngo / /de ltar srog rtsol lam rdo rje bzlas pa'i sbyor ba thun mong ma yin pas nyi zla sgra gcan gyi lto bar btsan thabs su rengs pa de nyid du/ srog thur gyi byed pa nye bar gnas pa'i dbang las me chu'i bya ba bzlog⑥par dka' ba dka /btsan thabs su gong bur bya ba'i sbyor ba 'dzin pa'am sems dben gcig chod kyi nges pa la sbyar bar bya ba la/ dang po nyid du rten gyi gnad nges par bya ba'i 48—686

mdo ni/ marar+ṇabin+d+rapāten dzībarna①ban+d+rad+maraṇatra/ sidhebirdomahārasnesat+tha sedhiḥpradzāyate—/ thig le ltung gyur na ni 'chi ba ste/ /thig le 'dzin pa nyid ni 'tsho ba'o/ /rin chen chen po thig le grub gyur na/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bi rū pāk+ṣa'i zhabs kyis so// 15 //rin chen chen por sgrub pa'i dus gnad la gdams pa'i mdo ni/ut+yādemṛkyukāletsami⑦thuṣ+peshukrabāhibhā—/ tamirītsabahakyurteshaṃkrāsnebishu be+etsabe+eḥ—/ skye dang 'chi dang 'khrig pa dang / /nyi ma'i 'pho ba bi shu be'i/ /dus la khu ba'i lam dang ni/ /mun can lam yang steng du'o/ /se kod de sha 'babazhi sreg 16 /cho ga dngos la yang dag par mdoms pa'i mdo gsang gnas kyi 'dzin pa gcig chod kyi nges pa mthar thug pa'i rtsa ba ni/ nabababananirodz+nyāspyaṇabātenirudhe.inyishatibhayaṭītai bhūny-ibrar+ghaṃsnebilokya—/ swayamanubhabarūpaḥmāṇanāthophotha bidz+nyābradzatikhasamabhāwaṃdīr+ghanārdabimudz+re—/ rlung ni dgu bo bkag ④las 'di ltar srog gi rlung ni 'gog pa la/ /klags rnyed na ni 'byung po'i tshogs kyis 'jigs pa ster bar rnam ltas nas/ /rang nyid dang ba'i gzugs dang de nas zig ler srog gi mgon po ste/ /nā da ring ba steng du drangs las mkha' mnyam dngos po thob par 'gyur/ /pa ra mo pa de she ti// 17 //'di nyid ni steng du 'gyur ba drug gi gnad dang sbyar ba las ting nge 'dzin nam zung 'jug gi rim pa'i sbyor ba gcig chod kyi rtsa bar yang 'gyur te/ rdo rje nyi ma'ang zhes sogs rdo rje'i tshig gi nges pa dang sbyar ro/ /spyor ba 'di nyid cung zad brtan ⑤nam mgo rtsam yang rung rgyun kyi sbyor bas bogs 'byin zhing / /48—686

mdo ni/ maraḍibinupāten dzībadz+wa⑫banudh+waraṇ+ḍatra/ sidhejirdomahārasnesaza sirnyiḥpradzāyate/ thig le ltung gyur na ni 'chi ba ste/ /thig le 'dzin pa nyid ni 'tsho ba'o/ /rin chen chen po thig le grub gyur na/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /be rū pāk+ṣa'i zhabs kyis so// 15 //rin chen chen por sgrub pa'i dus gnad la gdams pa'i mdo ni/kuṅgādemṛkyukāletsami②thuneshukrabātitī| tamirītsabahakyurteshaṃkrāsnebeshu betsabeḥ—/ skye dang 'chi dang 'khrig pa dang / /nyi ma'i 'pho ba bi shu be'i/ /dus la khu ba'i lam dang ni/ /nun can lam yang steng du'o/ /se kod de sha 'a sa da 16 //cho ga dngos la yang dag par mdoms pa'i mdo gsang gnas kyi 'dzin pa gcig chod kyi nges pa mthar thug pa'i rtsa ba ni/ nabababananirotswaspruṇabātenirudheyinyishatibhayajite sgruny-ibrahūṃ②jilokya1 suyamanubhabarūpaḥpāṇanātho3tha birdobradzatikhasamabhāwaṃdīr+ghanārdabimusgyu1 rlung ni dgu bo bkag ④las 'di ltar srog gi rlung ni 'gog pa la/ /klags rnyed na ni 'byung po'i tshogs kyis 'jigs pa ster bar rnam ltas nas/ /rang nyid dang ba'i gzugs dang de nas thig ler srog gi mgon po ste/ /rā da ring ba steng du drangs las mkha' mnyam dngos po thob par 'gyur/ /pa ra mo pa de she ti// 17 //'di nyid ni steng du 'gyur ba drug gi gnad dang sbyar ba las ting nge 'dzin nam zung 'jug gi rim pa'i sbyor ba gcig chod kyi rtsa bar yang 'gyur te/ rdo rje nyi ma'ang zhes sogs rdo rje'i tshig gi nges pa dang sbyar ro/ /sbyor ba 'di nyid cung zad brtan ⑤nam mgo rtsam yang rung rgyun gyi sbyor bas bogs 'byin zhing / /48—686

gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'chi ba las rgyal ba thob par 'gyur ba'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsa ba'i mdo ni/ yaḥpardupakās na yutatanuḥstasta kekāladaṇ+ḍaḥ kṛtwabayorayugalabahane+ekarmakud+madajiṣaṇi/ ākulhartsu rgudabaribhubārtsuḍiyānasabarnyakribyusrunuparigalatoghaṣ+ṭakaran+d+rayogata—/ yisba bātābh+yasanajirnyitsākar+ṣaṇitsobarīteswārnyilahūṃdrabhabatiyadābibyudasgo3nilo3smata—/ewaṃtsajirbimalasasukhaderlojikātaḥ brasrutesubyuṭīṭanitsayamaṇishaṃtarbayet+tathāne+eḥgang zhig skyil krung ⑫gdan ldan lus kyi sgal tshigs dbyug pa rengs par ni/ /byas nas 'byung nga ga rlung dag yang dang yang du sbyor ba'i las bya ste/ /bshad pa'i gnas yongs btsum las gyen du drang zhing o ḍi yā gnas bsdam/ /srog rnams steng du bkug las mgrin pa'i dril chung bu gar no bar bya// 18 //'di lhar rlung ni cho ga goms par bkug pas rang dbang nyid du ni/ /rab 'byung 'ang ba gang tshe rlung ni glog dang 'dra bar 'gyur de las/ /'di lhar dri med bde ba ster ba'i zla ba lce'u chung las 'bab pas/ /bskams pa'i rtsa tshogs nyin dang mang du nga bya de bzhin bza' bas so/ /bi burtse ka ro pa de she ti// 1( //'di ni zla ba rjes dran gyi rtsa ba'ang yin zhing / btsan thabs kyi 'byung po dgu 'gog gi gnad dang sbyar bas 'dzin pa'i khyad par du 'gyur ba'o/ /'dzin pa'am sems dben btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba de nyid las/ rjes dran nam sgyu lus kyi rim pa'i sbyor ba yang dag par bcing ba la sbyar ba'i mdo ni/ yā brjopatatiprabhāsuramayaḥ shīhūṃshutsārādrwabodedīpad+madalongaresamarasīspru tong rmāgaṇiḥ sprurdzadwadz+rashikhrogrataṅkarūṇayāsnyin+dañjagaṅgārartetābasnakarushābal phyas 48—687

gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'chi ba las rgyal ba thob par 'gyur ba'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsa ba'i mdo ni/ yaḥpa:pakās na yutatanuḥstabha rkakāladaṇ+ḍaḥ kṛtwabayorayugalabaharnakarmakur+yadabiṣar+ṇa/ ākurmi: rgudabaribhubāsh+yaḍiyānasabasmrakri6srunuparigalatoghaṣ+ṭakaran+d+rayogata—/ isba bātābh+yasanabe+edhinākar+ṣaṇitsobanīteswāsgolatwodrabhabatiyadābidrudasgophonilophosmata—/ewaṃtsadh+rirbimalasasukhadezlobikātaḥ brasrutesu6:ṭanitsayamaṇishaṃtarbayet+tathāṣ+peḥgang zhig skyil krung ①gdan ldan lus kyi sgal tshigs dbyug pa rengs par ni/ /byas nas 'byung 'jug rlung dag yang dang yang du sbyor ba'i las bya ste/ /bshad pa'i gnas yongs btsum las gyen du drang zhing o ḍi yā gnas bsdam/ /srog rnams steng du bkug las mgrin pa'i dril chung bu gar rno bar bya// 18 //'di ltar rlung ni cho ga goms par bkug pas rang dbang nyid du ni/ /rab 'byung 'gyur ba gang tshe rlung ni glog dang 'dra bar 'gyur de las/ /'di ltar dri med bde ba ster ba'i zla ba lce'u chung las 'bab pas/ /bskams pa'i rtsa tshogs nyin dang mtshan du tshim bya de bzhin bza' bas so/ /bi budha ka ro pa de she ti// 19 //'di ni zla ba rjes dran gyi rtsa ba'ang yin zhing / btsan thabs kyi 'byung po dgu 'gog gi gnad dang sbyar bas 'dzin pa'i khyad par du 'gyur ba'o/ /'dzin pa'am sems dbe+en btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba de nyid las/ rjes dran nam sgyu lus kyi rim pa'i sbyor ba yang dag par bcing ba la sbyar ba'i mdo ni/ yā brjopatatiprabhāsuramayaḥ shīhūṃshudz+nyārādrwabodebīpad+madalongaresamarasībyu todzanīrmāgaṇiḥ sbyardzadwadz+rashirjagrataṅkarūṇayārnyin+dañjagaṭ+wāraṇitābasbyikaruṇ+ḍabal sus 48—687

hadzalnganīhirūbam+bisgoḥ—/ ji srid ma lhung ba na 'od gsal las byung bsel ba'i 'od zer rgyun 'bab pas/ /lha mo'i pad+ma'i spubs su rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams kyis ni ro mnyam gyur/ /rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor snying rje tha dad min las khyab par 'gro ba'i rgyu/ /de srid dpal ldan snying rje stobs te khyab bdag gzugs la lhan skyes shes par byos/ /dge ba'i mgon po'i zhal snga nas te// 20 //gang zhig phyag rgya gcig sbyor dang zhes sogs rdo rje'i tshig gi nges pa dang sbyar ro/ /ji ltar rjes su dran par bya ba'i mdo ni/ prabirtirbanibirtir+pāṣ+pe bstemanasaḥtadwa—/ sweyamebayadārūpaṃdzagat+pabaṃprakāshate/ phyin ci log pa 'am ma log pa/ /de tshe yid ni med pa nyid/ /gang tshe rang gi gzugs 'di nyid/ /'gro ba thams cad bar snang 'gyur/ /ār+ya de ba'i zhal snga nas te// 21 //lce rtse rkan sbyar zhes sogs rdo rje'i tshig gis bstan pa'i mkha' khyab sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i man ngag gi rtsa ba'o/ /de'i phyir rang byin gyis brlab pa nyid kyi lam du bsgod pa gcig pa rtsa ba'i nges par 'gyur ba'i mdo ni/ ātshwanā drehriyatradz+nyārnakaṣ+ṭhadz+nyārnaprasakhyate—/ b.resamādhimasgosaupunar+pānābhawayatu/ye shes mi shes nyid yin na/ /shing ni ye shes dag tu 'gyur/ /be+er yang nyams su myong gyur pa'i/ /ting 'dzin 'di ni lam mchog yin/ /'di yang 'phags pa lha'i zhal snga nas te// 22 //chad pa dang bems po'i stong pa nyid snang med las gzhan so so rang gis nyams su stsong ba nyid lam dngos yin par gsal bar bstan pa las/ snang ba sgyu ma'i rjes dran gyi rtsa ba yang ngo / /gnas 'di la zla ba rab 'byam gyi thig le'i 48—688

hadzatshidīhirūbam+bisgoḥ—/ ji srid ma lhung ba na 'od gsal las byung bsil ba'i 'od zer rgyun 'bab pas/ /lha mo'i pad+ma'i spubs su rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams kyis ni ro mnyam gyur/ /rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor snying rje tha dad min las khyab par 'gro ba'i rgyu/ /de srid dpal ldan snying rje stobs te khyab bdag gzugs la lhan skyes shes par byos/ /dge ba'i mgon po'i zhal snga nas te// 2༷ //gang zhig phyag rgya gcig sbyor dang zhes sogs rdo rje'i tshig gi nges pa dang sbyar ro/ /ji ltar rjes su dran par bya ba'i mdo ni/ prajirtirbanijirtir+pāni bsnyimanasaḥtadwa1 sīyamebayadārūpaṃdzagat+pabaṃprakāshate/ phyin ci log pa 'am ma log pa/ /de tshe yid ni med pa nyid/ /kang tshe rang gi gzugs 'di nyid/ /'gro ba thams cad bar snang 'gyur/ /ār+ya de ba'i zhal snga nas te// 21 //lce rtse rkan sbyar zhes sogs rdo rje'i tshig gis bstan pa'i mkha' khyab sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i man ngag gi rtsa ba'o/ /de'i phyir rang byin gyis brlab pa nyid kyi lam du bsgrod pa gcig pa rtsa ba'i nges par 'gyur ba'i mdo ni/ ātsātsā drehriyatradz+nyāne+ekaṣ+ṭhatshwane+eprasagyate—/ b.ram̐samādhimarnyesaupunaṅgātsābhawayatu/ye shes mi shes nyid yin na/ /shing ni ye shes dag tu 'gyur/ /slar yang nyams su myong gyur pa'i/ /ting 'dzin 'di ni lam mchog yin/ /'di yang 'phags pa lha'i zhal snga nas te// 22 //chad pa dang bems po'i stong pa nyid snang med las gzhan so so rang gis nyams su myong ba nyid lam dngos yin par gsal bar bstan pa las/ snang ba sgyu ma'i rjes dran gyi rtsa ba yang ngo / /gnas 'di la zla ba rab 'byam gyi thig le'i 48—688

nges pa gsungs te/ nyi ma dang / sgra gcan yang shes par bya ba'o/ /'di shes nas thams cad du byed pa bcing ba la yang dag par sbyar ba'i mdo ni/uXṣenim+biṣetsāpisubyanadzasum̐taṣebatsa—/ gastsotirjahāsaṃbhūñjimāyādahamanusmaretra/mig phye ba dang btsums pa dang / /gnyid logs pa dang de bzhin du'ang / /'gro gnas rgod dang za ba na/ /sgyu ma'i sku ni rjes dran bya/ /ār+ya de ba'i ste// 2na //rdor sems dang po'i mgon po rjes dran byi rtsa ba yang ngo / /'di las mtha' rnam par bsal te/ mnyam rjes ris med par khams gsum pa'i brtan g.yo rang bzhin gye tshul las nges pa'i lhar slong ba'i rtsa ba'i man ngag gi mdo ni/māyāswasnanir+bhasasbatrem rkyusatsarātsarā.itiṣ+pewasam+bik+ṣadhekār+yakār+yalcayoginaḥ—/ dza latsan+d+ranir+bhasazamasardzutaidzagat+payo.itikurbarnyinibāsngeswasharirephopiyoginaḥ—/'jig rten gsum po rgyu dang mi rgyur bcas/ /thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam dang mtshungs par/ /blta bar mi byed nyid na rnal 'byor pa'i/ /bya dang bya ba min pa'ang de ltar ro// 24 //'gro ba gsum po chu zla dang mtshungs kyi/ /thams cad med pa nyid du grur to zhes/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis ni mi bya ba/ /nyid ni rang gi lus kyi gnad skabs la'ang / 'di yang ār+ya de ba'i ste// 25 //dum bu ma yin dkyil 'khor gyi/ /rnam pa gang gis brtan g.yo khyab/ /ces sogs rdo rje'i tshig gi nges pa dang sbyar ro/ /bdag nyid la nges pa'i lha mngon du gyur nas phyi rol gyi lha la zhen pa spang zhing phyag sogs la ji ltar sbyar ba'i mdo ni/ kāṣ+ṭhapāṣanamṛdrebānananamet+pahadzāt+pakaḥ tan+d+rabhabobiburnyarlot+ta 48—689

nges pa gsungs te/ nyi ma dang / sgra gcan yang shes par bya ba'o/ /'di shes nas thams cad du byed pa bcing ba la yang dag par sbyar ba'i mdo ni/ud+maṣenismiṣetsāpisubyanadzalgitaṣebatsa—/ gaphyutiṣ+pehāsaṃbyuhūṃmāyādahamanusmaretra/mig phye ba dang btsums pa dang / /gnyid logs pa dang de bzhin du'ang / /'gro gnas rgod dang za ba na/ /sgyu ma'i sku ni rjes dran bya/ /ār+ya de ba'i ste// 2da //rdor sems dang po'i mgon po rjes dran gyi rtsa ba yang ngo / /'di las mtha' rnam par bsal te/ mnyam rjes ris med par khams gsum pa'i brtan g.yo rang bzhin gyi tshul las nges pa'i lhar slong ba'i rtsa ba'i man ngag gi mdo ni/māyāswasnanilhasasprutrelo ā+oṃsatsarātsarā.itine+ewasasbok+ṣarnyekād+makārlalcayoginaḥ| dza latsan+d+ranihūṃsazamasan+d+ratedzagasgroyi.itikurbarnyinibāsngosusharirehwapiyoginaḥ—/'jig rten gsum po rgyu dang mi rgyur bcas/ /thams cad sgyu ma mi lam dang mtshungs par/ /blta bar mi byed nyid na rnal 'byor pa'i/ /bya dang bya ba min pa'ang de ltar ro// 24 //'gro ba gsum po chu zla dang mtshungs kyi/ /thams cad med pa nyid du gyur to zhes/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis ni mi bya ba/ /nyid ni rang gi lus kyi gnad skabs la'ang / 'di yang ār+ya de ba'i ste// 25 //dum bu ma yin dkyil 'khor gyi/ /rnam pa gang gis brtan g.yo khyab/ /ces sogs rdo rje'i tshig gi nges pa dang sbyar ro/ /bdag nyid la nges pa'i lha mngon du gyur nas phyi rol gyi lha la zhen pa spang zhing phyag sogs la ji ltar sbyar ba'i mdo ni/ kaṣ+ṭhapāṣanabṛdrebānananamet+pahadzāblokaḥ taṅgābhabojiburnyahūṃt+ta 48—689

n+d+raṇ+ḍamonadhūyate—/ rdo shing 'jim pa'i lha rnams la/ /lhan skyes bdag pos phyag mi bya/ /de yi rang bzhin rtogs pa na/ /de la phyag byas nyes mi 'gyur/ /ār+ya de ba'i ste/ 'dod yon gyi rnam pa thams cad dus thams cad pa'i mchod par bya ba'i rtsa ba yod do// 26 //gnas skabs 'di nyid du ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag gi sbyor ba'am 'od gsal gye rim pa spyod pa'i rjes su mthun pa sgrub pa'i sgo la spyir gdams pa'i mdo ni/ praṇibadz+radharaḥkapālibanitātuspyodzagatrastedzanaḥsohaṃherukasprustereṣa bhagawanayonuprarnyirjomayi—/ pad+masmadanañcagokudatargokurbanuyathāgorabā detat+padze+ematīdh+riyeṇamanasāyogishwaraḥsergyatī—/ 'gro ba gsum po mtshungs par srog chags rdo rje 'chang dang bud med rnams ni thod pa can/ /nye ru ka yi sku de nga nyid 'di ni bcom ldan ma gang tha dad min bdag la/ /bud med pad+ma chang dang go ku da ha na yis ji lta ba bzhin rim gro bgyi/ /'di las kun du dbang po 'pho ba min pa'i yid kyis rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'grub par 'gyur—/ /sum̐ ḍa rī pa'i zhabs kyis te// 27 //dus thams cad pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag gi rtsa ba yang ngo / /kun du dbang po mi 'pho ba'i nges pa la ji ltar sbyar ba'i mdo ni/ pri yāsaṅgah+phubaṃyadidamātaṣ+ṭakisukhaṃtadebe+edānortsuṅkamitibaramudārnyigamarna—/ i hastesaṃbidāswasukhabiṣayādargyudaparam̐tataḥkopikhon+yaḥsahadzasukhasaṃbyuḥprabhabati—/sngon du dga' mar 'khyud ①pa gang de shin tu bde de nyid yin na/ /da ni mchog gi phyag rgya dag la mnyam par 'khyud pa zhes bya ci/ /gzhan pa yang dag rig pa'am rang gi bde ba yul las gzhan min na/ /lhan skyes bde ba bdag 48byed690

t+thaṇ+ḍamonad+mayate1 rdo shing 'jim pa'i lha rnams la/ /lhan skyes bdag pos phyag mi bya/ /de yi rang bzhin rtogs pa na/ /de la phyag byas nyes mi 'ang / /nga de ba'i ste/ 'dod yon gyi rnam pa thams cad dus thams cad pa'i mang par bya ba'i rtsa ba yod do// 26 //gnas skabs 'di nyid du nying nge 'dzin gyi yan lag gi sbyor ba'am 'od gsal gyi rim pa spyod pa'i rjes su mthun pa sgrub pa'i sgo la spyir gdams pa'i mdo ni/ praṇibadz+radharaḥkapālibanitātuspyodzagatrasnyidzanaḥsohaṃterukasprurtereṣa bhagawanayonuprarnyirjomayi1 pad+masmradanalcagokudatane+ekurbanuyathāgorabā detat+pablomatījiyeṇamanasāyogishāraḥsirgyatī—/ 'gro ba gsum po mtshungs par srog chags rdo rje 'chang dang bud med rnams ni thod pa can/ /te ru ka yi sku de nga nyid 'di ni bcom ldan ma gang tha dad min bdag la/ /bud med pad+ma chang dang go ku da ha na yis ji lta ba bzhin rim gro bgyi/ /'di las kun du dbang po 'pho ba min pa'i yid kyis rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'grub par 'gyur—/ /rgu ḍa rī pa'i zhabs kyis te// 27 //dus thams cad pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag gi rtsa ba yang ngo / /kun du dbang po mi 'pho ba'i nges pa la ji ltar sbyar ba'i mdo ni/ pre yāsaṅgatrubaṃyadidamātartsekisukhaṃtadeberānirtsut+pamitibaranudrwarnyigamane+e—/ yi hastesaṃbidāswasukhajiṣayādan+d+radaparetataḥkopikhon+yaḥsahadzasukhasaṃspruḥprabhabati—/sngon du dga' mar 'khyud ①pa gang de shin tu bde de nyid yin na/ /da ni mchog gi phyag rgya dag la mnyam par chag pa zhes bya ci/ /gzhan pa yang dag rig pa'am rang gi bde ba yul las gzhan min na/ /lhan skyes bde ba bdag 48nga 690

por 'gyur te de nas su yang gzhan zhig yin/ /'di yang rgu ḍa rī pa'i zhabs kyi ste// 28 //bsam gtan ris med dam/ /bde chen gcig chod kyi man ngag gi rtsa ba yang ngo / /nges pa 'di nyid ting nge 'dzin gyi gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu'i sbyor ba'am zung 'jug gi rim pa rjes mthun pa sgrub pa'i mdo ni/ su bhaḥpraburnyi.itetartsedabastadwayabardzite—/ yuganadzhabat+yar+shasgyusupabodzhajibardzite/gnyid log sad pa zhes 'di las/ /gnyis kyi gnas skabs rnams spangs pa1 /rmi lam sad pa rnam par bral/ /zung 'jug bstan par brjod pa yin//klu spub kyi zhal snga nas te// 29 //gnyid 'thug 'od gsal dang / mi lam sgyu mar 'ching ba'i man ngag gi rtsa ba yang ngo / /de nas thams cad du blang dor la sogs pa'i ris su bcad pa mtha' dag la ltos pa med par ris med zung 'jug gi dbyings ji lha ba la yang dag par sbyar ba'i mdo ni/ saṃsārohwastenatatwatastanusgrotāsbartsesubāstibakābasto yatranayātitatrajitathānuk+taphyanurtikriyā—/ isgyuropyakṛto3tharadzubhudzagatshuyapishātsabha mokiṭīt+yadzamākṛhāṇajilasaswesmoyabābastatiḥ—/ de nyid du na 'khor ba yod pa min na lus can rnams ni 'ching ba smra ba ci/ /gang du 'ching ba med na grol zin de la grol ba'i bya ba brdzun pa nyid du 'gyur/ /thag pa sbrul dang grib ma sha zar 'jil pa bzhin du sgro btags pas ni byas des na/ /cung zad dor bar mi bya blang mi bgyi ste rang nyams ji lta ba bzhin gsal bar gnas/ /klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas te// daX //srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba mthar thug pa'i rtsa ba yang ngo / /de ltar na 48—691

por 'gyur te de nas su yang gzhan zhig yin/ /'di yang sum̐ ḍa rī pa'i zhabs kyi ste// 28 //bsam gtan ris med dam/ /bde chen gcig chod kyi man ngag gi rtsa ba yang ngo / /nges pa 'di nyid ting nge 'dzin byi gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu'i sbyor ba'am zung 'jug gi rim pa rjes mthun pa sgrub pa'i mdo ni/ su p+taḥpraburta.itetadhadabastadwayabardzitai—/ yuganadzhabat+yar+shastuswapabodzhabibardzitai/gnyid log sad pa zhes 'di las/ /gnyis kyi gnas skabs rnams spangs pa—/ /rmi lam sad pa rnam par bral/ /zung 'jug bstan par brjod pa yin//klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas te// 29 //gnyid 'thug 'od gsal dang / rmi lam sgyu mar 'ching ba'i man ngag gi rtsa ba yang ngo / /de nas thams cad du blang dor la sogs pa'i ris su bcad pa mtha' dag la ltos pa med par ris med zung 'jug gi dbyings ji lta ba la yang dag par sbyar ba'i mdo ni/ saṃsārolhastenatatwatastanubh+ritāsbrarnyasubān+tibakābasto yatranayātitatrabitathāmuk+tasumut+takriyā—/ it+yāropyakṛtophotharatshubyudzagatshuyapishātsabha moki—t+yadzamākṛhāṇabilasaswestsoyathābastatiḥ—/ de nyid du na 'khor ba yod pa min na lus can rnams ni 'ching ba smra ba ci/ /gang du 'ching ba med na grol zin de la grol ba'i bya ba brdzun pa nyid du 'gyur/ /thag pa sbrul dang grib ma sha zar 'khrul pa bzhin du sgo btags pas ni byas des na/ /cung zad dor bar mi bya blang mi bgyi ste rang nyams ji lta ba bzhin gsal bar gnas/ /klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas te// 0 //srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba mthar thug pa'i rtsa ba yang ngo / /de ltar na 48—691

sbyor ba de mtha' dag bsam gtan gyi yan lag tu spyad pas/ bsam gtan yan lag drug ldan gyi sgo las spyan gnyis kyi bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa mngon sum dang po'i ngo bo nyid du skyes pa na/ sbyor ba de nyid rlung dang thig le'i byed pa gtso bor bcings pa la gnad du btang bas/ tshogs chung ngus yan lag phyi ma rnams kyang yan lag drug ldan du grub pa las mngon par rtogs pa'i ngo bo nyid du skyes te/ spyan dang mngon sum phyi ma gsum bde blag tu mngon du gyur pa'i rim gyis sangs rgyas nyid dang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub kyi mthar thug par 'gyur ba zhes bya ba 'di yin no/ /nges pa 'di nyid pha rgyud kyi lam srol la rdzogs rim pa'i lus dben khyad par can rang byin rlabs su/rim pa phyi ma rnams kyi gnad bcings pas/ rim pa khongs su bsdu ba'i man ngag tu gyur te/ so so'i 'bras bu la tshogs chung ngus sbyor ba'i thabs mkhas su 'gyur ba dang gnad gcig pa ni/ dang po'i sangs rgyas kyis rgyud thams cad kyi rdo rje'i tshig mngon du gyur par byas pa dang / sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog kha phye ba'i nges pa mthar thug pa de nyid las dang po pas kyang lag tu longs pa'i man ngag tu brtsal ba ste/ dpe zla thams cad dang bral ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po pa'i gter la rang dbang bar byas pa'am/ dbul po btsan thabs su 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyi bde ba la bag yangs su sbyar ba dag yin no/ /'di la yang brtson 'grus can mthong ba'i chos nyid la lcags la sman chen po'i sbyor bas gser du bya ba ltar ye shes kyi sku mngon du bya ba dang / ma nus na 'dzin pa gcig chod kyi gnad las btsan thabs kyi 'pho bas 'chi srid gtsug tor gyi 'dzin pa'am sems dben du bsgrubs te/ las mtha' rnam par 48—692

sbyor ba de mtha' dag bsam gtan gyi yan lag tu spyad pas/ bsam gtan yan lag drug ldan gyi sgo las spyan gnyis kyi bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa mngon sum dang po'i ngo bo nyid du skyes pa na/ sbyor ba de nyid rlung dang thig le'i byed pa gtso bor bcings pa la gnad du btang bas/ tshogs chung ngus yan lag phyi ma rnams kyang yan lag drug ldan du grub pa las mngon par rtogs pa'i ngo bo nyid du skyes te/ spyan dang mngon sum phyi ma gsum bde blag tu mngon du gyur pa'i rim kyis sangs rgyas nyid dang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub kyi mthar thug par 'gyur ba zhes bya ba 'di yin no/ /nges pa 'di nyid pha rgyud kyi lam srol la rdzogs rim pa'i lus dben khyad par can rang byin rlabs su/rim pa phyi ma rnams kyi gnad bcings pas/ rim pa khongs su bsdu ba'i man ngag tu gyur te/ so so'i 'bras bu la tshogs chung ngus sbyor ba'i thabs mkhas su 'gyur ba dang gnad gcig pa ni/ dang po'i sangs rgyas kyis rgyud thams cad kyi rdo rje'i tshig mngon du gyur par byas pa dang / sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog kha phye ba'i nges pa mthar thug pa de nyid las dang po pas kyang lag tu longs pa'i man ngag tu brtsal ba ste/ dpe zla thams cad dang bral ba'i yid bzhin gye nor bu rin po che'i gter la rang dbang bar byas pa'am/ dbul po btsan thabs su 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyi bde ba la bag yangs su sbyar ba dag yin no/ /'di la yang brtson 'grus can mthong ba'i chos nyid la lcags la sman chen po'i sbyor bas gser du bya ba ltar ye shes kyi sku mngon du bya ba dang / ma nus na 'dzin pa gcig chod kyi gnad las btsan thabs kyi 'pho bas 'chi srid gtsug tor gyi 'dzin pa'am sems dben du bsgrubs te/ las mtha' rnam par 48—692

phye nas sgyu ma lta bu'i lus su langs pa'i mkha' spyod kyi rten la yan lag gam rim pas phyi ma gnyis spyod pa'i ngo bo nyid du bsgrubs pas ye shes kyi sku mngon du byed cing gong nas gong du bogs 'byen pa ste/ bla ma gcig rdzogs las mchog mngon du byed pa'i sgo yang rab tu gyur pa rnam pa gnyis so/ /'di mtha' dag kyang yang dag pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon dpal ldan bla ma tshul bzhin du bsnyen pa las gzhan pa'i thabs kyis rnyed pa ma yin no zhes zab mo dpal ldan bla ma'i lam rdzogs la 'doms pa'i mdo ni/ nabinābadz+raguruṇ+ḍasar+bhakleshaprahāṇakaḥnithārdepararmashān+tamabai brnyi kamāstayāḥ/ rdo rje'i bla ma spangs nas ni/ /nyon mongs thams cad spangs pa dang / /mchog tu zhi zhing mi ldog pa'i/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur/ /ri khrod zhabs kyi zhal snga nas so// 32 //gnas 'di lta bu la nan tan du byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa skal ba mchog tu gyur pa dag gis/ spros pa dang bya ba thams cad btang ste ting nge 'dzin gye gnas pa 'ba' zhig gis gnas pa la gcig tu brtul ba brtan par bya ba'i mdo ni—/ ishādz+nyānābh+yasitamanashoyoginoṣ+pebayuk+ṇinyik+ṣukṛtram̐natsababahutaram̐sgodzan ram̐pinidra—/ nobagayonatsahaṭhabashaḥ bāyuroṭinapāṭhaḥ pūdzāhomādikam pitathāt+yār+yam smisamāyo/ ye shes goms byed rnal 'byor pa yi yid ni 'di ltar rigs min nyid/ /slong ba bgyid dang shin tu mang po'i bza' ba dang ni gnyid kyang ste/ /myur ba'i dbang las mang du smra dang sgra sgogs rlung dang klog pa dang //mchod dang sbyin sreg sogs kyang de bzhin spang bya 'dir ni ting nge 'dzin pa'o/ /bi bud+dhā ka ra'i zhal snga nas so// 33 //de ltar rnal 'byor pha ma'i rgyud gnyis kyi nges pa mthar thug pa mchog gi 48—693

bye nas sgyu ma lta bu'i lus su langs pa'i mkha' spyod kyi rten la yan lag gam rim pas phyi ma gnyis spyod pa'i ngo bo nyid du baspubs pas ye shes kyi sku mngon du byed cing gong nas gong du bogs 'byin pa ste/ bla ma gcig rdzogs las mchog mngon du byed pa'i sgo yang rab tu gyur pa rnam pa gnyis so/ /'di mtha' dag kyang yang dag pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon dpal ldan bla ma tshul bzhin du bsnyen pa las gzhan pa'i thabs kyis rnyed pa ma yin no zhes zab mo dpal ldan bla ma'i lam rdzogs la 'doms pa'i mdo ni/ nabitsābadz+raguruṇ+ḍasasprukleshaprahāṇakaḥniṅgārteparasaṃshārnyamabai brnyi kamāstayāḥ/ rdo rje'i bla ma spangs nas ni/ /nyon mongs thams cad spangs pa dang / /mchog tu zhi zhing mi ldog pa'i/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur/ /ri khrod zhabs kyi zhal snga nas so// da2 //gnas 'di lta bu la nan tan du byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa skal ba mchog tu gyur pa dag gis/ spros pa dang bya ba thams cad btang ste ting nge 'dzin gyi gnas pa 'ba' zhig gis gnas pa la gcig tu brtul ba brtan par bya ba'i mdo ni—/ ishātshwatsābh+yasitamanashoyoginone+ebayultenyiṭākṛhūṃnatsababahutarestodzan dzāpinidra—/ nobasgayonatsahazabashaḥ bāyuroṭinapāṭhaḥ pūdzāhomādikam pitathāt+yār+yam smisamāyo/ ye shes goms byed rnal 'byor pa yi yid ni 'di ltar rigs min nyid/ /slong ba bgyid dang shin tu mang po'i bza' ba dang ni gnyid kyang ste/ /myur ba'i dbang las mang du smra dang sgra sgrogs rlung dang klog pa dang //mchod dang sbyin sreg sogs kyang de bzhin spang bya 'dir ni ting nge 'dzin pa'o/ /ji busgyu ka ra'i zhal snga nas so// 33 //de ltar rnal 'byor pha ma'i rgyud gnyis kyi nges pa mthar thug pa mchog gi 48—693

dang ⑫po'i sangs rgyas kyis yang dag par gsal bar byas pa las brtsams nas/thams cad kyang mthar thug gi zhi sgo gcig la yang dag par sbyor ba gnad gcig pa gsal bar lag tu longs pa'i lam gcig rdzogs/ ri khrod zhabs kyi gshegs shul la rje btsun rang nyid kyis kyang mngon par bsgrod pa'i byin rlabs kyi nye lam thun mong ma yin pa/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa mtha' dag gi snying po las kyang snying por gyur pa'i gdams pa 'di snyed cig /grub pa'i dbang phyug mgo bh+ya badz+ras kyi zhal snga nas slob bshad du bstsal ba'i man ngag gi dbang po'i lung skabs ji lta ba'i rtsa tshig tu'ang sbyar nas gsung ba rnams bsgyud pas 'jigs pa las/ rje nyid kyi bzhed pa ji lta bar bal yul ye rang gi 'dab dpal go ji tsan+d+ra'i gtsug lag khang dang / mchod rten go ma sa'i drung shārnya stu ri gsang ba mchog gi gnas la sogs par bsgyur te/ phyis mtshan ma khyad par can dang sbyar nas mtshams sbyor dang ming tho'i sa bon tsam dang spro'i dben gnas lhun grub snang zhes bya bar ri khrod pa rgya mtshos yi ger bgyis pa'o// //oṃ tsasmokaya/ āḥgud+mabāta/ prardosnalasu/ oṃ ka4ya/ āḥkaku/ hūṃ tsista dz+ratriganardobātrisgyu ya/ badz+rapad+me3graḥdzeti/ dhasmyo ka ya/ paspyaka ba rigaṅga/ niṣ+ṭa nishunastosrar+yak+ṣaḍihūṃ②—/ / //48—694

dang ①po'i sangs rgyas kyis yang dag par gsal bar byas pa las brtsams nas/thams cad kyang mthar thug gi zhi sgo gcig la yang dag par sbyor ba gnad gcig pa gsal bar lag tu longs pa'i lam gcig rdzogs/ ri khrod zhabs kyi gshegs shul la rje btsun rang nyid kyis kyang mngon par bsgod pa'i byen rlabs kyi nye lam thun mong ma yin pa/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa mtha' dag gi snying po las kyang snying por gyur pa'i gdams pa 'di snyed cig /grub pa'i dbang phyug asgo bh+ya badz+ras kyi zhal snga nas slob bshad du basprul ba'i man ngag gi dbang po'i lung skabs ji lta ba'i rtsa tshig tu'ang sbyar nas gsung ba rnams bskyud pas 'jigs pa las/ rje nyid kyi bzhed pa ji lta bar bal yul ye rang gi 'dab dpal go bi tsan+d+ra'i gtsug lag khang dang / mchod rten go ma sa'i drung shān+ta stu ri gsang ba mchog gi gnas la sogs par bsgyur te/ phyis mtshan ma khyad par can dang sbyar nas mtshalas sbyor dang ming tho'i sa bon tsam dang spro'i dben gnas lhun grub snang zhes bya bar ri khrod pa rgya mtshos yi ger bgyis pa'o// //oṃ tsan+t+rakraya/ āḥsrur+yabāta/ prardopālasu/ oṃ shādzhaya/ āḥwakra/ hūṃ tsit+ta dz+ratriganan+dabātribhā ya/ badz+rapad+mephograḥdzebha/ dhadz+re tā ya/ pa5ka ba rigaṅga/ niṣ+ṭa nijin—srar+yak+ṣaḍiṣ+ṭidu —/ / //48—694

)lha /grub pa'i dbang phyug paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shrī ba na rat+na'i zhal lung rin po che'i snying po'i phreng ba/①ra༅༅/ /rgya gar shar phyogs sad ga ra'i mkhas pa chen po/ mchog grub pa'i dbang phyug shrī ba na rat+na'i zhal gyi lung / ched du gdams pa kha 'thor ba dang bcas pa gnas skabs dang yang rung ba rnams su thos pa la/ prat+yak+ṣa shītaragiprak+ṣani1bhawadzakasmakhukarnyaka/ bhangatadzanabhawashan+tibhak+tabanarat+na homabiraḥsrid par skye ba'i nyon mongs rnyog pa rnams/ /rab tu bkrus las mngon sum chags bral ba/ /gnas brtan chen po nags kyi7rin chen la/ /srid pa zhi byed skye bos gus bsten kye/ /paṇ+ḍi ta chen po mi'i nyi mas ched du brjod pa'o// 1 //je dang por thun mong ma yin pa'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul la gdams pa/ltasā〈snaratsamāberatsayatimanaḥ satribishāṇ+ḍahotoḥ sriṅgā1sumasā'i shati 48wa 696

tshog /grub pa'i dbang phyug paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bhā ba na rat+na'i zhal lung rin po che'i snying po'i phreng ba/⑫ra / /rgya gar shar phyogs sadha ga ra'i mkhas pa chen po/ mchog grub pa'i dbang phyug shrī ba na radha'i zhal gyi lung / ched du gdams pa kha 'thor ba dang bcas pa gnas skabs dang yang rung ba rnams su thos pa la/ prat+yak+ṣa bītaragiprak+ṣanitabhawadzakasmakhakawaṃke—/ bhadzatadzanābhawasharnyibhadz+nyabanarat+na hosbabiraḥsrid par skye ba'i nyon mongs rnyog pa rnams/ /rab tu bkrus las mngon sum chags bral ba/ /gnas brtan chen po nags kyi ②rin chen la/ /srid pa zhi byed skye bos gus bsten kye/ /paṇ+ḍi ta chen po mi'i nyi mas ched du brjod pa'o// 1 //ji dang por thun mong ma yin pa'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul la gdams pa/yāsāsaṃsāratsashrījiratsayatimanaḥ saṭībeshār+ṣahetoḥ sīṅgād+masuprasādārnyishati 48nga 696

nidzazubaṃsuminonisprapahūṃ—/ tatsaprakyāt+pabepy-isamudayātisukhaṃkaphyanadzālanustekurlun+ta stsarnyipad+meshirasisajinayisargyoroḥ sasprukālaḥ/ yid ni don la mngon par zhen pa'i rgyu las 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rnam par bkra bar byed pa'i blo/ /gang yin de ni rje bo gang gi drin las spros pa med pa'i rang gi sa la rab tu 'jug /de yang rtog pa'i dra ba las grol yang dag bde bar char ⑫ba so so rang gis rig bya ba/ /bla ma dam pa de yi zhabs kyi pad+mar dul bar byas pa'i mgo bos rtag tu phyag bgyi'o//klu spub zhabs la sha ba ra dbang phyug gis so// 2 //de nas mi rtag pa nyid kyis nges par 'byung ba'i gnas la gdams pa'i phyir—/ yathāsragrabīturlebasnudzanaparibṛtobartsepuruṣezayānāsgyunipatatijiṣāde pratiparda—/ ebaṃtesnyogas+thādabisadibasormardunikāṭibradzartomāyuyibhabatabhabaiz-i stomanasaḥ gsad bya'i skyes bu me tog thod can rol mo dang ldan skye bo mang pos yongs bskor ba/ /gsod pa'i gnas su 'gro bzhin pa ni gom pa re res nyam ngar lhung ba ji lta bar/ /longs spyod gnas bcas rnams kye 'di ltar nyin re nyin res 'chi ba la ni nges brtun te/ /mngon par chas pa khyed rnams longs spyod dag gis yid la khengs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba ci/ /paṇ+ḍi ta bhat+pa ha ri'i gzhung las so/ da //ma brtags pa'i bsod nyams kyi chags pa dag las khyad par du yid 'byung bar bya ba la gdams pa/ āyurbar+ṣashany-in+d+rahūṃparimitetretotadhigateta sgyurnyidādz+nyamadz+nyamaparam̐bālatwabṛdhatwayoḥshejibyurnyibiyogayogaduḥkhasanyihaṃsebānithilngaṭī bebāritaraṅgatsalcalataresokhyekutaḥpātītsāḥ—/ mi rnams tshe tshad lo brgya nyid na'ang mtshan mo rnams kyis de'i byed song / /de la byed ni byis pa nyid de 48—697

nidzabyubaṃswaminonisprapasdi—/ tatsaprat+yāt+thabebyesamudayātisukhaṃkaphyanadzālamuk+ṇikur+yān+t+ra sgyurnyipad+meshirasisabinayisaṅgaroḥ sar+bhakālaḥ/ yid ni don la mngon par zhen pa'i rgyu las 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rnam par bkra bar byed pa'i blo/ /gang yin de ni rje bo gang gi drin las spros pa med pa'i rang gi sa la rab tu 'jug /de yang rtog pa'i dra ba las grol yang dag bde bar char ①ba so so rang gis rig bya ba/ /bla ma dam pa de yi zhabs kyi pad+mar dul bar byas pa'i mgo bos rtag tu phyag bgyi'o//klu sgrub zhabs la sha ba ra dbang phyug gis so// 2 //de nas mi rtag pa nyid kyis nges par 'byung ba'i gnas la gdams pa'i phyir—/ yathāsragrabīturlebasnudzanaparidṛtobadhapuruṣephrayānās+thānipatatibiṣāde pratiparda—/ ebaṃhesgogas+thādabisadibasormardunikāṭibradzarnyomāyuyobhabatabhabaidṛ p+tamanasaḥ gsad bya'i skyes bu me tog thod can rol mo dang ldan skye bo mang pos yongs bskor ba/ /gsod pa'i gnas su 'gro bzhin pa ni gom pa re res nyam ngar ltung ba ji lta bar/ /longs spyod gnas bcas rnams kye 'di ltar nyin re nyin res 'chi ba la ni nges brtun te/ /mngon par chas pa khyed rnams longs spyod dag gis yid la khengs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba ci/ /paṇ+ḍi ta bharja ha ri'i gzhung las so/ da //ma brtags pa'i bsod nyams kyi chags pa dag las khyad par du yid 'byung bar bya ba la gdams pa/ āyurbar+ṣashany-in+d+rahūṃparimitaitretotar+ghaṃgataita sngar+ghaṃdādz+nyam—maparebālatwabṛdhatwayoḥsheṣibyārnyibiyogayogaduḥkhasanyihaṃsebānithilādzī bebāritaraṅgatsañcalataresokhyekutaḥs+thābhāṭ+wāḥ—/ mi rnams tshe tshad lo brgya nyid na'ang mtshan mo rnams kyis de'i phyed song / /de la phyed ni byes pa nyid de 48—697

gzhan zud ⑫rgan po nyid kyis 'das/ /lhag ma phrad dang 'amal ba'i sdug bang nad bcas re ba 'bras bu med/ /srog ni chu yi rlabs ltar g.yo ba mi rnams ci phyir shin du bde/ /'phrog byed don 'dzin gyi gzhung las so// 4 //de ltar shes pa las bde bar gshegs pa'i brtan pa bdud rtsi lta bu la brten par gdams pa/ yathākatāthipurukho3rnyimranathayanudzalad+mamasnotekatain kabyun—/ asogatemārgamapihasebayan+darastabāne+ebabenut+tabhajibeḥ/ ji lhar su yang rung ba'i skyes bu mar don gnyer ba yis/ /chu ni mngon par bsrubs kyang mar rnyed 'gyur ba ma yin pa/ /de bzhin bde bar gshegs pa'i lam 'di la yang mi brten pa'i/ /mi yis rnam par grol ba rnyed par 'ang ba ma yin nyid//kho dpon la springs pa zhal las so// 5 //thun mong ma yin pa'i phyi nang gi cad par bstan pa las rnam par grol ba'i bstan pa'i snying po la gdams pa/ sazasardonaprabeny-idz+ramanaḥsrusgrik+ṣikāk+ṣumarnyiyi kṛtarnya1 bortsesubaṅgāsujibhagakatīnasudinyekāyadishun+yatot+ta/ sangs rgyas pa dang mu stegs kun nas mtshungs snyam du/ /rnam dbye byed po med las gal te 'dir dbye ba/ /chen po'i blo dang ldan pas zhib mor mthong ba gang / /mthar thug pa ni stong nyid gcig phur ②gsungs pa'o/ /la ba pa'i snang ba'i phreng ba las so—/ 6 //de lta bas na/ yaḥ prabyiroyatisar+yadzātonatasu.ujita②swabhābatosnyi/ yaḥprat+yayāṭīnasasrun+yatai.usteyaḥ shun+yatedzānatibohāpramat+ta/ gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes/ /de la skye ba rang bzhin yod ma yin/ /rkyen la rag las gang de'ang stong par bshad/ /gang zhig stong nyid shes de bag yod pa'o/ /zhes pa 48—698

gzhan phyed ①rgan po nyid kyis 'das/ /lhag ma phrad dang 'bral ba'i sdug bsngal nad bcas re ba 'bras bu med/ /srog ni chu yi rlabs ltar g.yo ba mi rnams ci phyir shin du bde/ /'phrog byed don 'dzin gyi gzhung las so// 4 //de ltar shes pa las bde bar gshegs pa'i brtan pa bdud rtsi lta bu la brten par gdams pa/ yathāsgotābe+epurukhophornyiphranathayanadzalad+mamasnotai1haṃn kartsan—/ asaugataimārgamapihasebayan+darastathāṣ+pebabimut+tabhagh+rabeḥ/ ji ltar su yang rung ba'i skyes bu mar don gnyer ba yis/ /chu ni mngon par bsrubs kyang mar rnyed 'gyur ba ma yin pa/ /de bzhin bde bar gshegs pa'i lam 'di la yang mi brten pa'i/ /mi yis rnam par grol ba rnyed par 'gyur ba ma yin nyid//kho dpon la springs pa zhal las so 5 //thun mong ma yin pa'i phyi nang gi khyad par bstan pa las rnam par grol ba'i bstan pa'i snying po la gdams pa/ sazasardonaprabir+bhadz+ramanaḥsrusmik+ṣikāk+ṣumadhiyi kṛtan+ta—/ bortasubad+māsubibhagakarnyinasudihaikāyadishun+yatot+ta/ sangs rgyas pa dang myu stegs kun nas mtshungs snyam du/ /rnam dbye byed po med las gal te 'dir dbye ba/ /chen po'i blo dang ldan pas zhib mor mthong ba gang / /mthar thug pa ni stong nyid gcig phur ④gsungs pa'o/ /la ba pa'i snang ba'i phreng ba las so— / 6 //de lta bas na/ yaḥ prah+yerdzayatisar+yadzātonatasu.ut+yāta①swabhābatoste/ yaḥprat+yayādzhainasasrun+yatai.usteyaḥ shun+yataidzānatibohāpramat+ta/ gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes/ /de la skye ba rang bzhin yod ma yin/ /rkyen la rag las gang de'ang stong par bshad/ /gang zhig stong nyid shes de bag yod pa'o/ /zhes pa 48—698

mdo las so// 7 //stong pa nyid de yang nam mkha'i me tog dang mo sham gyi du lta bu gtan med pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi dgag pa ni ma yin no zhes gdams pa/ not+yadobhābaru peṇatsānuṅgādaḥkhabukhyabata—/ sanuṅgādasubhābena.uṅgādashun+yatāmatā/ ngo bo nyid kyis dngos skye med/ /mkha'i me tog bzhin ma skyes min/ /skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin byis/ /skye ba stong par bzhed pa yin/ /la ba'i na bza' can gyis so// 8 //de'i phyir/ natatwatartsetakhanusarnyibhābasteshāmasahūṃbyabahāratobisgyudebabargyu tanayaphyayatwaṅgābhābatasgatwamatosteteṣaḥ dngos po rnams kyi de kho na nyid kyang / /nges par med na mo sham bu ji bzhin/ /tha snyad du yang med pa nyid 'gyur te—/ /rang bzhin nyid yod 'di las de rnams yod/ /dpal ldan zla ba'i 'o 1 //yod pa de yang med pa'i zlas drangs par ni ma yin no zhes rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i rang bzhin gyi tshul la gdams pa/ nehwabhabyadadzatahūṃprat+yayā dani rurtseta/ bhabābhabobatonastoyuganadhaskyodzayate/ skye med nyid phyir rang bzhin med/ /'gag pa med las rten 'byung ba/ /yod dang med pa nyams 'di las| /zung 'jug nyid du skye bar 'gyur/ /sa dra ya badz+ra gyi'o// 10 //mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan pa'i mtshan gzhi ni sems kyi rang bzhin gyi tshul las gzhan ma yin no zhes gdams pa/ pratit+yadzātāḥbatikalngashutsāḥshut+yāḥsubhābenabastusarnya| nortsedinartsitrajitekarūparūpādaya/ palcadzinadzayarnyi/skye ba kun rtog gi ①stong rten 'byung ba/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin gyis na dngos 48—699

mdo las so// 7 //stong pa nyid de yang nam mkha'i me tog dang mo sham gyi bu lta bu gtan med pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi dgag pa ni ma yin no zhes gdams pa/ not+yadobhābaru peṇanānut+yādaḥkhabukhyabata—/ anut+yādaswabhābena.uṅgādashun+yatāmatā/ ngo bo nyid kyis dngos skye med/ /mkha'i me tog bzhin ma skyes min/ /skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin byus/ /skye ba stong par bzhed pa yin/ /la ba'i na bza' can byis so// 8 //de'i phyir/ natatwatabyetakhanusarnyibhābasteshāmasatwobyabahāratobisgyudebaban+d+ra tanayasuyatwadrwabhābatasmatwamatosteteṣaḥ dngos po rnams kyi de kho na nyid kyang / /nges par med na mo sham bu ji bzhin/ /tha snyad du yang med pa nyid 'gyur te—/ /rang bzhin nyid yod 'di las de rnams yod/ /dpal ldan zla ba'i 'o 9 //yod pa de yang med pa'i zlas drangs par ni ma yin no zhes rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i rang bzhin gyi tshul la gdams pa/ ṣ+peswabhabyadadzata3prat+yayā dani rudhata/ bhabābhabobatonastoyuganartsen+tudzayate/ skye med nyid phyir rang bzhin med/ /'gag pa med las rten 'byung ba/ /yod dang med pa nyams 'di las—/ /zung 'jug nyid du skye bar 'gyur/ /a dra ya badz+ra gyi'o// 10 //mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan pa'i mtshan gzhi ni sems kyi rang bzhin gyi tshul las gzhan ma yin no zhes gdams pa/ pratit+yadzātāḥbatikalpashut+yāḥshut+yāḥswabhābenabastusan+ta| nortsedin—trabitekarūparūpādaya/ pañcadzinadzayadhi/skye ba kun rtog gi ①stong rten 'byung ba/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin gyis na dngos 48—699

por med/ /chad min bkra ba sems kyi ngo bor gcig /gzugs sogs rgyal ba lnga rnams rgyal gyur cig /me tri'i zhabs kyi'o// 11 //de nyid ni lhan cig skyes pa bde ba chen po brjod pa dang bral ba'i kho na de ①nyid mthar thug pa te/ ṇar+ghaṃbā.igurukaha.i/ ṇat+tamābuṛ.isis/ sa hadzāmi.asuhasa.aladza.i—/ kāsrukanyidz+dzatīs/ bla mas brjod pa de yang ma yin zhing / /de ni slob mas go ba'am thob pa med/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba bdud rtsi ste/ /su la su zhig gis ni brjod par byed/ /sa ra ha'i zhabs kyi glu'o// 12 //'di nyid brtan g.yo'i khyab bdag rgyu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'o zhes khyad par gyi gnas la gdams pa/ yeparbatā.aṣ+ṭamahāsamudādwabibyusabe+enarakādibhed/ ya tras+thabaram̐dzegalamedabasardetat+tadrwayibadz+ra j-idebanan+d+raḥ/ gang zhig ri dang rgya mtsho chen po brgyad/ /gling dang dmyal sogs dbye ba thams cad dang / /brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba thams cad gang / /de de gzhan min rdo rje 'dzin rang nyid/ /klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas so// 1na //'o na don gzhan du snang ba ci zhe na/ gsungs pa/ shun+yatāshun+yataib bhabe+esgyubobāsanabāsetā—/ satibātābartan+d+raṭībhūtāḥ apa.ebaghanopalāḥ/stong nyid bag chags kyis bsgos na/ /stong pa nyid ni dngos por 'gyur/ /rlung gis dkrugs las brtan por be+e/ /gyur pas chu nyid chab phrom mo/ /nā ga bo dhi'i 'o// 14 //de lta mod kyi rang bzhin gzhan du gyur pa ni ma yin no zhes bya ba'i tshul gyis lam gyi shes pa ye shes kyi phyogs nyid la dpes gdams pa/ saṃsharamā 48—700

por med/ /chad min bkra ba sems kyi ngo bor gcig /gzugs sogs rgyal ba lnga rnams rgyal gyur cig /me tri'i zhabs kyi'o// 11 //de nyid ni lhan cig skyes pa bde ba can po brjod pa dang bral ba'i kho na de ⑫nyid mthar thug pa te/ ṇatrībāyigurukaha.i/ ṇat+tamābuṛyisis/ sa hadzāmikasuhasa.aladza.i—/ kāsrukanyidz+dzatīs/ bla mas brjod pa de yang ma yin zhing / /de ni slob mas go ba'am thob pa med/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba bdud rtsi ste/ /su la su zhig gis ni brjod par byed/ /sa ra ha'i zhabs kyi glu'o// 12 //'di nyid brtan g.yo'i khyab bdag rgyu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'o zhes cad par gyi gnas la gdams pa/ yeparbatā.aṣ+ṭamahāsamudrudwabibyusarbenarakādisnyed/ ya trasbabaredzegalamedabasadz+ratat+taṅgāyibadz+ra sgrodebanargyuḥ/ gang zhig ri dang rgya mtsho chen po brgyad/ /gling dang dmyal sogs dbye ba thams cad dang / /brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba thams cad gang / /de de gzhan min rdo rje 'dzin rang nyid/ /klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas so// 1da //'o na don gzhan du snang ba ci zhe na/ gsungs pa/ shun+yatāshun+yateb bhabesgyubobāsanabāsitā—/ satibātābartadz+raṭībyutāḥ sapa.ebaghanopalngaḥ/stong nyid bag chags kyis bsgos na/ /stong pa nyid ni dngos por 'gyur/ /rlung gis dkrugs las brtan por ni/ /gyur pas chu nyid chab phrom mo/ /tsā ga bo rnyi'i 'o// 14 //de lta mod kyi rang bzhin gzhan du gyur pa ni ma yin no zhes bya ba'i nga gyis lam kyi shes pa ye shes kyi phyogs nyid la dpes gdams pa/ isharamā 48—700

dāyayathānyibālogar+ṣadeyiyasutishuk+kabhabaṃ/ yānyik+ṣayine+ebatushuk+kabābaṃbālasu burnyirbatishārnyimātsā| ji ltar byis pas 'di la dkar po nyid/ /'ong snyam sol ba blangs nas dad pas 'di la dkar po nyid/ /'ong snyam sol ba blangs nas bdar ba yis/ /zad par song mod dkar por mi 'gyur ba/ /byis blo brdzun pa'i mngon nga de bzhin no/ /nga klu'i zhabs kyi'o// 15 //de'i phyir rang bzhin kho na la lam gyi snying por bya ba ste/ nakleshabornyi tornyininabodhekleshasaṃbhab—/ kleshaprakrititatsebatāyasbotanupardzitaḥ byang chub nyon mongs las gzhan min/ /byang chub nyon mongs las ma byung / /nyon mongs rang bzhin nyid las ni/ /nga kyis bdud rtsi brnyes pa lags/ /klu grub kyi zhal snga nas so// 16 //rang bzhin las gzhan du rnam 'gyur ni med bzhin du snang ba brdzun pa kho na ste/ sahotsatsitram̐tsihūṃsamabeṣamanitsān+datagatornyiyidarternyistojiditamabetro tāt+pabirnyitsā| satsādosaṃsārez-idayagagatsāsgogalikhiteralīkiḥsaṃka⑫ཿsnyibhu banamirdasaṃgrehamib| e ma'o bden pa'i don ni cho gas rtogs kyang nga la pa'i blo dag la/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam mtho dma'i nga ba sna tshogs bkra ba rnam bkod pa/ /srid pa gsum gyis bsdus pa 'di ni kun tu rtog pa brdzun pa yis/ /thog ma med pa'i 'khor bar snying gi nam mkha'i khongs su bris pa bzhin/ /la ba pa'i zhabs kyis so// 1che //de nyid kyis na rang bzhin bde ba chen po so so rang gis rig pa'i ngo bo nyid du mngon du bya ba'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i sgo thun mong ma yin pa la gdams pa—/ etete'iṣayasta.ebamanasaḥpanyathrabh+rastik+ṣaṇ+ḍatirebordzukhabarnying yab 48nga 701

dāyayathānyibālogar+ṣadeyoyasutibyuklabhabaṃ—/ yātik+ṣayiṣ+pebatushuklabābaṃbālasu burnyirbatithārnyimāṭ+wā| ji ltar byis pas 'di la dkar po nyid/ /'ong snyam sol ba blangs nas dad pas 'di la dkar po nyid/ /'ong snyam sol ba blangs nas bdar ba yis/ /zad par song mod dkar por mi 'gyur ba/ /byes blo brdzun pa'i mngon pas de bzhin no/ /ār+ya klu'i zhabs kyi'o// 15 //de'i phyir rang bzhin kho na la lam byi snying por bya ba ste/ nakleshabodhi tornyim+binabodhikleshasaṃbhab—/ kleshaprakrititatsebatāyamṛtamupardzitaḥ byang chub nyon mongs las gzhan min/ /byang chub nyon mongs las ma byung / /nyon mongs rang bzhin nyid las ni/ /par kyis bdud rtsi brnyes pa lags/ /klu grub kyi zhal snga nas so// 16 //rang bzhin las gzhan du rnam 'gyur ni med bzhin du snang ba brdzun pa kho na ste/ ahotsatsitram̐tsitram̐samabiṣamaniston+datagatodhiyodastebhirnyibiditamabibhū tārjabidhinā / anādosaṃsārez-idayagaganāsgogalikhitairalīkiḥsaṃkabyeḥs+t+ribhu banamirdasaṃgrehamib—/ e ma'o bden pa'i don ni cho gas rtogs kyang 'khrul pa'i blo dag la/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam mtho dma'i dgo ba sna tshogs bkra ba rnam bkod pa/ /srid pa gsum gyis bsdus pa 'di ni kun tu rtog pa brdzun pa yis/ /thog ma med pa'i 'khor bar snying gi nam mkha'i khongs su bris pa bzhin/ /la ba pa'i byedabs kyis so// 17 //de nyid kyis na rang bzhin bde ba chen po so so rang gis rig pa'i ngo bo nyid du mngon du bya ba'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i sgo thun mong ma yin pa la gdams pa—/ etetebiṣayasta.ebamanasaḥpanyathrabh+ranyik+ṣaḍātirebobyukhabarnyibyedayab 48—701

lan+d+ratrakleshabibyedananaḥ—/ babyesaṅgarūpādapaṅkadzaradzaḥsur+shaswayiyadwashātanamām kasāramit+yaharahasun+darnyitatwamṛtaḥ bdag po nyon mongs sa bon byis mtho dbang po'i stobs dang de rnams nyid kyis rtsol ldan par/ /yid ni rab tu 'jug pa lnga po rnams kyi skad cig yul 'di rnams te de nyid ni/ /phyag 'os bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi chu skyes rdul la rang nyid reg pa'i dbang gang las/ /bdag gi snying po zhes bya de kho na nyid bdud rtsir son par gyur pa a la la/ doḍiprabarnya las so— 18 //de las ji ltar de kho na nyid kyi bdud rtsi'i gnas la son pa gsal bar 'doms pa/ nasat+yanāsat+yānatsetadubhayiṭ+wāpyanubhayinirūl+lekhasaṣ+ṭhakṛtibatamayīm rgyanakadhī—/ dzinaḥshas+thāmaibaspriratsaladzagat+tatwamitisaswesebe+en+tidridebīdzayatis sukhabadz+rapraṇayibhā—/ bden dang kun du brdzun min de dag skye dang 'jig pa'ang ma yin pa/ /rang bzhin spros med dbu ma'i blo ni kun du thams cad byed po mchog /brtan g.yo'i 'gro ba'i de kho na zhes rgyal ba ston pa nyid kyis te/ /de ni bde ba'i rdo rjer gyur ma so so rang rig lha mo rgyal/ /ri khrod zhabs kyis rus— 19 //bde ba de rang gis rig na rang la bya byed srid par thal ches pa nyid du dogs pa la gsungs pa/ ken tata①joyatesokhyamitibe+edabedakamanaḥbedabe+ed kabhābopidosngonoṣ+peḥswabhābataḥ—/ bde de gang gis shes snyam na/ /yid kyis rig par byed mod kyang / /rang bzhin med phyir rig bya dang / /rig byed gyur pa'i skyon med do/ /'phags pa klu'i zhabs kyi'o// 2༷ //so so rang gis rig bya'i lha mo'i nges pa gsungs pa/ nirād+makatwat+palu 48—702

lanutrakleshabidzā nanaḥ| ban+d+rasargyorūpādapaṅkadzaradzaḥsur+shaswayiyadwashātanamām kasāramit+yaharahasun+darnyitatāsbotaḥ bdag po nyon mongs sa bon gyis mtho dbang po'i stobs dang de rnams nyid kyis rtsol ldan par/ /yid ni rab tu 'jug pa lnga po rnams kyi skad cig yul 'di rnams te de nyid ni/ /phyag 'os bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi chu skyes rdul la rang nyid reg pa'i dbang gang las/ /bdag gi snying po zhes bya de kho na nyid bdud rtsir son par gyur pa sa la la/ doḍiprabarnya las so— 18 //de las ji ltar de kho na nyid kyi bdud rtsi'i gnas la son pa gsal bar 'doms pa/ nasat+yatsāsat+yānatsetadubhayināpyanubhayinirūl+lekhasaṅgākṛtibatamayīm rgyanakadhī—/ dzinaḥshasgyube+ebasgriratsaladzagat+tatwamitisaswesebistidridebīdzayatis sukhabadz+rapraṇayitī—/ bden dang kun du brdzun min de dag skye dang 'jig pa'ang ma yin pa/ /rang bzhin spros med dbu ma'i blo ni kun du thams cad byed po mchog /brtan g.yo'i 'gro ba'i de kho na zhes rgyal ba ston pa nyid kyis te/ /de ni bde ba'i rdo rjer gyur ma so so rang rig lha mo rgyal/ /ri khrod zhabs kyis so— 19 //bde ba de rang gis rig na rang la bya byed srid par thal ches pa nyid du dogs pa la gsungs pa/ ken tata⑫stoyatesokhyamitibedabedakemanaḥbedabed kabhābopidokhononeḥsubhābataḥ—/ bde de gang gis shes snyam na/ /yid kyis rig par byed mod kyang / /rang bzhin med phyir rig bya dang / /rig byed gyur pa'i skyon med do/ /'phags pa klu'i zhabs kyi'o// 2༷ //so so rang gis rig bya'i lha mo'i nges pa gsungs pa/ nirāt+pakatwakalu 48—702

dhasmyodhatobishurnyitaḥsustashabobanīnaḥtatrosgrinyiyisubishustodhasmyoṅgātusurūpodzag tekarūpaḥbadag med nyid phyir nges par chos kyi dbyings/ /rnam par dag pas ro dag nyal ba'i gnas/ /shin tu rnam dag chos dbyings rang bzhin gyis/ /der ni bzhengs 'di 'gro ba gcig pa'i sku/ /brtson 'grus dpal bshes gnyen gyi'o// 21 //de nyid kyis na rang byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas la gdams pa/sabharnyatatwalabhāyasaṃlhagigamitismṛte—/ hūṃphaṭākārajinirmultesatwabojishibaṃparaḥ/ma 'phrul ba yi de nyid thob/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhes dran/ /hūṃphaṭa yi ge las grol ba/ /sems dpa'i gzugs brnyan zhi ba mchog /dzā larnya ri pa'i'o/ / 22 //de'i nges pa kho nar rgyu 'bras kyi tsasmo lī dang lhan cig skyes pa gnyis kyi nges pa la gdams pa/ tsasmolokaralīlayānidzapadādulngalito3jiswabyurbiṣarturim hāsukhaṃbiratsayad+malīnaḥsubostodaye| sastotsāgragatopinidṛtipardagrwadrastopidzharte yayādāgadrabudayadrayitsasahādzānan+d+rayaban+d+ramate| gtum mo'i 'od kyi rol pas rang gi gnas las g.yo ba'ang rang 'byung bde ba cher/ /thim las rgya cher khyab cing gsal bzhin pa la rang nyid rtogs pa shar ba gang / /chu skyes rtse mor son pa'ang 'phel ba gang gis myang 'das go 'phang thob pa yang / /ri gnyis dag la shar ba'i lhan cig skyes dga'i skad cig ma ste bdag 'dud do/ /bīr+ya shrī mi tra'i 'o// 2da //de'i phyir mngon par kasal ba'i rgyus 'bras bu la ji ltar mtshams sbyor ba'i nges pa gsungs pa/ ekamudrasamāyuk+tabyutumudruyutothab/ adha 48—703

dhan+d+radhatorbishurnyitaḥsup+tashabobarmānaḥtatrosgritiyisubishudhedhan+d+rajotuswarūpodzag tekarūpaḥbadag med nyid phyir nges par chos kyi dbyings/ /rnam par dag pas ro dag nyal ba'i gnas/ /shin tu rnam dag chos dbyings rang bzhin gyis/ /der ni bzhengs 'di 'gro ba gcig pa'i sku/ /brtson 'grus dpal bshes gnyen gye'o—/ / 21 //de nyid kyis na rang byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas la gdams pa/abhan+tatatwalabhāyasaṃp+tagigamitismṛtai—/ hūṃphaṭakārabinirmur+ghaṃsatwabobishibaṃparaḥ/ma 'phrul ba yi de nyid thob/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhes dran/ /hūṃphaṭa yi ge las grol ba/ /sems dpa'i gzugs brnyan zhi ba mchog /dzā larnya ri pa'i'o—/ / 22 //de'i nges pa kho nar rgyu 'bras kyi tsaṇ+ḍa byā dang lhan cig skyes pa gnyis kyi nges pa la gdams pa/ tsaṇ+ḍalokaralīlayānidzapadādulbālitophobiswabyurbiṣ+ṭazlarim hāsukhaṃbiratsayaprelīnaḥswabostodaye—/ astodzāgragatopinidṛtipardathādrastopidzhaste yayādāgadrabudayadrayitsasahādzānan+d+rayaban+d+ramanye—/ gtum mo'i 'od kyi rol pas rang gi gnas las g.yo ba'ang rang 'byung bde ba cher/ /thim las rgya cher khyab cing gsal bzhin pa la rang nyid rtogs pa shar ba gang / /chu skyes rtse mor son pa'ang 'phel ba gang gis myang 'das go 'phang thob pa yang / /ri gnyis dag la shar ba'i lhan cig skyes dga'i skad cig ma ste bdag 'dud do/ /bīr+ya shrī mi tra'i 'o// 2 //de'i phyir mngon par gsal ba'i rgyus 'bras bu la ji ltar mtshams sbyor ba'i nges pa gsungs pa/ ekamudrasamāyuk+tabyutumudruyutothab/ an+ta 48—703

bhabasukhaṃsak+ṣadatedarenit+yaswānubhabosteyasusapunasistomahānudrayā / chags pa'i mtha' ni chags bral dang po 'jug pa'i dus su 'jug pa yi ni yid gang zhig/zla ba'i rang bzhin gnas pa na ni gzhan la rab tu 'jug ste rlung gi rgyu ba 'gag/de yi dus su bde ba gang zhig 'byung ba gzhan min mngon sum pa yi go 'phang mchog /de ni gang gis rtag par yang yang nyams su myong las phyag rgya can po'i dngos grub 'gyur/ /ḍo dri pra brnya las so// 29 //phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub kyi rang bzhin gsungs pa/ ebaṃ prabhasuraṣ+ṭit+tat+patāt+pastuprabalhate—/ stoganirmāṇakāyāsgyupratīt+yapraṇiṅgānataḥtotsitasmanirnyirdon+datsatayostutaṅgābhabataḥ 'di ltar 'od gsal ba'i sems las/sems can don du rdzogs longs spyod/ /sprul pa'i sku dag can lam dang / /rten cing nga la 'byung las 'jug pa/ /de rnams kyi ni de dag gi/ /rang bzhin las gzhan ma yin no/ /zung 'jug gsal ba las so// daX //de'i phyir sems can sgrol ba'i khur par ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa can bdag legs su 'dod pa dag gis gnas 'di kho na la yid gcig tu bya bar gdams pa/ yatwatsikaimanaḥkṛtwargyayateparameparda/ tatrebalabhatesirnyir nadzalenakiphalaḥ gang du 'ang mchog gi go 'phang la/ /yid gcig pa yis bsam byas na/ /de las dngos grub rnyed 'gyur te/ /bya mang rtsom la 'bras bu ci/ /zhal byung ngo // ka1 //de lta bas na 'chi ba med pa nyid kyi gnas la yang ngo zhes gdams pa'i phyir/tsitalcashun+yatāsbo'imahāzudrutrikaparā1 talcabhābayatānitram̐mṛkyurāyatebalcanaḥ/sems kyang stong pa nyid du gsungs/ /phyag rgya chen po'i bdag nyid gsungs/ /48—706

bhabasukhaṃsak+ṣadahaṃborenit+yaswānubhabosteyasusapunasesgomahāmudrayā—/ chags pa'i mtha' ni chags bral dang po 'jug pa'i dus su 'jug pa yi ni yid gang zhig/zla ba'i rang bzhin gnas pa na ni gzhan la rab tu 'jug ste rlung gi rgyu ba 'gag/de yi dus su bde ba gang zhig 'byung ba gzhan min mngon sum pa yi go 'phang mchog /de ni gang gis rtag par yang yang nyams su stsong las phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub 'gyur/ /ḍo dri pra brnya las so// 29 //phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub kyi rang bzhin gsungs pa/ ebaṃ prabhaswarabyit+tat+patārbastuprabartate—/ sgoganirmāṇakāyāsgyupratīt+yapraṇijonataḥtotsitasmasdirnyin+dhon+datsatayostutadrwabhabataḥ 'di ltar 'od gsal ba'i sems las/sems can don du rdzogs longs spyod/ /sprul pa'i sku dag don lam dang / /rten cing 'brel 'byung las 'jug pa/ /de rnams kyi ni de dag gi/ /rang bzhin las gzhan ma yin no/ /zung 'jug gsal ba las so// 30 //de'i phyir sems can sgrol ba'i khur don ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa can bdag legs su 'dod pa dag gis gnas 'di kho na la yid gcig tu bya bar gdams pa/ yatwatsishaṃmanaḥkṛtwargyayateparameparda/ tatrebalabhatesernyir nadzalenakiphalaḥ gang du 'ang mchog gi go 'phang la/ /yid gcig pa yis bsam byas na/ /de las dngos grub rnyed 'gyur te/ /bya mang rtsom la 'bras bu ci/ /zhal byung ngo // 31 //de lta bas na 'chi ba med pa nyid kyi gnas la yang ngo zhes gdams pa'i phyir/tsitañcashun+yatāthralngamahāmyudrwakhyukaparā—/ tañcabhābayatānitram̐mṛkyurāyatebañcanaḥ/sems kyang stong pa nyid du gsungs/ /phyag rgya chen po'i bdag nyid gsungs/ /48—705

de yang rtag tu sgom pa las/ /'chi ba bslu bar 'gyur ba nyid/ /bi ru pāk+ṣa'i 'o// da2 //de ltar shes pa nas sgrub pa kho na snying por bya ba'i phyir nags su gnas pa'i skabs kyi phan yon la gdams pa/ nadṛshutetsakrasukhan+darāshānī tsasugastopinadṛsh+yatetsa—/ nadṛsh+yatenabartsadzanasushokaḥsbyitirbanesādhutarānarāṇaḥ/mi rnams kha nas gya gyur smra ba mi thos shing / /dman pa rnams kyi khengs pa mthong ba min pa dang / /gnyen gyi skye bo'i zu ngan mthong ba ma yin pas/ /nags su gnas na mi rnams shin tu legs pa nyid/ /zhal byung nyid do// kad //chags sdang gi rkyen spangs pa la sogs pas chags bral gyi nges pa la gnas pa nyid kyang chags pa chen po'i nges pa la mi ston na slar zhing sred pa brtas pa'i rgyu'o zhes bya ba'i nga gyis sred pa las nges par 'byung ba la khyad par du gdams pa—/ bhan+tadeshamane+ekadusgabiṣamikirtsin+daprastasmrayāt+yatshishīlakulngarnyimānasutsite setsakṛtāniblal| bhuñjasmran+yajibasgyuteparakṛtesāshaṅgayākākapatreṇ+ḍabaire ṇipāpakasmonidatetsāt+yāpisanubyusi / bgrod dka'i yul ni mang por 'khyams nas bdag gis cung zad kyang ni ma rnyed par/ /nga khrims rigs kyi nga rgyal dor nas phyug po bsten par byas kyang 'bras bu med/ /gus pa spangs pa'i gzhan gyi nga du bya rog lta bur dogs dang bcas shing zos/ /da dung nga par ma nga sdig pa'i las la dga' ba'i dgra bo sred pa skye /bharla ha ri'i 'o// da4 //khyad par gyi sred pa las nges par 'byung ba la 'dir nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas bla lhag tu gdams pa/ ekedṛṣ+ṭashataidṛṣ+ṭadṛṣ+ṭapalcaṣatānirtsi/ satitreṣ+ṭasu puruyeṣasutsakrabh+ramatimasta ke/ gcig mthong ba nas brgya mthong zhing / /48—706

de yang rtag tu sgom pa las/ /'chi ba bslu bar 'gyur ba nyid/ /bi ru pāk+ṣa'i 'o// 32 //de ltar shes pa nas sgrub pa kho na snying por bya ba'i phyir nags su gnas pa'i skabs kyi phan yon la gdams pa/ nadṛshritetsakrasukhan+darāshānī tsasugasgopinadṛsh+yatetsa—/ nadṛsh+yatenababyudzanagyashokaḥsbitirbaṣ+pesādhutarānarāṇaḥ/mi rnams kha nas gya gyur smra ba mi thos shing / /dman pa rnams kyi khengs pa mthong ba min pa dang / /gnyen gyi skye bo'i mya ngan mthong ba ma yin pas/ /nags su gnas na mi rnams shin tu legs pa nyid/ /zhal byung nyid do// ldan //chags sdang gi rkyen spangs pa la sogs pas chags bral gyi nges pa la gnas pa nyid kyang chags pa chen po'i nges pa la mi ston na slar zhing sred pa brtas pa'i rgyu'o zhes bya ba'i tshul gyes sred pa las nges par 'byung ba la khyad par du gdams pa—/ bhan+d+radeshamanokadugabiṣameki—n+daprap+tasmayāt+yalngashīlakulābhimānamutsilta setsakṛtānithral—/ bhuñjasmran+yabibasriteparakṛtesāshaṅgayākākapaz-iṇ+ḍabe+ere ṇipāpakan+d+ranidatenābyāpisan+tu6se—/ bgrod dka'i yul ni mang por 'khyams nas bdag gis cung zad kyang ni ma rnyed par/ /byed khrims rigs kyi nga rgyal dor nas phyug po bsten par byas kyang 'bras bu med/ /gus pa spangs pa'i gzhan gyi par du bya rog lta bur dogs dang bcas shing zos/ /da dung byed par ma gyur sdig pa'i las la dga' ba'i dgra bo sred pa skye/ /bharla ha ri'i 'o// na4 //khyad par kyi sred pa las nges par 'byung ba la 'dir nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas bla lhag tu gdams pa/ ekaidṛṣ+ṭashataidṛṣ+ṭadṛṣ+ṭapalcaṣatānistsa/ atiz-iṣ+ṭasu puruyeṣasutsakrabh+ramatimasta ke/ gcig mthong ba nas brgya mthong zhing / /48—706

brgya phrag lnga dbang mthong nas ni/ /shin tu sred pa'i skyes bu yi/ /mgon po la ni 'khor lo 'khor/ /mdza' mo'i bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa las so ni 'khor lo 'khor—/ /mdza' mo'i bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa las so da5 //de lta bu'i bsgrod pa gcig pa'i lam gyi gtso bo'i snod kyi khyad par la gdams pa/ rnyigrubhābasgritāyetsayetsatarkaratānarāḥ/ bṛdwabhabesgridāyetsateṣārnya twan+da de sha yeḥ/ gang yang dge slong dngos gnas dang / /mi gang rtog ge la dga' dang / /gang zhig rgan po'i dngos gnas pa/ /de la de nyid bstan mi bya/ /sha ba rā su yi// da6 //de ltar theg pa thams cad kyi nges par 'byung ba mthar thug pa'i snying po rnyed nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i snying po la rton pa nyid kyis yon tan shes pas de kho na'i ched du rang dang gzhan gyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad sbyor ba gcig pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa bla na med pa la gdams par bzhed pas de yun du gnas pa las brtsams pa'i mchog tu shis pa brjod pa/ sistoṣadhanibhabaduḥkha mahāgadāne+epusgyut+pane+eparamakaṇ+ḍirasā yatsāni/ brak+ṣalane+ekashalikhānimanomakhātsā shorjodaniḥ prabatsarānitsararam̐yarnyi/ sdug bsngal nad chen ldan pa'i srid pa rnams kyi grub pa'i sman/ /bsod nams kyi ni bdag nyid rnams la rna ba'i bcud len mchog /kun tu yid kyi dri ma 'khrud par byed pa'i chu gcig pu/ /zas gtsang sras po'i gsung rab rnams ni yun du rgyal gyur cig /slob dpon chen po dpa' bo'i 'o// da4 //'dzam bu'i gling gi mkhas pa mtha' dag gi thig le mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i grub pa'i dbang phyug shrī ba na rat+na'i zhal snga nas/ mdo sngags kyi 48—707
