skyesabadz+ra muḥzhes bya ba 'dis gshegs su gsol lo/ /rje btsun dpal he ru ku'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa nag po rdo rjes mdzad pa'o// //'gos 'gyur la rgya dpe'i steng nas zhus dag byas pa'o// //bsdur mchan/935 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉ba/937 ①〈〈pe 〉〉dag938 ①〈〈pe 〉4)sa/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉togacor glibasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2914)48—939

༄ga /dpal phyag na rjo rje'i sgrub thabs/①ga dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du—/ shrī badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sā dha na/ bod skad du/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho chen por bdag /yang dag min ④rtog gis sgribs pas/ /de bral bya phyir mgon po ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sgrub thabs bshad—/ /sngon du bshad pa'i tshogs bdun rnam par dag pa dang / tshad med pa bzhi sngon du 'gro bas stong pa nyid bsgom mo/ /de nas rang gi snying gar/nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge ra yig go/ /de'i 'od zer byis lus rnams bsregs shing thal bar byas nas/ a las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i bum pa gang zhing lud pas/ thal ba rnams sbyangs shing / bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho baṃ yig dang bcas par gyur zhing der baṃ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje baṃ yig gi brgyan pa'o/ /48byed940

chog /dpal phyag na rdo rje'i spub thabs/①go dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ra /rgya gar skad du—/ shrī badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sā dha na/ bod skad du/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho chen por bdag /yang dag min ②rtog gis sgribs pas/ /de bral bya phyir mgon po ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sgrub thabs bshad—/ /sngon du bshad pa'i tshogs bdun rnam par dag pa dang / tshad med pa bzhi sngon du 'gro bas stong pa nyid bsgom mo/ /de nas rang gi snying gar/nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge ra yig go/ /de'i 'od zer gyis lus rnams bsregs shing thal bar byas nas/ sa las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i bum pa gang zhing lud pas/ thal ba rnams sbyangs shing / bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho baṃ yig dang bcas par gyur zhing der baṃ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje baṃ yig gi brgyan pa'o/ /48—940

de nyid spro ba dang sdud pa'i sbyor ba las/ bdag nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje pad+ma dang zla ba la bzhugs pa/ sems dpa'i byad krungs can/ ston ka'i sprin ltar rab tu dkar ba'i kha dog ste/ zhal gcig pa zla ba rgyas pa lta bu cung zad bzhad pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gsor ba la brtson pa/ phyag g.yon pas dril bu dkur bsten pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang / sna tshogs pa'i dar gye smad dkris can/ rin po che'i cod pan 'chang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis sgeg pa/ cung zad ljags 'gril zhing / mche ba lhag ger phyung ba/ seṅge'i lta bas gzigs shing / khro gnyer dang bcas pas sdang ba thams cad 'joms pa la brtson pa'o/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdagug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / mnyes pa'i sngags so/ /dpral bar ni oṃ mo/ /mgrin par ni byeda'o/ /thugs kar ni hūṃ ngo / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pa ra ba tsa na a mṛ te na/ a rnyi ṣiñca hūṃ/ dbang bskur ba'i sngags so/ /de nas zla ba'i dbus su ni/ /baṃ yig sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor//'od zer spro dang bsdu bar bya/ /ba spu'i bu ga mang po las/ /spro zhing 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /thub pa nyid bsgrub de bzhin bsdu/ /gang tshe yid ni skyo ba na/ /rtse gcig sems kyis bzlas pa bya/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan+ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag gis rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /sgrub thabs sbyar ba'i bsod nams kyis—/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /gnyis su med pa'i gnas thob shog /dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon burtse kirtis mdzad pa spyodabakab —— ①lo chen gyis bsgyur ba'i 'gyur rnying la zhus dag tsam bgyis pa'o// //48—941

de nyid spro ba dang sdud pa'i sbyor ba las/ bdag nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje pad+ma dang zla ba la bzhugs pa/ sems dpa'i sprul krungs can/ ston ka'i sprin ltar rab tu dkar ba'i kha dog ste/ zhal gcig pa zla ba rgyas pa lta bu cung zad bzhad pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gsor ba la brtson pa/ phyag g.yon pas dril bu dkur bsten pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang / sna tshogs pa'i dar gyi smad dkris can/ rin po che'i cod pan 'chang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis sgeg pa/ cung zad lngags 'gril zhing / mche ba lhag ger phywang ba/ seṅge'i lta bas gzigs shing / khro gnyer dang bcas pas sdang ba thams cad 'joms pa la brtson pa'o/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdagug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / mnyes pa'i sngags so/ /dpral bar ni oṃ mo/ /mgrin par ni lha'i'o/ /thugs kar ni hūṃ ngo / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pa ra ba tsa na a bṛ te na/ a rnyi jilca hūṃ/ dbang bskur ba'i sngags so/ /de nas zla ba'i dbus su ni/ /baṃ yig sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor//'od zer spro dang bsdu bar bya/ /ba spu'i bu ga mang po las/ /spro zhing 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /thub pa nyid bsgrub de bzhin bsdu/ /gang tshe yid ni skyo ba na/ /rtse gcig sems kyis bzlas pa bya/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṭīrnya ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag gis rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /sgrub thabs sbyar ba'i bsod nams kyis| /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /gnyis su med pa'i gnas thob shog /dpal phyag na rdo rje'i skrub pa'i thabs slob dpon burtse kirtis mdzad pa rdzogs so // //⑫lo chen gyis bsgyur ba'i 'gyur rnying la zhus dag tsam bgyis pa'o// //48—941

ra /'phags pa gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs/⑫༄ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya nī lto ba ra dha ra sā dha ne+e/ bod skad du/'phags pa gos sngon po can gyi skrub thabs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon brkyang gar gyis ri bong 'dzin pa la/ /legs zhugs khros pa klu dgra de btud nas/ /de bsnyen cho ga bla ma bzang po las/ /ji ltar 'ongs pa bdag nyid dran par bri/ /rang gi snying gar a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du yi ge hūṃ nag po 'od dang bcas pa bsam ste/ de'i 'od kyis 'gro ba ma lus pa sbyangs shing / rang gi lhag pa'i lhar gyur te/ de thams cad 'dus nas/ sa bon gyi yi ge la zhugs pa dang / rdo rje sngon po rtse mo lnga pa 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs par lta'o/ /yang spro ba dang bsdu ba las/ 'di ltar bsgom par bya ste/ kha dog sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /bcu drug lo lon lta bu la/ /rab tu khros pa'i lta stangs can/ /lto 'bye brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan//48—943

༄ga /'phags pa gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs/'-i ༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya nī waṃ ba ra dha ra sā dha rna/ bod skad du/'phags pa gos sngon po can byi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon brkyang gar gyis ri bong 'dzin pa la/ /legs zhugs khros pa klu dgra de btud nas/ /de bsnyen cho ga bla ma bzang po las/ /ji ltar 'ongs pa bdag nyid dran par bri/ /rang gi snying gar a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du yi ge hūṃ nag po 'od dang bcas pa bsam ste/ de'i 'od kyis 'gro ba ma lus pa sbyangs shing / rang gi lhag pa'i lhar gyur te/ de thams cad 'dus nas/ sa bon gyi yi ge la zhugs pa dang / rdo rje sngon po rtse mo lnga pa 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs par lta'o/ /yang spro ba dang bsdu ba las/ 'di ltar bsgom par bya ste/ kha dog sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /bcu drug lo lon lta bu la/ /rab tu khros pa'i lta stangs can/ /lto 'phye brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan//48byed943

zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /bsnun cing rab tu gsor bar mdzad/ /de bzhin g.yon pa sdigs mdzub bo/ /smad g.yogs sngon po legs par bsnams/ /mgo skyes ser skya 'khyel ba dang / /mig gsum 'bar ba chen po ni/ /mche ba rnam gcigs cod pan can/ /ha ha gad rgyangs chen po yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad skrag byed pa/ /rab tu 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs/ /'jigs byed chen por bdag nyid bsam/ /de'i rjes su/nyid kyi snying ga'i phyogs su gnas pa'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ ye shes sems pa bkug cing gnyis su med par byas nas/ de nas yang sku dang gsung dang thugs byin gyis brlab bo/ /de'i 'og tu spro ba dang bsdu ba'i rim pas/ ji srid skyo bar ma gyur gyi bar du bsgom par bya zhing / skyo bar gyur na sngags bzlas par bya la/ bzlas pa'i 'og tu mchod pa dang / gtor ma dang / gshegs su gsol ba rnams byas te/ don lam gdab par bya'o/ /oṃ nī lasba ra bha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ hūṃ snephaṭa/ snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /'bum phrag gcig yongs su bzlas pas/ dur khrod du phyin la—/ drag po'i thab khung du sgrub bya'i rkang rjes kyi sa dang / dur khrod kyi thal ba dang / ke tshe dang / dha dhu ra dang / khrag dang / dug la sgrub bya'i gzugs brnyan byas la/ bcad cing bcad cing me la bsregs na/ zhag bdun gyis sgrub bya 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du ji lta ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa'i las thams cad/ de lta de ltar 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar bla mas gang bshad phan 'byung bdud rtsi yi/ /thigs pas sdug bsngal zhi byed 'di ni 'dir gtor bas/ /skye bo rtog pa'i dug gis nad med nyams gyur pas/ /48—944

zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /bsnun cing rab tu gsor bar mdzad/ /de bzhin g.yon pa sdigs mdzub bo/ /smad g.yogs sngon po legs par bsnams/ /mgo skyes ser skya 'khyil ba dang / /mig gsum 'bar ba chen po ni/ /mche ba rnam gcigs cod pan can/ /ha ha gad rgyangs chen po yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad skrag byed pa/ /rab tu 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs/ /'jigs byed chen por bdag nyid bsam/ /de'i rjes su/nyid kyi snying ga'i phyogs su gnas pa'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ ye shes sems pa bkug cing gnyis su med par byas nas/ de nas yang sku dang gsung dang thugs byin gyis brlab bo/ /de'i 'og tu spro ba dang bsdu ba'i rim pas/ ji srid skyo bar ma gyur gyi bar du bsgom par bya zhing skyo bar gyur na sngags bzlas par bya la/ bzlas pa'i 'og tu mchod pa dang / gtor ma dang / gshegs su gsol ba rnams byas te/ smon lam gdab par bya'o/ /oṃ nī lasba ra bha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ hūṃ ⑫phaṭa/ snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /'bum phrag gcig yongs su bzlas pas/ dur khrod du phyin la—/ drag po'i thab khung du sgrub bya'i rkang rjes kyi sa dang / dur khrod kyi thal ba dang / ke tshe dang / dha dhu ra dang / khrag dang / dug la sgrub bya'i gzugs brnyan byas la/ bcad cing bcad cing me la bsregs na/ zhag bdun gyis sgrub bya 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du ji lta ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa'i las thams cad/ de lta de ltar 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar bla mas gang bshad phan 'byung bdud rtsi yi/ /thigs pas sdug bsngal zhi byed 'di ni 'dir gtor bas/ /skye bo rtog pa'i dug gis nad med nyams gyur pas/ /48nga 944

༄ga /gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon chen po gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs//1 ༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā yak+ṣa su na a dhi pa ti nī la bā sa na sā dha ni/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon chen po gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /re shig dang po rnal 'byor pas/shing gcig la sogs pa'i sa phyogs su/ me tog la sogs pa bkram zhing /rab tu 'jam pa'i stan la 'dug ste/ bdun rnam par dag pa dang / tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi dang / stong pa nyid kyi don bsam par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ad+ma kophohaṃ/ de nas yi ge paṃ las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar/ e las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i dbus su ni sprin gyi sgra'i yi ge kha dog nag po'i gzugs can no/ /de nas phyogs bcur 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis nam mkha' la khro bo rigs lnga bkug nas/ de nyid du gzhug ste—/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun phyag na rdo rje sku mdog nag po char 48byed946

tshog /gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon chen po gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs/⑫ra /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā yak+ṣa su na a dhi pa ti rī la bā sa na sā dha ni/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon chen po gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /re shig dang po rnal 'byor pas/shing gcig la sogs pa'i sa phyogs su/ me tog la sogs pa bkram zhing /rab tu 'jam pa'i stan la 'dug ste/ bdun rnam par dag pa dang / tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi dang / stong pa nyid kyi don bsam par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya ta tshwa na badz+ra swa bhā wa sablo ko3haṃ/ de nas yi ge paṃ las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar/ saṃ las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i dbus su ni sprin gyi sgra'i yi ge kha dog nag po'i gzugs can no/ /de nas phyogs bcur 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis nam mkha' la khro bo rigs lnga bkug nas/ de nyid du gzhug ste—/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun phyag na rdo rje sku mdog nag po char 48—946

sprin gsar pa lta bu/ zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/mche ba gcigs pa/ zhal khro gnyer can/ sma ra dang ag tshom dang / smin ma dang / ral pa ser skya can/ cod pan gyi dbus na de bzhin gshegs pa mi skyod ①pas brgyan pa/ se 'bru'i me tog ltar dmar ba'i mig can/ de bzhin du g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /phyag g.yon pa ni gdug pa rnams la sdigs 'dzub byed cing / gdengs can nag po zhal du gsol ba/phyag g.yas pa na 'bar ba'i rdo rje rab tu gsor ba/ stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris dang ldan pa'o/ /'jog po dang rigs ldan dmar pos dbu la brgyan pa/mtha' yas dang / nor rgyas kyi bu nag po gnyis ni zhabs gnyis la'o/ /pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po ser po gnyis ni snyan gnyis la'o/ /dung skyong dkar po ni ske rags la'o/ /hu lun+ta ljang khu ni do shal du byas pa'o/ /mtha' yas dang chu lha ni lag gdub tu gnas pa'o/ /'bar ba chen po'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i nyi ma'i gdan dang / nyi ma'i rgyab yol lo/ /snying gar yang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃyig go/ /phyugs bdag dang nor lha'i bu la sogs pa'i gzhung 'jubs pa rnams 'joms par mdzad pa/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus pa yang nas yang du brlag par mdzad pa'i bdag nyid du bsam par bya'o/ /rang gi snying gar yang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ yig go/ /mig la sogs pa'i dbang po drug la yang yi ge hūṃ drug mngon par dgod de/ der yang rje btsun gyi sku re re bsam par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu ye shes sems pa gzhug par bya ste/ slar yang sku dang gsung dang thugs byin gyis brlab bo/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ/ces pa ni bzlas pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rja/ ar+ya nut+pan+da 48—947

sprin gsar pa lta bu/ zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/mche ba gcigs pa/ zhal khro gnyer can/ sma ra dang ag chos dang / smin ma dang / ral pa ser skya can/ cod pan gyi dbus na de bzhin gshegs pa mi skyod ⑫pas brgyan pa/ se 'bru'i me tog ltar dmar ba'i mig can/ de bzhin du g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /phyag g.yon pa ni gdug pa rnams la sdigs 'dzub byed cing / gdengs can nag po zhal du gsol ba/phyag g.yas pa na 'bar ba'i rdo rje rab tu gsor ba/ stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris dang ldan pa'o/ /'jog po dang rigs ldan dmar pos dbu la brgyan pa/mtha' yas dang / nor rgyas kyi bu nag po gnyis ni zhabs gnyis la'o/ /pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po ser po gnyis ni snyan gnyis la'o/ /dung skyong dkar po ni ske rags la'o/ /hu lurnya ljang khu ni do shal du byas pa'o/ /mtha' yas dang chu lha ni lag gdub tu gnas pa'o/ /'bar ba chen po'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i nyi ma'i gdan dang / nyi ma'i rgyab yol lo/ /snying gar yang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃyig go/ /phyugs bdag dang nor lha'i bu la sogs pa'i gzhung 'jubs pa rnams 'joms par mdzad pa/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus pa yang nas yang du brlag par mdzad pa'i bdag nyid du bsam par bya'o/ /rang gi snying gar yang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ yig go/ /mig la sogs pa'i dbang po drug la yang yi ge hūṃ drug mngon par dgod de/ der yang rje btsun gyi sku re re bsam par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu ye shes sems pa gzhug par bya ste/ slar yang sku dang gsung dang thugs byin gyis brlab bo/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ/ces pa ni bzlas pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ḍi/ sar+ya nut+pan+da 48—947

twa / ces pa ni gtor ma'i sngags te/ bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang /bzhib pa dang / ldag par 'os pa dang / ldag par 'os pa'i sbyor bas bya'o/ /ldang ba'i dus su/ oṃ muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol ba dang / ci bde ba'i spyod lam gyis gnas par bya'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon chen po gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs/ slob dpon dri na ka ra badz+ra gyis mdzad pa rdzogs casaske/ / //bsdur mchan/946 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/947 ༅〈〈pe 〉༄skyod/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2917)48wa 948

twa / ces pa ni gtor ma'i sngags te/ bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang /bzhib pa dang / ldag par 'os pa dang / ldag par 'os pa'i sbyor bas bya'o/ /ldang ba'i dus su/ oṃ muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol ba dang / ci bde ba'i spyod lam gyis gnas par bya'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon chen po gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs/ slob dpon dri na ka ra badz+ra gyis mdzad pa rdzogs rbeduske/ / //bsdur mchan/946 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/947 ༅〈〈pe 〉༄skyod/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2917)48wa 948

༄ga /rje btsun phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/①to rje btsun phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ bhaji rā ga badz+ra pā ṇi sā dha na/ /bod skad du/ rje btsun phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di la lhag par dbang ba'i sngags pa ni/ /snying rjes yid ni gcugs par gyur pa dang / /lhag par mos pa brtan po'i yid can ni/ /byang chub sems kyi rnam pas rab tu brgyan—/ /dkon mchog gsum la gcig tu skyabs su song / /bla ma'i rjes gnang thob phyir yon tan ldan/ /rang 'dod lha dang bla ma dbyer med lta/ /shin tu brtson pa ldan pas rab tu sgrub/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha sarba bispyon ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa—/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ ces pas bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung bar bya'o/ /de nas bla na med pa'i mchod pa rnam pa bdun dang / ji skad du bshad pa'i bdag nyid 'bul ba dang / lam bsten pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de 48byed949

chog /rje btsun phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/⑫ga rje btsun phyag na rdo rje'i spub thabs bzhugs so// ra /rgya gar skad du/ bhaskyo rā ga badz+ra pā ṇi sā dha na/ /bod skad du/ rje btsun phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di la lhag par dbang ba'i sngags pa ni/ /snying rjes yid ni gcugs par gyur pa dang / /lhag par mos pa brtan po'i yid can ni/ /byang chub sems kyi rnam pas rab tu brgyan—/ /dkon mchog gsum la gcig tu skyabs su song / /bla ma'i rjes gnang thob phyir yon tan ldan/ /rang 'dod lha dang bla ma dbyer med lta/ /shin tu brtson pa ldan pas rab tu sgrub/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha sarba jikyān ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa—/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ ces pas bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung bar bya'o/ /de nas bla na med pa'i mchod pa rnam pa bdun dang / ji skad du bshad pa'i bdag nyid 'bul ba dang / lam bsten pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de 48nga 949

nas 'gro ba thams cad la snying rje rab tu bsgom mo/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral bas/ /ma dpyad dngos po yod ma yin/ /de phyir 'gro kun stong pa nyid/ /gnyis su med par bsgom par bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+tha kophohaṃ/zhes bya ba 'dis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas dbang chen dang chu dang me dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnams 'dres pa las/ rtag pa'i rang bzhin gyis gzhal med khang pa'o/ /de yi dbus su pad+ma ni/ /sna tshogs 'dab ma ge sar bcas—/ /dga' bo la sogs klu brgyad ni/ /gdan du sgrub pos bsam par bya / /de steng tsha zer dkyil 'khor la/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /rab rgyas zla ba bsgom bya ba/ /me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /de steng sum cu rtsa bzhi yisaṣ+pe/ /gsal byed snying rje'i bdag nyid ni/ /nyi ma'i 'od gsal rnams /༄ ༄bsam pa/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /de steng yi ge hūṃ byas pa/ /yang dag skyes las rtse lnga pa'i/ /rdo rje lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan/ /so sor kun rtog ye shes bsgom/ /hūṃ las sangs rgyas spro bya ste/ /bsdus te de la de rnams gzhug /yang dag 'dus nas dbyer med pa/ /de ni bya ba sgrub par bsgom/ /zla ba nyin mtshan hūṃ yig las/ /skyes pa'i rang nyid gos sngon can/ /rnam dag ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /yun ring phyag na rdo rje bsams/ /dbu skra kham pa gyen du 'greng / /khro gnyer spyan ni dmar ba ste/ /mche ba gcigs pa yi ni zhal—/ /glog gi ljags kyis 'jigs byed pa/ /'jigs dus rlung gi dbugs dang ni/ /hūṃ yig 'don pa yi ni zhal/ /ha har rgod pa rtsub cing drag /rgya mtsho chen po lto ba che/ /pad+ma dbu la brgyan par ro/ /dga' bo nye dga' rna cha ste//pad+ma chen pos tshangs skud byas/ /dung skyong tak+ṣa lag gdub bo/ /rigs ldan 48—950

nas 'gro ba thams cad la snying rje rab tu bsgom mo/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral bas/ /ma dpyad dngos po yod ma yin/ /de phyir 'gro kun stong pa nyid/ /gnyis su med par bsgom par bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa ablo ko3haṃ/zhes bya ba 'dis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas dbang chen dang chu dang me dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnams 'dres pa las/ rtag pa'i rang bzhin gyis gzhal med khang pa'o/ /de yi dbus su pad+ma ni/ /sna tshogs 'dab ma ge sar bcas—/ /dga' bo la sogs klu brgyad ni/ /gdan du sgrub pos bsam par bya—/ /de steng tsha zer dkyil 'khor la/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /rab rgyas zla ba bsgom bya ba/ /me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /de steng sum cu rtsa bzhi yis⑫/ /gsal byed snying rje'i bdag nyid ni/ /nyi ma'i 'od gsal rnams ②bsam pa/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /de steng yi ge hūṃ byas pa/ /yang dag skyes las rtse lnga pa'i/ /rdo rje lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan/ /so sor kun rtog ye shes bsgom/ /hūṃ las sangs rgyas spro bya ste/ /bsdus te de la de rnams gzhug /yang dag 'dus nas dbyer med pa/ /de ni bya ba sgrub par bsgom/ /zla ba nyin mtshan hūṃ yig las/ /skyes pa'i rang nyid gos sngon can/ /rnam dag ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /yun ring phyag na rdo rje bsams/ /dbu skra kham pa gyen du 'greng / /khro gnyer spyan ni dmar ba ste/ /mche ba gcigs pa yi ni zhal—/ /glog gi ljags kyis 'jigs byed pa/ /'jigs dus rlung gi dbugs dang ni/ /hūṃ yig 'don pa yi ni zhal/ /ha har rgod pa rtsub cing drag /rgya mtsho chen po lto ba che/ /pad+ma dbu la brgyan par ro/ /dga' bo nye dga' rna cha ste//pad+ma chen pos tshangs skud byas/ /dung skyong tak+ṣa lag gdub bo/ /rigs ldan 48nga 950

karko dpung rgyan te/ /lhag can nor rgyas rkang gdub bo/ /phrag pa zla ba nyi mas brgyan / /seṅge rkang brgyad lngags pa'i gos/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog sked par dkris—/ /brang 'gro chen po gsol ba po/ /rang mdog rdo rje rtse gsum ni/ /g.yas kyi phyag na bsnams pa ste/ /rdo rje dbyug chen mi bzad pa/ /g.yon gyi phyag na bsnams pa'o/ /nyi ma'i gdan dang rgyab rten drag /g.yon brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis gnas/ /de nas dbyug pa'i steng bsam pa/ /mkha' la 'gro bdag gtum po ste/ /khros shing lus ni che la dpa'/ /kha gdangs sna tshogs mdog can no/ /rkang pa gnyis kyis brang 'gro mnan/ /za bzhin pa ni nyid du byed/ /ser skya zlum zhing 'bar ba'i spyan/ /'jigs shing kun tu seng seng lta—/ /de nas snying gar nyin mtshan hūṃ/ /de nyid 'od zer 'phro ba'o de bzhin spyi bo mgrin pa snying / /oṃ uhūṃ yongs bsgom par bya/ /rang snying sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes 'khor lo yongs su dgug /de rjes mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag bzhugs/ /hūṃ gis bgegs ni bskrad bya ste/ /gsang gtor la sogs sbyin par bya/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hos dgug pa dang / /gzhug dang bcings dang dges pa ru/ /cho gas dam tshig ye shes ni/ /gcig tu grur par rnam par bsam/ /rang snying sngags kyi 'od zer kyis/ /nam mkha'i rgyal ba bkug nas su/ /bzhugs gsol me tog la sogs mchod/ /brtul zhugs dbang bskur gsol ba gdab/ /de tshe ye shes chus gang ba'i/ /rgyal bdag rin chen bum pa yis/ /bdag dang dkyil 'khor bcas pa la /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur bsgom/ /de ltar dbang bskur chu gyur pas//dbu la mi bskyod rgyal po ste/ /ral pa'i cod pan gyis brgyan pa'i/ /mig 48—961

karko dpung rgyan te/ /lhag can nor rgyas rkang gdub bo/ /phrag pa zla ba nyi mas brgyan—/ /seṅge rkang brgyad lpags pa'i gos/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog sked par dkris—/ /brang 'gro chen po gsol ba po/ /rang mdog rdo rje rtse gsum ni/ /g.yas kyi phyag na bsnams pa ste/ /rdo rje dbyug chen mi bzad pa/ /g.yon gyi phyag na bsnams pa'o/ /nyi ma'i gdan dang rgyab rten drag /g.yon brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis gnas/ /de nas dbyug pa'i steng bsam pa/ /mkha' la 'gro bdag gtum po ste/ /khros shing lus ni che la dpa'/ /kha gdangs sna tshogs mdog can no/ /rkang pa gnyis kyis brang 'gro mnan/ /za bzhin pa ni nyid du byed/ /ser skya zlum zhing 'bar ba'i spyan/ /'jigs shing kun tu seng seng lta—/ /de nas snying gar nyin mtshan hūṃ/ /de nyid 'od zer 'phro ba'o de bzhin spyi bo mgrin pa snying / /oṃ t+pahūṃ yongs bsgom par bya/ /rang snying sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes 'khor lo yongs su dgug /de rjes mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag bzhugs/ /hūṃ gis bgegs ni bskrad bya ste/ /gsang gtor la sogs sbyin par bya/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hos dgug pa dang / /gzhug dang bcings dang dges pa ru/ /cho gas dam tshig ye shes ni/ /gcig tu gyur par rnam par bsam/ /rang snying sngags kyi 'od zer gyis/ /nam mkha'i rgyal ba bkug nas su/ /bzhugs gsol me tog la sogs mchod/ /brtul zhugs dbang bskur gsol ba gdab/ /de tshe ye shes chus gang ba'i/ /rgyal bdag rin chen bum pa yis/ /bdag dang dkyil 'khor bcas pa la /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur bsgom/ /de ltar dbang bskur chu gyur pas//dbu la mi bskyod rgyal po ste/ /ral pa'i cod pan gyes brgyan pa'i/ /mig 48—951

sman lha bu bsgom par bya/ /yang ni snying ga'i sa bon 'od/ /byung ba'i lha mo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /yang dag mchod cing bdag nyid kyi/ /lha yi sbyor ba brtan par bsgom/ /de nas gal te zlos 'dod na/ /'di lta ste ces pa sogs so/ /de las ldang bar 'dod na ni/ /smon lam dag kyang gdab par bya//gos sngon lag na rdo rje yi/ /go 'phangs myur du thob par shog /bsod nams 'di yis 'gro ba ni/ /ma lus pa yis de thob shog /de nas de nyid gsum brjod pas/ /rang snying sa bon rang dkyil 'khor/ /bsdus te lha yi rnam pa yi//nga rgyal dag gis gnas par bya/ /sngon gyi slob dpon gyis byas gzhung / /rgya che 'am 'khrugs dang bsdus pa dag /mthong nas de dag rtogs phyir brtsams/ /bdag la mkhas rnams bzod par mdzod/ /rje btsun phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs gzungs kyi rjes su 'a ngas pa rdzogs so// //'di stong pa nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa yin te/ rgya skad lhug pa yin yang bod skad tshigs ⑫bcad du sdebs par snang / tshig phal cher sgrub thabs rgyas pa ba ri 'gyur dang tshig gcig tu 'dug pa rnams ba ri'i 'gyur ltar bris nas 'bru zhus rgya dpe dang gtugs pa'o// //48—952

sman lta bu bsgom par bya/ /yang ni snying ga'i sa bon 'od/ /byung ba'i lha mo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /yang dag mchod cing bdag nyid kyi/ /lha yi sbyor ba brtan par bsgom/ /de nas gal te zlos 'dod na/ /'di lta ste ces pa sogs so/ /de las ldang bar 'dod na ni/ /smon lam dag kyang gdab par bya//gos sngon lag na rdo rje yi/ /go 'phangs myur du thob par shog /bsod nams 'di yis 'gro ba ni/ /ma lus pa yis de thob shog /de nas de nyid gsum brjod pas/ /rang snying sa bon rang dkyil 'khor/ /bsdus te lha yi rnam pa yi//nga rgyal dag gis gnas par bya/ /sngon kyi slob dpon gyis byas gzhung / /rgya che 'am 'khrugs dang bsdus pa dag /mthong nas de dag rtogs phyir brtsams/ /bdag la mkhas rnams bzod par mdzod/ /rje btsun phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs gzungs kyi rjes su 'brangs pa rdzogs so// //'di stong pa nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa yin te/ rgya skad lhug pa yin yang bod skad tshigs ①bcad du sdebs par snang / tshig phal cher sgrub thabs rgyas pa ba ri 'gyur dang tshig gcig tu 'dug pa rnams ba ri'i 'gyur ltar bris nas 'bru zhus rgya dpe dang gtugs pa'o// //48—952

bsdur mchan/949 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/95 ①〈〈pe 〉stago ②〈〈pe 〉gnam/951 ①〈〈pe 〉〉tshogabasdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (2918)48—953

chog /'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i gzungs/⑫ga 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i gzungs bzhugs so//ra /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya nī lāsba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi kal pa tsā ma ṅgā ra tī/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can/ sangs rgyas gang ga'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis rjes su gnang ba/ mche ba gcigs pa dang 'tsham pa/ mig me stag gi phung po 'dra ba/ dbugs me lce ltar 'bar ba/ 'jigs pa'i nga ro can—/ lag pa dang / rkang pa klu nor rgyas kyi bus brgyan pa/ klu nag po se ral khar thogs pa/ klu dga' bo dang nye dga' bo 'bar bas rna cha byas pa/sprul 'bar ba rin po che'i cod pan thogs pa/ sprul gdug pa 'bar ba za ba/bzhin rgyas pa/ smin ma dang dpral ba bsdus pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/48—964

༄ga /'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i gzungs/⑨to 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon can kyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i gzungs bzhugs so//༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya nī khāsba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi kal pa nā ma dh+wa ra bhā/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can/ sangs rgyas gang ga'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis rjes su gnang ba/ mche ba gcigs pa dang 'tsham pa/ mig me stag gi phung po 'dra ba/ dbugs me lce ltar 'bar ba/ 'jigs pa'i nga ro can—/ lag pa dang / rkang pa klu nor rgyas kyi bus brgyan pa/ klu nag po se ral khar thogs pa/ klu dga' bo dang nye dga' bo 'bar bas rna cha byas pa/srul 'bar ba rin po che'i cod pan thogs pa/ sbrul gdug pa 'bar ba za ba/bzhin rgyas pa/ smin ma dang dpral ba bsdus pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/48—954

gshin rje'i cha byad can/ lce glog ltar 'grur ①ba/ gsus po che/ sbrul za ba/lag pa brdabs pa'i sgras 'jigs par byed pa/ klu'i rgyal po 'dab bzang ske rags su bcings pa/ a la la zhes sgog ②par byed pa/ rgya mtsho zabs su dpag tshad brgyad khri yod pas/ rkang pa'i pus mor phyin pa dbang po dang nyi ma phrag pa la khur ba/ klu thams cad rlag par byed pa/ gad rgyangs chen po rgod pas kun du 'khrugs par byed pa/ gshin rje'i gzugs can/ khams gsum pa 'jigs par byed pa/ klu rnams 'jigs par byed pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ga'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis gsungs pa'i rig chasngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /tar+ya thā/ sgo sgo pā na/ nā ga a dhi pa tā ye/ i dan rī khāsba ra dha ra sha rī ram̐/ badz+ra pā ṇi hri da yo yaḥ sa mā ti kra mā dze+e/ ud sā da dzā/ bha bi sh+ya ti/ tad ya thā/ budha/ budha/ bi budha/bi budha/ ma ti kra ma tha ha ra ha ra/ nā ga rna/ pra ha ra pra ha ra nā ga rna/tshin da tshin da/ nā ga hri da yā ni/ bhin da bhin da/ na ga marmā ṇi/bi shir+yan+tu nā ga /sha rī ra ṇi/ bi sbo ṭā ya nā ga na ya ni/ tar+ya thā/ hūṃ phaṭa/nā ga bi dā ra zla ya phaṭa/ nā god hā ra nā ya phaṭa/ — la shā pa nā ya phaṭa/a pra ti ha ra/ ba la pa ta kra mā ya phaṭa/ kri tān tā ya phaṭa/ kri tān tā ru pā ya phaṭa/ ro ṣa ṇa ya phaṭa/ tā ba nā ya phaṭa/ kum+bhaṇ+ḍi rda sā da nā ya phaṭa/pre ta pi shā tsa/ bi rtswa sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ yak+ṣa a ba sma ra bi nā sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ha sa ha sa/ dā ra dā ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ nā sha ya/ nā sha ya/ sarba bispyon bi ṭ+wā sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ sarba shā trun sang gha bi nā sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ oṃ nī lāsba ra dha ra badz+ra pa ṇi rādz+nyā pa ya nyi swā hā/ de'i cho ga la gnod sbyin gyis zin 48—955

gshin rje'i cha byad can/ lce glog lhar 'gyur ⑫ba/ gsus po che/ sprul za ba/lag pa brdabs pa'i sgras 'jigs par byed pa/ klu'i rgyal po 'dab bzang ske rags su bcings pa/ a la la zhes sgrog ②par byed pa/ rgya mtsho zabs su dpag tshad brgyad khri yod pas/ rkang pa'i pus mor phyin pa dbang po dang nyi ma phrag pa la khur ba/ klu thams cad rlag par byed pa/ gad rgyangs chen po rgod pas kun du 'khrugs par byed pa/ gshin rje'i gzugs can/ khams gsum pa 'jigs par byed pa/ klu rnams 'jigs par byed pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ga'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis gsungs pa'i rig ⑫sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /tadu thā/ sgo sgo pā na/ nā ga a dhi pa tā ye/ i dan nī lngasba ra dha ra sha rī re/ badz+ra pā ṇi tri da yi yaḥ sa mā ti kra mā paṃ/ ud sā da dzā/ bha ji sh+ya ti/ tad ya thā/ budha/ burnya/ ji budha/'i budha/ ma ti kra ma tha ha ra ha ra/ nā ga ne+e/ pra ha ra pra ha ra tsā ga ne+e/tshin da tshin da/ nā ga hri da yā ni/ rnyin da rnyin da/ na ga maṅgā ṇi/ji shir+yaskyo tsā ga /sha rī ra ṇi/ ji sbo ṭā ya tsā ga na ya ni/ tar+ya thā/ hūṃ phaṭa/tsā ga ji dā ra ṇ+ḍa ya phaṭa/ nā god hā ra tsā ya phaṭa/ bhā la shā pa nā ya phaṭa/sa pra ti ha ra/ ba la pa ta kra mā ya phaṭa/ kri tān tā ya phaṭa/ kri tān tā ru pā ya phaṭa/ ro ṣa ṇ+ḍa ya phaṭa/ tā ba nā ya phaṭa/ kum+bhaṇ+ḍi rda sā da nā ya phaṭa/pre ta pi shā tsa/ bi nī sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ yak+ṣa a ba sma ra ji tsā sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ha sa ha sa/ dā ra dā ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ tsā sha ya/ tsā sha ya/ sarba jisnan bi tsā sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ sarba shā trun sang gha bi nā sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ oṃ nī lngasba ra dha ra badz+ra pa ṇi rātshwa pa ya ti swā hā/ de'i cho ga la gnod sbyin gyis zin 48—965

pa la/ chu la sngags kyis btab ste gtor na gtong bar 'gyur ro/ /klu bzlog par 'dod na/ smag shad kyi lcug ma 'am/ bal po bse ru'i lcug mas bya'o/ / yi dwags 1dang brjed byed rnams la skud pas bya'o/ /rims nad med par bya ba dang / gzhogs phyed na ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa la ni skud pa sngon pos bya'o/ /nor 'dod na zhag gcig myung bar 'dug ste/ spos phor gyis bdugs na rmi lam du dge ba dang mi dge ba'i don thams cad ston la/ gser gyi dong rtse bdun stong sbyin par byed do/ /rgyas btab pa grol bar 'dod na thal bas bya'o/ /sgo lcags dbye bar 'dod na yungs kar gyis bya'o/ /'jigs pa thams cad bsrung ba la ni mar rnying pa'am/ thal ba'am/ yungs kar gyis bya'o/ /nad kyi 'jigs pa thams cad la ni/ skud pa sngon po la bsrung ba'i mdud pa byas te—/ mgul du btags na bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /byes pa gdon byis nyen pa la ni/ mtshon sna lnga'i skud pa la bsrung ba'i mdud pa byas te/mgul du btags na bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /chom rkun bzlog par 'dod na sas bya'o/ /dug la ni rtswa ku shas byab par bya'o/ /bdag bsrung ba la ni yid kyis sam chus bya'o/ /gzhan bsrung ba la no skud pa sngon pos bya'o/ /las de dag thams cad la sngags brjod pa ni lan gsum mam/ bdun nam/bcu bzhi'am/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ brgya rtsa brgyad brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar byas na 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /mchod rten sku gdung dang ldan pa'i drung du/me tog sngon pos mchod de/ sngags stong bzlas brjod byas na 'grub par 'gyur ro—/ /'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can byi cho ga zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// //48—956

pa la/ chu la sngags kyis btab ste gtor na gtong bar 'gyur ro/ /klu bzlog par 'dod na/ smag shad kyi lhag ma 'am/ bal po bse ru'i lhag mas bya'o/ / yi dwags ⑫dang brjed byed rnams la skud pas bya'o/ /rims nad med par bya ba dang / gzhogs phyed na ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa la ni skud pa sngon pos bya'o/ /nor 'dod na zhag gcig smyung bar 'dug ste/ spos phor gyis bdugs na thi lam du dge ba dang mi dge ba'i don thams cad ston la/ gser gyi dong rtse bdun stong sbyin par byed do/ /rgyas btab pa grol bar 'dod na thal bas bya'o/ /sgo lcags dbye bar 'dod na yungs kar gyis bya'o/ /'jigs pa thams cad bsrung ba la ni mar rnying pa'am/ thal ba'am/ yungs kar gyis bya'o/ /nad kyi 'jigs pa thams cad la ni/ skud pa sngon po la bsrung ba'i mdud pa byas te—/ mgul du btags na bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /byis pa gdon gyis nyen pa la ni/ mtshon sna lnga'i skud pa la bsrung ba'i mdud pa byas te/mgul du btags na bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /chom rkun bzlog par 'dod na sas bya'o/ /dug la ni rtswa ku shas byab par bya'o/ /bdag bsrung ba la ni yid kyis sam chus bya'o/ /gzhan bsrung ba la ni skud pa sngon pos bya'o/ /las de dag thams cad la sngags brjod pa ni lan gsum mam/ bdun nam/bcu bzhi'am/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ brgya rtsa brgyad brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar byas na 'grub par 'byur ro/ /mchod rten sku gdung dang ldan pa'i drung du/me tog sngon pos mchod de/ sngags stong bzlas brjod byas na 'grub par 'gyur ro—/ /'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// //48—966

༄ga /mkha' lding gi sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ga ru ṭa sā dha na/ bod skad du/ mkha' lding gi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' lding zhes pa rkang pa nas ni dpyi mthar ser po de bzhin lte ba'i mtshalas su kha ba'i mdog /mgrin pa'i bar du kha dog dmar po sprin nag dang mtshungs smin ma'i 'khril shing ji srid nyid du ste/ /de las gong du kha dog sna tshogs gdengs can rigs dang bcas pa de nyid lnga yis rgyas btab pa/ /bsgoms na de yi phyag rgyas gdengs can dug dang 'byung po'i nad la sogs pa dag kyang nges par 'phrog /rang gi snying ga'i pad+ma dag la nyi ma'i steng du spyo gi yi ge 'dab chags mgon po ni/ /klu yi rgyan dang ldan zhing mtha' dag rigs kyi dbang gi kha dog lnga rnams 'phro ba bsgom par bya/ /de nas 'dab chags mgon po'i sngags ni dang por oṃ yig dag dang pak+ṣ-i swā hā'i mtha' can te/ /de ni bye ba phrag gcig bzlas nas 48—958

mas /mkha' lding gi sgrub thabs/⑫ma /rgya gar skad du/ ga ru ṭa sā dha na/ bod skad du/ mkha' lding gi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' lding zhes pa rkang pa nas ni dpyi mthar ser po de bzhin lte ba'i mtshams su kha ba'i mdog /mgrin pa'i bar du kha dog dmar po sprin nag dang mtshungs smin ma'i 'khril shing ji srid nyid du ste/ /de las gong du kha dog sna tshogs gdengs can rigs dang bcas pa de nyid lnga yis rgyas btab pa/ /bsgoms na de yi phyag rgyas gdengs can dug dang 'byung po'i nad la sogs pa dag kyang nges par 'phrog /rang gi snying ga'i pad+ma dag la nyi ma'i steng du k+ṣi gi yi ge 'dab chags mgon po ni/ /klu yi rgyan dang ldan zhing mtha' dag rigs kyi dbang gi kha dog lnga rnams 'phro ba bsgom par bya/ /de nas 'dab chags mgon po'i sngags ni dang por oṃ yig dag dang pak+ṣi swā hā'i mtha' can te/ /de ni bye ba phrag gcig bzlas nas 48—958

gdengs can rigs dang bcas pa'i 'dab chags mgon po bsgrub par bya /mkha' lding 'grub na gdengs can bdag po'i bu rnams mngag gzhug nyid du nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ /rab mchog sa yi steng du 'byung po gnod sbyin gdon rnams dag dang mkha' 'gro ma dang ma mo rnams/ /sngags kyis dgug par rab tu 'gyur te gdon rmi tshogs pa mtha' dag dus kyi sos zin brjod par byed/ /de phyir sems can don gyi be+ed du dang por mi rnams kyis ni mkha' lding dbang po sgrub par byed/ /'dis ji ltar bya ba dug gso ba'i cho ga zhib mo ni rgyud las rtogs par bya'o/ /mkha' lding gi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //'di'i rgya skad dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud tshig las bkol pa kho na yin pa ste/jo nang lo tsa blo gros dpal dang / sa bzang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur gsar ji lta bar bris so// //48—959

gdengs can rigs dang bcas pa'i 'dab chags mgon po bsgrub par bya/ /mkha' lding 'grub na gdengs can bdag po'i bu rnams mngag gzhug nyid du nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ /rab mchog sa yi steng du 'byung po gnod sbyin gdon rnams dag dang mkha' 'gro ma dang ma mo rnams/ /sngags kyis dgug par rab tu 'gyur te gdon gyi tshogs pa mtha' dag dus kyi sos zin brjod par byed/ /de phyir sems can don gyi slad du dang por mi rnams kyis ni mkha' lding dbang po sgrub par byed/ /'dis ji lhar bya ba dug gso ba'i cho ga zhib mo ni rgyud las rtogs par bya'o/ /mkha' lding gi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //'di'i rgya skad dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud tshig las bkol pa kho na yin pa ste/jo nang lo tsa blo gros dpal dang / sa bzang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur gsar ji lta bar bris so// //48—959

chog /rdo rje gtum mo'i sgrub zabs/⑫༄ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍi kā sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/ rdo rje gtum mo'i spub thabs/ 'jigs byed chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su/ mchod pa dang kator ma la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dag rab tu bsams te/ phyi nas stong pa nyid du bya'o/ /de nas dur khrod kyi gnas su/ /mi ro'i gdan la jiḥyig go/ /de las rdo rje gtum ⑤mo nag mo chen mo skra thor tshugs su bcings pa/ /mche ba gcigs shing mig gsum pa phyag g.yas kyi dang pos ni mdung rtse gsum pa sdang bar byed pa la bsnun pa'o| /gnyis pa na ral gri/ gsum pa na mda'/ bzhi pa na lcags kyu/lnga pa na 'khor lo/ drug pa na dgra sta'o/ /g.yon gyi dang pos ni gdug pa'i mgo bo/ gnyis pa na phub/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na kham phor khrag 48—961

༄ga /rdo rje gtum mo'i sgrub thabs/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍi kā sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ rdo rje gtum mo'i sgrub thabs/ 'jigs byed chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su/ mchod pa dang gtor ma la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dag rab tu bsams te/ phyi nas stong pa nyid du bya'o/ /de nas dur khrod kyi gnas su/ /mi ro'i gdan la byāḥyig go/ /de las rdo rje gtum ②mo nag mo chen mo skra thor tshugs su bcings pa/ /mche ba gcigs shing mig gsum pa phyag g.yas kyi dang pos ni mdung rtse gsum pa sdang bar byed pa la bsnun pa'o—/ /gnyis pa na ral gri/ gsum pa na mda'/ bzhi pa na lcags kyu/lnga pa na 'khor lo/ drug pa na dgra sta'o/ /g.yon gyi dang pos ni gdug pa'i mgo bo/ gnyis pa na phub/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na kham phor khrag 48—961

gis gang ba/ /lnga pa na zhags pa/ drug pa ni sdigs 'dzub bo/ /g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis gdong lnga pa la bzhon pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i cod pan can/ mgo bo'i do shal dang / me tog dang 'phreng ba la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis spud pa/ sgeg cing rnam par gcigs pa gzhon nu ma'i lus can no/ /gang 'di las kyi rjes su 'brel pa'i kha dog can du bdag nyid bsam par bya'o/ /oṃ lha'im hā kā li de dī ka ra la bi kran+da kā la rā tri tsaṇ+ḍa ru pi ṇi hūṃ pha ṭa/ snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍi ha ha hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ṭī hūṃ/ shin tu nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā li de bī kṛṇ+ḍa ba lo a nu ka kha kha khā nyi khā nyi/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ sbo ṭa ya sbo ṭa ya/ baṃ hriḥhūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa ni gtor ma'i sngags so/ /gang zhig sngags 'dis nyin ⑫dang nyin la lan brgya rtsa brgyad du gtor ma 'bul bar byed pa de ni bde ba dang / 'byor pa dang / 'dod pa thams cad byed do—/ /rdo rje gtum mo'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //gsar 'gyur ro//48—962

gis gang ba/ /lnga pa na zhags pa/ drug pa ni sdigs 'dzub bo/ /g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis gdong lnga pa la bzhon pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i cod pan can/ mgo bo'i do shal dang / me tog dang 'phreng ba la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis spud pa/ sgeg cing rnam par gcigs pa gzhon nu ma'i lus can no/ /gang 'di las kyi rjes su 'byel pa'i kha dog can du bdag nyid bsam par bya'o/ /oṃ sto ma hā kā li de bī ka ra la bi kran+da kā la rā tri tsaṇ+ḍa ru pi ṇi hūṃ pha ṭa/ snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍi ha ha hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ s+thā hūṃ/ shin tu nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā li de bī greṇ+ḍa ba lo a mu ka kha kha khā ti khā ti/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ sgo ṭa ya sgo ṭa ya/ baṃ hriḥhūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa ni gtor ma'i sngags so/ /gang zhig sngags 'dis nyin ①dang nyin la lan brgya rtsa brgyad du gtor ma 'bul bar byed pa de ni bde ba dang / 'byor pa dang / 'dod pa thams cad byed do—/ /rdo rje gtum mo'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //gsar 'gyur ro//48—962

༄ga /rgan byad ma'i grub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsa muṇ+ḍa sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ rgan byad ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'jigs byed chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du bshad pa'i cho gas stong pa nyid kyi don bsam par bya'o/ /phyi nas nyi ma la gnas pa'i rtsa yig gi sa bon las/ tsa muṇ+ḍi sku mdog dmar mo/ 'jigs 'jigs ltar snang ba/ skra 'dzings pa/ mche ba gatshigs pa/ mig gsum pa/phyag g.yas pas gri gug dang / g.yon pas thod par khrag 'thung ba/ mi'i pags pas stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs su byas pa/ mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can 'bar ba 'bar ba'i lus can/ mi ro la bzhon te nam mkhar 'gro ba/ dur khrod kyi sa gzhir rab tu dgyes pa'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes bya bas byen gyis brlab cing / khro bo chen pos dbu la brgyan par bya'o/ /oṃ rtsa tsā ra tsā ya tsā ra tsā ya hūṃ hriḥ'abum phrag gsum du bzlas pas las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /48byed964

tshog /rgan byad ma'i skub thabs/⑫༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ tsa nusmo sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/ rgan byad ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'jigs byed chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du bshad pa'i cho gas stong pa nyid kyi don bsam par bya'o/ /phyi nas nyi ma la gnas pa'i rtsa yig gi sa bon las/ tsa nuṇ+ḍi sku mdog dmar mo/ 'jigs 'jigs ltar snang ba/ skra 'dzings pa/ mche ba gcigs pa/ mig gsum pa/phyag g.yas pas gri gug dang / g.yon pas thod par khrag 'thung ba/ mi'i pags pas stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs su byas pa/ mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can 'bar ba 'bar ba'i lus can/ mi ro la bzhon te nam mkhar 'gro ba/ dur khrod kyi sa gzhir rab tu dgyes pa'o/ /oṃlha'ihūṃ zhes bya bas byin gyis brlab cing / khro bo chen pos dbu la brgyan par bya'o/ /oṃ rtsa tsā ra tsā ya tsā ra tsā ya hūṃ hriḥ'abum phrag gsum du bzlas pas las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /48—964

༄ga /rang byin gyis brlab pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/①to rang byin kyis brlab pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ swā dhiṣ+ṭha na ma hā kā la sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du—/ rang byin gyis brlab pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jigs byed chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba snang mthar byed/ /de yi sgrub pa rab bshad de/ /lha dang 'byung po 'jigs byed cing / /bgegs rnams nyams par byed pa'o/ /de la dur khrod la sogs par nag po chen po bsgrub par bya'o—/ /sgron ma lnga dang stsos byed la sogs pa dam tshig lhag par gnas pa dang /yi ge hūṃ las yang dag par byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje bsam par bya'o/ /de las ni bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra tī le tī la ya sarba bighān brnya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya bas phyogs bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas gru gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor der/ dpal nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa/48byed966

tshog /rang byin gyis brlab pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/⑫sha rang byin gyis brlab pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ swā dhiṣ+ṭha na ma hā kā la sā dha ne+e/ bod skad du—/ rang byin gyis brlab pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jigs byed chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba snang mthar byed/ /de yi sgrub pa rab bshad de/ /lha dang 'byung po 'jigs byed cing / /bgegs rnams nyams par byed pa'o/ /de la dur khrod la sogs par nag po chen po bsgrub par bya'o—/ /sgron ma lnga dang myos byed la sogs pa dam tshig lhag par gnas pa dang /yi ge hūṃ las yang dag par byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje bsam par bya'o/ /de las ni bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra tī li khri la ya sarba bisgyun brnya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya bas phyogs bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas gru gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor der/ dpal nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa/48—966

dam tshig gi mchod pas mchod par bya ste/ me ma hā kā la ya na maḥḍi/ ḍā ki nī ye na maḥ re rā ki nī ye na maḥ lo lā gi rī ye na maḥ shaṃ ka ra lī ye na maḥzhes bya ba'i sngags kyis so/ /de 'og tu sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa byas nas/oṃ myuḥ zhes bya bas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /phyi nas byams pa dang /snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dag bsgom zhing / oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+tha ko3haṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis stong pa nyid du byen gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas dur khrod chen po'i dbus su/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa'o/ /bha ga'i dbus ni o ḍi ya na'o/ /g.yas kyi zur ni dza lan+ta ra'o/ /g.yon gyi zur ni kā ma ru pa'o/ /mdun gyi zur ni ku dzi ka'o/ /dbus su nus pa'i sa bon hūṃ bsam par bya'o/ /de las byung ba'i nag po chen po ni/ mig sman ltar gnag pa/ spyan dmar po gsum dang ldan pa/g.yas dang g.yon du dmar po dang ljang khu'i zhal lo/ /phyag g.yas kyi dang po na be con mi mgos brgyan pa'o/ /gnyis pa na ni cang te'u'o/ /g.yon gyi dang po na ni tri shu la'o/ /gnyis pa na ni zhags pas bcing bar byed pa'o/ /tha ma dag gi gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni dmar mo ste kha ṭī ga dang / chang snod 'dzin pas phrag pa nas 'khyud pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis rtse ba/rje btsun ni be sha kha'i 'dug stangs kyis gnas pa/ sdang ba dang gdug par byed pa rnams 'gyel ba'i steng du/ rdo rje myos byed chen po'i rgyab tu nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ sma ra dang yin ma ni rab tu ser ba/ 'bar ba chen po'i sku mgo skyes gyen du bgreng zhing / klu chen po brgyad dang mgo bo'i do shal can—/ thung zhing spom pa lpags pa'i gos can du blta bar bya'o/ /zur 48—967

dam tshig gi mchod pas mchod par bya ste/ paṃ ma hā kā la ya na maḥḍi/ ḍā ki rī ye na maḥ re rā ki rī ye na maḥ lo lnga gi rī ye na maḥ ke ka ra lī ye na maḥzhes bya ba'i sngags kyis so/ /de 'og tu sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa byas nas/oṃ muḥ zhes bya bas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /phyi nas byams pa dang /snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dag bsgom zhing / oṃ shu n+ya ta tshwa na badz+ra su bhā wa mtsho ko3haṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis stong pa nyid du byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas dur khrod chen po'i dbus su/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa'o/ /bha ga'i dbus ni yo ḍi ya na'o/ /g.yas kyi zur ni dza larnya ra'o/ /g.yon gyi zur ni kā ma ru pa'o/ /mdun gyi zur ni ku dzi ka'o/ /dbus su nus pa'i sa bon hūṃ bsam par bya'o/ /de las byung ba'i nag po chen po ni/ mig sman ltar gnag pa/ spyan dmar po gsum dang ldan pa/g.yas dang g.yon du dmar po dang ljang khu'i zhal lo/ /phyag g.yas kyi dang po na be con mi mgos brgyan pa'o/ /gnyis pa na ni cang te'u'o/ /g.yon gyi dang po na ni tri shu la'o/ /gnyis pa na ni zhags pas bcing bar byed pa'o/ /tha ma dag gi gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni dmar mo ste kha ṭī ga dang / chang snod 'dzin pas phrag pa nas 'khyud pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis rtse ba/rje btsun ni be sha kha'i 'dug stangs kyis gnas pa/ sdang ba dang gdug par byed pa rnams 'gyel ba'i steng du/ rdo rje myos byed chen po'i rgyab tu nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ sma ra dang smin ma ni rab tu ser ba/ 'bar ba chen po'i sku mgo skyes gyen du bsgreng zhing / klu chen po brgyad dang mgo bo'i do shal can—/ thung zhing sbom pa lpags pa'i gos can du blta bar bya'o/ /zur 48—967

gsum po dag la/ rā gi ni dang / lā gi ni dang / ka rā li ni rnams/nag mo kha ṭī ga dang / thod pa khrag can 'dzin pa dag go/ /de nas nag po chen po yongs su bkug ste/ gnyis su med par byas nas sngags bzla bar bya'o//oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā kā la swā dhiṣ+ṭha na saṃ paṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so//oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la hre hre k+ṣe tra pā la sismyon bi tsā sha ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ ces pa ni rab tu bskul ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā dzhai ra wa sarba si dhi dā ya ka ḍi hūṃ/rku hūṃ ṭaḥ ces pa ni grub pa rnams 'bebs par byed pa'i sngags so/ /sngon du bshad pa'i cho gas gtor ma sbyin par byed do/ /dbang bskur ba la 'di sbyin bya//gzhan du gtum zhing khro bas gsod/ /dngos grub kun gyi sbyor sgrub pa/ /bla ma'i drin las don yod yin/ /rang byin gyis brlab pa nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //gsar 'gyur yin no// //48—968—

gsum po dag la/ rā gi ni dang / lā gi ni dang / ka rā li ni rnams/nag mo kha ṭī ga dang / thod pa khrag can 'dzin pa dag go/ /de nas nag po chen po yongs su bkug ste/ gnyis su med par byas nas sngags bzla bar bya'o//oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā kā la swā dhiṣ+ṭha na saṃ paṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so//oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la hri hri k+ṣe tra pā la sispyon bi nā sha ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ ces pa ni rab tu bskul ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā bye ra wa sarba se dhi dā ya ka ḍi hūṃ/rku bye ṭaḥ ces pa ni grub pa rnams 'bebs par byed pa'i sngags so/ /sngon du bshad pa'i cho gas gtor ma sbyin par byed do/ /dbang bskur ba la 'di sbyin bya//gzhan du gtum zhing khro bas gsod/ /dngos grub kun gyi sbyor sgrub pa/ /bla ma'i drin las don yod yin/ /rang byen gyis brlab pa nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //gsar 'gyur yin no// //rke 48—968

phag /nag po chen po'i spub thabs/⑫༄ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā la sā dha ne+e/ bod skad du/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nim+bi'i shing la nag po chen po bya ste/ gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa/ skra gyen du langs pa/thod pa'i cod pan can/ lus la sprul gyis brgyan pa/ spyan dmar ba/mche ba gcigs pa'i zhal/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mi mgo'i 'phreng ba'i do shal dang ldan pa/ yi dwags kyi gdan la gnas pa/ mun pa mi bzad pa'i rang bzhin du bsgoms la/ nag po'i tshes gcig nas sgrub pa brtsams te/ de'i zhal lhor bstan la bzhag /kha shar du bstan la/ sngags stong phrag bcu bzlas par bya'o/ /dam tshig gi rdzas kyi gtor ma phul la/ gu gul gyi bdug spos dbul bar bya'o/ /me tog sna tshogs pas gtor nas/ oṃ sa si nu pa la tri shu la/ e h+ye nyi/ ma hā kā la sarba shā trun/ nirgyu da na/48—970

༄ga /nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/①༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā la sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nim+bi'i shing la nag po chen po bya ste/ gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa/ skra gyen du langs pa/thod pa'i cod pan can/ lus la sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ spyan dmar ba/mche ba gcigs pa'i zhal/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mi mgo'i 'phreng ba'i do shal dang ldan pa/ yi dwags kyi gdan la gnas pa/ mun pa mi bzad pa'i rang bzhin du bsgoms la/ nag po'i tshes gcig nas sgrub pa brtsams te/ de'i zhal lhor bstan la bzhag /kha shar du bstan la/ sngags stong phrag bcu bzlas par bya'o/ /dam tshig gi rdzas kyi gtor ma phul la/ gu gul gyi bdug spos dbul bar bya'o/ /me tog sna tshogs pas gtor nas/ oṃ a si mu pa la tri shu la/ e bye hi/ ma hā kā la sarba shā trun/ nispyo da na/48—970

nisgro da ya/ dz+wa re ṇa/ kṛṇ+ḍa pā ya kṛṇ+ḍa pā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bza' ba spangs la bzlas par bya'o/ /dam tshig rnams tshang bar byas la sngon du phyogs pas sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /sngon du bshad pa bzhin gtor ma dbul lo/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na brjo ṇa gā hā/ zhes bya ba 'bum phrag gcig bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na badz+re ṇa ma ma ka rdu ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes 'bum phrag gnyis bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na badz+re ṇa e dang pre sha yā mi ka raḥswā hā/ zhes 'bum phrag gsum bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ba lo kṛṇ+ḍa kārdu ku ru dzaḥdzaḥ zhes bya ba gtor ma'i sngags so/ /dang por rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub pa byas la/ /de'i 'og tu nag po chen po bsgrub par bya'o/ /nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //'di kha che paṇa chen dang lo tsa ba rab mchog dpal gyi 'gyur zangs ma'o// //

nir+gha da ya/ dz+wa re ṇa/ kṛṇ+ḍa pā ya kṛṇ+ḍi pā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bza' ba spangs la bzlas par bya'o/ /dam tshig rnams tshang bar byas la sngon du phyogs pas sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /sngon du bshad pa bzhin gtor ma dbul lo/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na badzo ṇa swā hā/ zhes bya ba 'bum phrag gcig bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na badz+re ṇa ma ma ka : ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes 'bum phrag gnyis bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na badz+re ṇa e dang pre sha yā mi ka raḥswā hā/ zhes 'bum phrag gsum bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ba dzi kṛṇ+ḍa kātram̐ ku ru dzaḥdzaḥ zhes bya ba gtor ma'i sngags so/ /dang por rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub pa byas la/ /de'i 'og tu nag po chen po bsgrub par bya'o/ /nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //'di kha che paṇa chen dang lo tsa ba rab mchog dpal byi 'gyur zangs ma'o// //48—971
