tshog /nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/⑫ga nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ra /rgya gar skad du/ma hā kā la sā dha na/ bod skad du/ nag po chen po'i skrub thabs/nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i gnas ni bsrung ba'i phyir/ /gtsug lag khang gi sgor gnas shing / /dri gtsang khang gi nang gnas par/ /nag po che dgod rnal 'byor pas/ /snying rje'i sems ni rab bskyed de/ /tsā las byung ba'i stobs po che/ /sku mdog nag po gdong bzhi pa/ /lto ba 'phyang ba bcu gnyis lag /stag lpags kyis ni smad dkris shing / /dbu la thod pa'i 'phreng bas brgyan/ /mche ba gatshigs shing mi bzad pa/ /mgo bo'i 'phreng ba mgul du 'chang / /rkang pa lag pa'ang rnam brgyan pa/ /smin ma skra yang ser skya ste/ /spyan gsum gyis ni rnam par spras/ /dang po'i zhal ni nag po mtshungs//g.yas pa sngon por snang ba ste/ /g.yon pa dmar po shin tu mdzes/ /rgyab ni dri 48—973

༄ga /nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/①༄na nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༄pha /rgya gar skad du/ma hā kā la sā dha na/ bod skad du/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i gnas ni bsrung ba'i phyir/ /gtsug lag khang gi sgor gnas shing / /dri gtsang khang gi nang gnas par/ /nag po che dgod rnal 'byor pas/ /snying rje'i sems ni rab bskyed de/ /rmā las byung ba'i stobs po che/ /sku mdog nag po gdong bzhi pa/ /lto ba 'phyang ba bcu gnyis lag /stag lpags kyis ni smad dkris shing / /dbu la thod pa'i 'phreng bas brgyan/ /mche ba gcigs shing mi bzad pa/ /mgo bo'i 'phreng ba mgul du 'chang / /rkang pa lag pa'ang rnam brgyan pa/ /smin ma skra yang ser skya ste/ /spyan gsum gyis ni rnam par spras/ /dang po'i zhal ni nag po mtshungs//g.yas pa sngon por snang ba ste/ /g.yon pa dmar po shin tu mdzes/ /rgyab ni dri 48—973

bcas du ba'i mdog /nyi ma 'bum dang mtshungs pa ste/ /de yi gdong ni bsam par bya/ /dang po ral gri 'dzin pa ste/ /de bzhin gnyis pa tho ba bsnams/ /gcig shos dang po thod pa ni/ /snying dang khrag gis gang ba ste/ /gnyis pa na ni kha ṭī bsnams/ /de bzhin g.yas dang g.yon pa yi/ /gsum pa rgyud mangs bsgreng la brtson/ /bzhi pa dag ni gar gyi tshul/ /de yi phyi nas gnyis po ni/ /rtse gsum dang ni dgra sta ste/ /mi yi lngags pa khrag 'dzag pa/ /gnyis kyi steng du 'dzin pa'o/ /'dug stangs rnam pa sna tshogs te/ /gar byed de bzhin g.yas brkyang ba/ /mnyam par bzhag pas bsgom par bya/ /de bzhin du ni de yi 'khor/ /mi gdug gdong can mkha' 'gro ma/ /seṅge glang po dred dang sbrul/ /byi la dang ni khyi yi gdong / /thod pa'i nang du blugs pa'i khrag /'thung byed lag na tri shu la/ /ha ha zhes sgog ca co'i sgras/ /skye bo thams cad skrag byed pa'o—/ /bdag nyid gshin rje gshed po'i rnal 'byor gyis nag po chen po bkug ste—/ tsan dan dmar po las byas pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ snod chen po dag 'bras nag po'i zan dang / 'khur ba dang / snum 'khur dang / 'o thug dang /sgog pa dang / 'bru'i chan sna tshogs dang / sha dang / klad pa dang /tshil dang / zhag dang / nang khrol dang / rlon pa dang / rkam po dang /btsos pa'i dbye bas nya sha rnam pa gsum dang / nya dang / ra dang / ma he dang / mi'i gzugs brnyan dang / chang snod gang ba dang / thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang / me tog la sogs pa nye bar spyod pa thams cad dang /zangs dang / lcags kyi khab dag dang bcas pas bgang bar bya'o/ /gshin rje gshed kyi phyag rgyas mngon par btab la phyogs bcings te/ khro ba'i sems 48—974

bcas du ba'i mdog /nyi ma 'bum dang mtshungs pa ste/ /de yi gdong ni bsam par bya/ /dang po ral gri 'dzin pa ste/ /de bzhin gnyis pa tho ba bsnams/ /gcig shos dang po thod pa ni/ /snying dang khrag gis gang ba ste/ /gnyis pa na ni kha ṭī bsnams/ /de bzhin g.yas dang g.yon pa yi/ /gsum pa rgyud mangs bsgreng la brtson/ /bzhi pa dag ni gar gyi tshul/ /de yi phyi nas gnyis po ni/ /rtse gsum dang ni dgra sta ste/ /mi yi lngags pa khrag 'dzag pa/ /gnyis kyi steng du 'dzin pa'o/ /'dug stangs rnam pa sna tshogs te/ /gar byed de bzhin g.yas brkyang ba/ /mnyam par bzhag pas bsgom par bya/ /de bzhin du ni de yi 'khor/ /mi gdug gdong can mkha' 'gro ma/ /seṅge glang po dred dang sprul//byi la dang ni khyi yi gdong / /thod pa'i nang du blugs pa'i khrag /'thung byed lag na tri shu la/ /ha ha zhes sgrog ca co'i sgras/ /skye bo thams cad skrag byed pa'o| /bdag nyid gshin rje gshed po'i rnal 'byor gyis nag po chen po bkug ste—/ tsan dan dmar po las byas pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ snod chen po dag 'bras nag po'i zan dang / 'khur ba dang / snum 'khur dang / 'o thug dang /sgog pa dang / 'bru'i chan sna tshogs dang / sha dang / k+kad pa dang /tshil dang / zhag dang / nang khrol dang / rlon pa dang / rkam po dang /btsos pa'i dbye bas nya sha rnam pa gsum dang / nya dang / ra dang / ma te dang / mi'i gzugs brnyan dang / chang snod gang ba dang / thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang / me tog la sogs pa nye bar spyod pa thams cad dang /zangs dang / lcags kyi khab dag dang bcas pas bgang bar bya'o/ /gshin rje gshed kyi phyag rgyas mngon par btab la phyogs bcings te/ khro ba'i sems 48—974

dang ldan pas spyan drang bar bya'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la a ya ti/ ma hā bi ha ra pā la na ya/ sarba ḍā ki nī/ yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/ sa pa ri ba rā na a tras na ni hi twa bha wa swā hā/ ces pa'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la sarba garnya/ put+pa dhu pa/ dī pa/ṣ+pe we t+ya/ sarba bsta a laṅgā ra k+ṣiṃdiñca/ pra tīts+tsha/ u pa bhu dza bh+yaḥ sarba duṣ+ṭa rmā/kā ya wāka tsi ṭ+wā/ ste bha ya/ ste bha ya/ ma ma sarba ā shaṃ/ pa ri sgo ra/ya tsa ya ba tha/ saṃ sā haṃ/ ma ma sarba sa tsā tsa/ sad su khaṃ/ brid+dhā ye/sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de bzhin du 'jig rten skyong ba bcu la'ang gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /gtor ma'i snod thor tshugs bcings pa'i bran gyi lag tu sbyin te/ dur khrod chen por dor bar bya'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ya na mo hūṃ phaṭa/ phyag 'tshal ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la rū pa ru tra sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa myur du 'bod pa'i snying po'o/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa pa ti ye swā hā/ na maḥshrī ma hā kā la ga ṇi shā ya/ na mo yo gi rī rna/ na mo ṭak+ki rī rna/ tar+ya thā/oṃ hi li ti li/ ki te ni ki te ni①/ tsit+ta ni tsit+ta ni/ di me di me swā hā/nag po chen po rab tu dga' bar byed pa'i snying po'o/ /yang na ni zhal gcig pa/phyag gnyis pa/ lag na be con thogs pa/ seṅge'i gdan la gnas pa/gtsug lag khang chen po bsrung ba'i don du bsgom par bya'o/ /ji srid rgyal bcas gtsug lag khang / /mchod rten chen po de bsrung 'gyur/ /des ni dge 'dun tshogs rnams kyang / /tshe ni ring por byed pa yin/ /ji srid nam mkha' nyi zla dang / /ji srid skar ma dag dang sa/ /ji srid rgya mtsho dang ni gling / /ji srid 'gro ba rigs drug gnas/ /nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //48—975

dang ldan pas spyan drang bar bya'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la sa ya ti/ ma hā bi ha ra pā la na ya/ sarba ḍā ki nī/ yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/ sa pa ri ba rā na a tras na ni hi twa bha wa swā hā/ ces pa'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la sarba garnya/ put+pa dhu pa/ dī pa/ne we t+ya/ sarba bstu a laṅgā ra udilca/ pra tīts+tsha/ u pa bhu dza bh+yaḥ sarba duṣ+ṭa shā/kā ya wāka tsi stu/ ste bha ya/ ste bha ya/ ma ma sarba ā shaṃ/ pa ri pū ra/ya tsa ya ba tha/ saṃ sā haṃ/ ma ma sarba sa hūṃ tsa/ sad su khaṃ/ briji ye/sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de bzhin du 'jig rten skyong ba bcu la'ang gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /gtor ma'i sdod thor tshugs bcings pa'i bran gyi lag tu sbyin te/ dur khrod chen por dor bar bya'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ya na mo hūṃ phaṭa/ phyag 'tshal ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la rū pa ru tra sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa myur du 'bod pa'i snying po'o/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa pa ti ye swā hā/ na maḥshrī ma hā kā la ga ṇi shā ya/ na mo yo gi rī dz+wa/ na mo ṭak+ki nī ne+e/ tadu thā/oṃ hi li ti li/ ki te ni ki te ni⑫/ tsit+ta ni tsit+ta ni/ di me di me swā hā/nag po chen po rab tu dga' bar byed pa'i snying po'o/ /yang na ni zhal gcig pa/phyag gnyis pa/ lag na be con thogs pa/ seṅge'i gdan la gnas pa/gtsug lag khang chen po bsrung ba'i don du bsgom par bya'o/ /ji srid rgyal bcas gtsug lag khang / /mchod rten chen po de bsrung 'gyur/ /des ni dge 'dun tshogs rnams kyang / /tshe ni ring por byed pa yin/ /ji srid nam mkha' nyi zla dang / /ji srid skar ma dag dang sa/ /ji srid rgya mtsho dang ni gling / /ji srid 'gro ba rigs drug gnas/ /nag po chen po'i spub thabs rdzogs so// //48—976
'gyur rnying la zhus dag bgyis pa'o// //bsdur mchan/972 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/975 ①〈〈pe 〉stan/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2925)sne48—976
'gyur rnying la zhus dag bgyis pa'o// //bsdur mchan/972 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/975 ①〈〈pe 〉stan/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2925)sne48—976

༄ga /'dod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ shrī kā ma rā dza sa dha rna ṭu/ bod skad du/'dod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jigs byed chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems su gnas pas/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings 'od gsal bar rab tu bsams pas/ lus dang ngag dang yid byin gyes brlabs shing / rab tu brtan pa'i sbyor bas/ 'jam pa'i gdan gyi dbus su 'dug pa'i rnal 'byor pas bsam par bya ba ni/ sa ka ṭa'i 'khor lo dmar po pad+ma 'dab ma bye bas brgyan pa yid kyis bsgom par bya'o//de'i steng du 'od dang 'od zer bye ba can gyi dngos po bsam par bya'o/ /de'i dbus su hūṃ gi yi ge dmar po'o/ /de yongs su gyur pa las lcags kyur byas te/'od zer spro dang bsdu ba las/ bcom ldan 'das bsgom par bya'o/ /zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba/48—977

phag /'dod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/⑫ra /rgya gar skad du/ shrī kā ma rā dza sa dha ne+e⑤/ bod skad du/'dod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jigs byed chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems su gnas pas/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings 'od gsal bar rab tu bsams pas/ lus dang ngag dang yid byin gyis brlabs shing / rab tu brtan pa'i sbyor bas/ 'jam pa'i gdan gyi dbus su 'dug pa'i rnal 'byor pas bsam par bya ba ni/ sa ka ṭa'i 'khor lo dmar po pad+ma 'dab ma bye bas brgyan pa yid kyis bsgom par bya'o//de'i steng du 'od dang 'od zer bye ba can gyi dngos po bsam par bya'o/ /de'i dbus su hūṃ gi yi ge dmar po'o/ /de yongs su grur pa las lcags kyur byas te/'od zer spro dang bsdu ba las/ bcom ldan 'das bsgom par bya'o/ /zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba/48—977

mdog dmar po'o/ /zhags pa dang / lcags kyu phyag na bsnams pa/ skra ser po gyen du badze+es pa/ klu brgyad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /sgeg cing steng du phyogs pa'i 'dod pa'i lha gdan du mnan pa'o/ /chang gis dga' ba can no//nag po chen po rdo rje ro langs mas mnyam par 'khyud pa/ 'jig rten gsum dbang du byed pas rab tu sbyin pa/ mi'u thung gsus pa 'phyang ba sems can thams cad kyi don sems pa/ zhags pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ bcom ldan 'das dang shes rab ma la gzigs pa'o/ /shes rab ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa ni 'di'i khyad par ro/ /'jig rten gsum po myur du dbang du byed cing rgyas par byed pa'o/ /dang por ni nye bar spyod pas mchod pa bya'o/ /gnyis par na sdig pa bshags pa'o/ /gsum par na bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /bzhi par na yongs su bsngo ba bya'o/ /lnga par na gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /drug par na tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi'o/ /bdun par ni stong pa nyid rab tu bsam par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya ta tshwa na badz+ra swa bhā wa bka ko3haṃ/stong pa nyid kyi tshig go/ /rab tu bzlas pas dngos grub kyi 'bras bu thams cad rab tu ster ro/ /stong phrag lngas 'jig rten gyi bud med rnams thogs pa med par dbang du byed do/ /'bum gyis ni rgyal po rnams so/ /'bum phrag lnga yis ni/lha dang / lha ma yin dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang /mi'am ci dang / lto 'bye chen po dab / brjed byed dang / non po rnams dbang du byed cing 'gugs par byed do/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ hre hre hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ dṛ lo/ tri hūṃ phaṭa/ li klo saḥces pa ni bzlas pa'i sngags te/ dngos grub mchog sbyin pa'o/ /oṃ shrī k+ka kṛṇ+ḍa ba lo hūṃ phaṭa ma r+ya rmā 48—978

mdog dmar po'o/ /zhags pa dang / lcags kyu phyag na bsnams pa/ skra ser po gyen du brjes pa/ klu brgyad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /sgeg cing steng du phyogs pa'i 'dod pa'i lha gdan du mnan pa'o/ /chang gis dga' ba can no//nag po chen po rdo rje ro langs mas mnyam par 'khyud pa/ 'jig rten gsum dbang du byed pas rab tu sbyin pa/ mi'u thung gsus pa 'phyang ba sems can thams cad kyi don sems pa/ zhags pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ bcom ldan 'das dang shes rab ma la gzigs pa'o/ /shes rab ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa ni 'di'i khyad par ro/ /'jig rten gsum po myur du dbang du byed cing rgyas par byed pa'o/ /dang por ni nye bar spyod pas mchod pa bya'o/ /gnyis par na sdig pa bshags pa'o/ /gsum par na bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /bzhi par na yongs su bsngo ba bya'o/ /lnga par na gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /drug par na tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi'o/ /bdun par ni stong pa nyid rab tu bsam par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ad+ma kolhahaṃ/stong pa nyid kyi tshig go/ /rab tu bzlas pas dngos grub kyi 'bras bu thams cad rab tu ster ro/ /stong phrag lngas 'jig rten gyi bud med rnams thogs pa med par dbang du byed do/ /'bum kyis ni rgyal po rnams so/ /'bum phrag lnga yis ni/lha dang / lha ma yin dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang /mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / brjed byed dang / rnon po rnams dbang du byed cing 'gugs par byed do/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ hri hri hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ dṛ lo/ tre hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khro saḥces pa ni bzlas pa'i sngags te/ dngos grub mchog sbyin pa'o/ /oṃ shrī ṣ+ṭha kṛṇ+ḍi ba bo hūṃ phaṭa ma r+ya rmā 48—978

sa put+pa/ dhū pa/ rak+ta ra la sā tā le nā ga de ba/ yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa kṛhā kṛṇ+ḍa i rda ba bo hā hā hūṃ/ kha kha khā hi khā nyi hūṃ dza dzo ma hā ṭ+wāṣ+ṭa hā sa gardza gardza/ oṃ kṛṣ+ṭa bar+ṇa ya spyo hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ gtor ma'i sngags so/ /sha dang chang dang dzam+bu ḍi ka dang bcas pa'i khrag dang bza' ba dang / me tog dang spos dang / nya dang / 'phreng ba dang mar me dang / byug pa dag gis nyin dang / mtshan mor thun mtshalas so sor gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /ji skad rang gi rtog pa las 'byung ba ltar las thams cad byed do/ /ces pa ni 'dod pa'i rgyal po nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs sdogs so// //gsar 'gyur yin no// //

sa put+pa/ ṣ+pe pa/ rak+ta ra la sā tā le nā ga de ba/ yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa i rda ba lo hā hā hūṃ/ kha kha khā nyi khā nyi hūṃ dza pro ma hā sgyuskyo hā sa gardza gardza/ oṃ kṛsna baṇa ya spro hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ gtor ma'i sngags so/ /sha dang chang dang dzaspru ḍi ka dang bcas pa'i khrag dang bza' ba dang / me tog dang sbos dang / nya dang / 'phreng ba dang mar me dang / byug pa dag gis nyin dang / mtshan mor thun mtshams so sor gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /ji skad rang gi rtog pa las 'byung ba lhar las thams cad byed do/ /ces pa ni 'dod pa'i rgyal po nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //gsar 'gyur yin no// //
bsdur ma na/977 6)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉sna ta ṭ+wāṃ/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2926) 48wa 980
bsdur ma na/977 6)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉sna ta ṭ+wāṃ/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2926) 48wa 980

ga ma hā kā la dmar po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ / rag /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā la rak+ta bar+ṇa sā dha ya/ bod skad du/ ma hā kā la dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jigs byed chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la saṭ+wā kṛ sā dha ka hūṃ hri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa kṛhā ba dzi tsa la a gats+tsha a gats+tsha ba ha ba ha r+pā baṃ rtsa rma re si dhi me de hi swā hā/ tshes brgyad dam bcu bzhi la mi'i thod par bza' ba dang / sha chen po'i dri dang / bdug spos dang bcas te dur khrod chen por gtor ma byen la/ sngags 'bum du bzlas te/ lha gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab nas so/ /de nas rdul gyi ras zung la ri mor bris te/ mdog dmar po/ phyag gnyis pa/ g.yon na tri shu la/ g.yas na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ 'jigs su rung ba chen po zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa'o/ /mchod pa chen po byed cing bsgom 48—981

zag /ma hā ka la dmar po'i sgrub thabs/⑫ga ma hā ka la dmar po'i spub thabs bzhugs so/ / ra /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā la rak+ta baṇa sā dha ya/ bod skad du/ ma hā kā la dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jigs byed chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la saṅgā kṛ sā dha ka hūṃ hro hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa kṛṇ+ḍa ba lo tsa la a gats+tsha a gats+tsha ba ha ba ha hūṃ paṃ rtsa rma re si dhi me de nyi swā hā/ tshes brgyad dam bcu bzhi la mi'i thod par bza' ba dang / sha chen po'i dri dang / bdug spos dang bcas te dur khrod chen por gtor ma byin la/ sngags 'bum du bzlas te/ lha gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab nas so/ /de nas rdul gyi ras zung la ri mor bris te/ mdog dmar po/ phyag gnyis pa/ g.yon na tri shu la/ g.yas na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ 'jigs su rung ba chen po zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa'o/ /mchod pa chen po byed cing bsgom 48—981

par bya'o/ /dang por stag gi pags pa'i steng du 'dug nas/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /phyi nas stong pa nyid du lhag par mos nas rang gi snying gar uyig ①yongs su gyur pa las/ chu skyes dmar po'i steng du nyi ma'o—/ /der hūṃ gi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las mdung rtse gsum pa hūṃ yig gis byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid ma hā kā la'i gzugs su bsgom par bya'o/ /sgom pas skyo na sngags zlas ②te/ de la sngags ni 'di'o/ /hūṃ hri hūṃ phaṭa/ 'bum phrag gcig gis dngos grub thams cad thob bo/ /na mo ma hā kā la ya/ rdaṣ+ṭat+pa ṭa bhe ra ba ya e ka mu khā ya/ dī bi ju dzā ya/ tri ṣ+pe tā ya/ oṃ ku lu ku lu/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ ste bha ya ste bha ya—/ mo ha ya mo ha ya/ hre hri/ hūṃ hūṃ/ ha rā ya hūṃ/ de ba dad ta murtso/ṭa 1ya bhudz+dza bhudz+dza hūṃ phaṭa/ drag shul gyi las thams cad byed pa'o/ /oṃ dzā shaṃ tri rma re/ rengs pa'i las thams cad byed do/ /gzhan yang mig sman la sogs pa'i las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /ma hā kā la dmar po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //gsar 'gyur yin no// //48—982

par bya'o/ /dang por stag gi pags pa'i steng du 'dug nas/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /phyi nas stong pa nyid du lhag par mos nas rang gi snying gar phayig ⑫yongs su gyur pa las/ chu skyes dmar po'i steng du nyi ma'o—/ /der hūṃ gi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las mdung rtse gsum pa hūṃ yig gis byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid ma hā kā la'i gzugs su bsgom par bya'o/ /sgom pas skyo na sngags zlas ②te/ de la sngags ni 'di'o/ /hūṃ hro hūṃ phaṭa/ 'bum phrag gcig gis dngos grub thams cad thob bo/ /na mo ma hā kā la ya/ dz+waṣ+ṭaka ṭa snye ra ba ya e ka nu khā ya/ dī bi bhu dzā ya/ tri ne tā ya/ oṃ ku lu ku lu/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ ste bha ya ste bha ya—/ mo ha ya mo ha ya/ hre hre/ hūṃ hūṃ/ ha rā ya hūṃ/ de ba dad ta murtso/ṭa ②ya bhudz+dza bhudz+dza hūṃ phaṭa/ drag shul gyi las thams cad byed pa'o/ /oṃ dzā gi hri saṃ re/ rengs pa'i las thams cad byed do/ /gzhan yang mig sman la sogs pa'i las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /ma hā kā la dmar po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //gsar 'gyur yin no// // 48—982

ra /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā la sā dha ne+e/ bod skad du/ kā la chen po'i sgrub thabs/ ma hā kā la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spub pa po gang zhig sgrub par 'dod pas/ shing mya ngan med pa'i rtsa bar song nas/ dang por nag po chen po la stag gi pags pa'i steng du nye bar spyod pas mchod par bya'o/ /snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du hūṃ gi yi ge dkar po bsam par bya'o/ /de yongs su gyur pa las ②bdag nyid ma hā kā la'i gzugs zhal gsum pa/ g.yas dmar ba/ g.yon ser ba/ phyag bzhi pa/ mdog dkar ba—/ skra dmar po gyen du brjes pa/ mche ba gcigs pa/ 'jigs par byed pa/sprul gyis brgyan pa/ g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje'o/ /gnyis pas ni ral gri'o/ /g.yon gyi dang pos ni thod pa'o/ /gnyis pa na mdung rtse gsum pa'o/ /lto ba rgyas pa/ mi mgo'i 'phreng ba can/ rab tu 'phyang ba'o/ /g.yon gyi 48—984

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā la sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ kā la chen po'i sgrub thabs/ ma hā kā la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrub pa po gang zhig sgrub par 'dod pas/ shing mya ngan med pa'i rtsa bar song nas/ dang por nag po chen po la stag gi pags pa'i steng du nye bar spyod pas mchod par bya'o/ /snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du hūṃ gi yi ge dkar po bsam par bya'o/ /de yongs su gyur pa las phyebadag nyid ma hā kā la'i gzugs zhal gsum pa/ g.yas dmar ba/ g.yon ser ba/ phyag bzhi pa/ mdog dkar bske/ skra dmar po gyen du badze+es pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ 'jigs par byed pa/sbrul gyes brgyan pa/ g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje'o/ /gnyis pas ni ral gri'o/ /g.yon gyi dang pos ni thod pa'o/ /gnyis pa na mdung rtse gsum pa'o/ /lto ba rgyas pa/ mi mgo'i 'phreng ba can/ rab tu 'phyang ba'o/ /g.yon gyi 48—984

phyogs su dbang phyug ma/ mdog dmar mo/ gri gug dang thod pa phyag na 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yas na spyod pa'i dbang phyug ma nag mo/ phyag na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang zhags pa'o/ /oṃ traṃ hri ma hā kā la ha na hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ma hā kā la'i sngags so/ /oṃ i shwa rī khaṃ phaṭa/ dbang phyug ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ cartse shwa rī r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ spyod pa'i dbang phyug ma'i sngags so/ /ma hā kā la'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //gsar 'gyur yin no/ /bsdur mchan/984 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉bos/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2928)48—985

phyogs su dbang phyug ma/ mdog dmar mo/ gri gug dang thod pa phyag na 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yas na spyod pa'i dbang phyug ma nag mo/ phyag na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang zhags pa'o/ /oṃ traṃ hri ma hā kā la ha na hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ma hā kā la'i sngags so/ /oṃ i shwa rī khaṃ phaṭa/ dbang phyug ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ cartse shwa rī r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ spyod pa'i dbang phyug ma'i sngags so/ /ma hā kā la'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //gsar 'gyur yin no/ /bsdur mchan/984 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉bos/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2928)48wa 985

༄ga /tshogs kyi dbang ldan chen po sprub pa'i thabs ①༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā ga ṇi shā sa dha na/ bod skad du/tshogs kyi dbang ldan chen po sgrub pa'i thabs/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi sngags kyi mthu chen las/ /ri rab rtse mor myur 'gro ba/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i rig ①sngags te/ /gang gzhan phra mo smos ci dgos/ /sgrub pa po gang zhig dkon mchog gsum bla mar byed cing / byang chub tu sems yang dag par bskyed pa/ bla ma dam pa bsnyen bkur bar mkhas pa/ dbang bskur ba dang ldan zhing dam tshig la mngon par brtson pa des/ brtson pas bsgrub par gyur na ni/ srid pa gsum byi dngos grub thams cad kyang 'grub par byed do/ /de la re zhig sgrub pa pos/ dben pa'i gnas su song nas/ rdo rje khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i rig sngags 'bum phrag bdun du bzlas par bya'o/ /phyi nas tshogs kyi bdag po'i bris sku dang / mchod pa mngon par 'dus byas te/48—986

chog /tshogs kyi dbang ldan chen po grub pa'i thabs ⑫༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā ga ṇi shā sa dha na/ bod skad du/tshogs kyi dbang ldan chen po sgrub pa'i thabs/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi sngags kyi mthu chen las/ /ri rab rtse mor myur 'gro ba/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i rig ②sngags te/ /gang gzhan phra mo smos ci dgos/ /sgrub pa po gang zhig dkon mchog gsum bla mar byed cing / byang chub tu sems yang dag par bskyed pa/ bla ma dam pa bsnyen bkur bar mkhas pa/ dbang bskur ba dang ldan zhing dam tshig la mngon par brtson pa des/ brtson pas bsgrub par gyur na ni/ srid pa gsum gyi dngos grub thams cad kyang 'grub par byed do/ /de la re zhig sgrub pa pos/ dben pa'i gnas su song nas/ rdo rje khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i rig sngags 'bum phrag bdun du bzlas par bya'o/ /phyi nas tshogs kyi bdag po'i bris sku dang / mchod pa mngon par 'dus byas te/48—986

bgegs bsang ba dang / bdag dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba sngon du 'gro bas/mchod pa kun gyis yang dag par mchod nas/ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o—/ /de'i 'og tu gtor ma sbyin par bya ste/ na mo bikyārnya kā ya/ ma hā ga na⑪pa nyi e ka dar+ghaṃ ma hā jirdu lasbo dha ra i rda ba ling kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa kha kha hūṃ/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ da ra da ra/ ji da ra ji da ra/ ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa/ ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi/ ṭu ṭu ṭu ṭu/ sirnyi sirnyi me/ pra yats+tsha swā hā/ ces pa'i sngags kyis so/ /de'i phyi nas yi ge brgya pa'i sngags brjod cing / bzod par gsol ba dang /gshegs su gsol ba bya'o/ /de nas stong pa nyid du rnam par bsams te/stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du/ rma yig las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /oṃ badz+ra ma da ma da hūṃ/ der yi ge gaḥlas byung ba'i tshogs kyi bdag po bsam par bya ste/ dpa' bo chen po khro bo'i lta ba/ spyan gsum gsum pa dmar ba/ yan lag thams cad kun da ltar dkar ba/ zhal lnga pa/phyag bcu pa/ zhabs drug dang ldan pa/ zhal dang po ni dkar po bzhad pa'o//g.yas dang g.yon du ser po ni zhi ba dang ljang khu ni gcigs pa'o/ /rgyab kyi zhal ni glang po che'i gdong pa dmar po mche ba gcigs pa'o/ /steng gi zhal ni sngon po gdangs pa'o/ /thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa/ rin po che'i cod pan gyis mdzes par byas pa/ kun gyi steng na sdong po bkod pa'i glegs bam gyis spyi bo brgyan pa'o/ /g.yas kyi dang po na dgra sta gnyis pa na 'khor lo/gsum pa na ral gri/ bzhi pa na mda'/ lnga pa na lcags kyu'o/ /g.yon gyi dang po na mdung rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa'o/ /gsum pa na kham phor chang gis gang ba/ bzhi pa na gzhu/ lnga pa na zhags pa'o//48—987

bgegs bsang ba dang / bdag dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba sngon du 'gro bas/mchod pa kun gyis yang dag par mchod nas/ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o—/ /de'i 'og tu gtor ma sbyin par bya ste/ na mo bi:n+ta kā ya/ ma hā ga na ①pa ti e ka dar+ghaṃ ma hā bibye lasgo dha ra i rda ba ling kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍa kha kha hūṃ/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ da ra da ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa/ ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi/ ṭu ṭu ṭu ṭu/ sirnyi sernyi me/ pra yats+tsha swā hā/ ces pa'i sngags kyis so/ /de'i phyi nas yi ge brgya pa'i sngags brjod cing / bzod par gsol ba dang /gshegs su gsol ba bya'o/ /de nas stong pa nyid du rnam par bsams te/stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du/ e yig las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /oṃ badz+ra ma da ma da hūṃ/ der yi ge gaḥlas byung ba'i tshogs kyi bdag po bsam par bya ste/ dpa' bo chen po khro bo'i lta ba/ spyan gsum gsum pa dmar ba/ yan lag thams cad kun da ltar dkar ba/ zhal lnga pa/phyag bcu pa/ zhabs drug dang ldan pa/ zhal dang po ni dkar po bzhad pa'o//g.yas dang g.yon du ser po ni zhi ba dang ljang khu ni gcigs pa'o/ /rgyab kyi zhal ni glang po che'i gdong pa dmar po mche ba gcigs pa'o/ /steng gi zhal ni sngon po gdangs pa'o/ /thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa/ rin po che'i cod pan gyis mdzes par byas pa/ kun gyi steng na sdong po bkod pa'i glegs bam gyis bye bo brgyan pa'o/ /g.yas kyi dang po na dgra sta gnyis pa na 'khor lo/gsum pa na ral gri/ bzhi pa na mda'/ lnga pa na lcags kyu'o/ /g.yon gyi dang po na mdung rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa'o/ /gsum pa na kham phor chang gis gang ba/ bzhi pa na gzhu/ lnga pa na zhags pa'o//48—987

zhabs gnyis ni jig krungs so/ /gnyis ni gar stabs so/ /gnyis ni brkyang bskum gyis gnas pa/ ma rungs pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs rnams ni 'og tu kha bub tu 'gyel ba ste/ de'i steng du bra ba byi ba brgyad do/ /de rnams kyi rgyab tu pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i dpal tshogs kyi dbang po ni/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/nyi ma'i 'od zer can/ stag gi pags pa dang / mi'i pags pa lhon pa/rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rla g.yas pa la ⑫nye bar brten pa'i / lha mo rdo rje 'ju byed sna chen ma/ phyag g.yas pas bza' ba'i dam tshig gis gang ba'i ka pā la dang g.yon pas ka ṇ+ḍa ya 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa'i tshul can no/ /de ltar bsams nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ rdo rje gdon mi za bas dbu la brgyan par bya'o/ /mchod cing bstod nas bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ lha'igaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥhūṃ—/ snying po'o/ /oṃ bste ka rdaṣ+ṭa rnyin da hūṃ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /'bum phrag bcu bzlas pas las thams cad byed pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra shoṇ+ḍa shaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ shin tu snying po'o/ /oṃ u dzī ka ya dzi tā ya/ na mo shī pā ya/ myur du 'grub par byed pa'i snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra shoṇ+ḍa ma hā ga ṇa pa ti rak+ṣan+tu—/ sarba dusne bh+yoḥ badz+ra dha ra sa dz+nyā pa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ni bgegs gzhom cing bsrung ba byed pa'i sngags te/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyang yin no/ /oṃ badz+ra dza ya bi dza ya ma hā ga ṇa pa nyi hūṃ phaṭa/ mchog tu gsang ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ma hā ba lā ka ma hā ga ṇa de ba pi ba tha/ ru rnyi rān/ sarba duṣ+ṭan hūṃ phaṭa/drag shul gyi las sgrub par byed pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra ru la sa tshirnya rnyirnya badz+re ṇi—/ mā ra ya/ kun da ya/ pi ba tha hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje sna chen ma'i sngags so//48—988

zhabs gnyis ni :kha krungs so/ /gnyis ni gar stabs so/ /gnyis ni brkyang bskum gyis gnas pa/ ma rungs pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs rnams ni 'og tu kha bub tu 'gyel ba ste/ de'i steng du bra ba byi ba brgyad do/ /de rnams kyi rgyab tu pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i dpal tshogs kyi dbang po ni/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/nyi ma'i 'od zer can/ stag gi pags pa dang / mi'i pags pa gyon pa/rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rla g.yas pa la ①nye bar brten pa'i—/ lha mo rdo rje 'ju byed sna chen ma/ phyag g.yas pas bza' ba'i dam tshig gis gang ba'i ka pā la dang g.yon pas ka ṇa ya 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa'i tshul can no/ /de ltar bsams nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ rdo rje gdon mi za bas dbu la brgyan par bya'o/ /mchod cing bstod nas bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ oṃgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥhūṃ—/ snying po'o/ /oṃ bste ka rdaṣ+ṭa sten da hūṃ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /'bum phrag bcu bzlas pas las thams cad byed pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra shoṇ+ḍa shaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ shin tu snying po'o/ /oṃ u dz+re ka ya dzi tā ya/ na mo shī pā ya/ myur du 'grub par byed pa'i snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra shoṇ+ḍa ma hā ga ṇa pa ti rak+ṣun+tu—/ sarba duṣ+ṭi bh+yoḥ badz+ra dha ra a dz+nyā pa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ni bgegs gzhom cing bsrung ba byed pa'i sngags te/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyang yin no/ /oṃ badz+ra dza ya bi dza ya ma hā ga ṇa pa nyi hūṃ phaṭa/ mchog tu gsang ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ma hā ba khā ka ma hā ga ṇa de ba pi ba tha/ ru dhī rān/ sarba duṣ+ṭan hūṃ phaṭa/drag shul gyi las sgrub par byed pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra ru la sa tshirnya bhirnya badzi ṇi—/ mā ra ya/ u da ya/ pi ba tha hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje sna chen ma'i sngags so/ /48—988

oṃb su rgya sarba at+pa sā dha ni sā dha ya sā dha ya ku dha ra spru dha ra/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarba sat+pa ni tsa yi hūṃ hūṃ tsa tsa ṭa ṭa ha ha swā hā/ dbang du byed pa nor dang gter dang mig sman la sogs pa'i grub pa sbyin par byed pa'i sngags so/ /la du dang /la phug dang / 'khur ba dang / sha dang / chang dang / 'a sa bu rnam pa sna tshogs pa bza' ba dang / gtor ma dang / sbyin sreg tu byas pas/ dpal tshogs kyi dbang po mnyes par bya'o/ /de nas ni rdzu 'phrul dang / dngos grub tu 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ tshogs kyi dbang po'i rtog pa las rgyas par 'byung ba ltar rtogs par bya'o/ /shin tu gsang ba gang 'dir rnam dpyad pa/ /thabs 'di bshad pa'i bsod nams gang yin des/ /skye bo 'dod bral rgud pa de zhi nas/ /rdzu 'phrul 'byor pa mchog de thob par shog /dpal tshogs kyi dbang po'i sgrub pa'i thabs rdzogs so// //gsar 'gyur nyid do/ /de ltar na spub thabs rgya mtsho'i kha skong gi sgrub thabs dang chos tshan bdun cu rtsa kacig po 'di rnams las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ spyan ras gzigs ri khrod pa'i sgrub thabs/ yo rgyan las 'byung ba'i 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs/ mi g.yo ba phyag bzhi lha dgu'i skrub thabs / /mi g.yo bla med gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs/ seng ldeng nags sgrol gtso 'khor lnga pa'i sgrub thabs/ ral gcig ma'i kun spyod kyi gzhung /dpal bde ba chen po'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi spub thabs/ rdo rje nyi ma'i spub thabs/ bdud rtsi 'od kyi 48—989

oṃ ba su rgya sarba arba sā dha ni sā dha ya sā dha ya u dha ra u dha ra/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarba arba ni tsa yo tram̐ tram̐ tsa tsa ṭa ṭa ha ha swā hā/ dbang du byed pa nor dang gter dang mig sman la sogs pa'i grub pa sbyin par byed pa'i sngags so/ /la du dang /la phug dang / 'khur ba dang / sha dang / chang dang / 'bras bu rnam pa sna tshogs pa bza' ba dang / gtor ma dang / sbyin sreg tu byas pas/ dpal tshogs kyi dbang po mnyes par bya'o/ /de nas ni rdzu 'phrul dang / dngos grub tu 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ tshogs kyi dbang po'i rtog pa las rgyas par 'byung ba ltar rtogs par bya'o/ /shin tu gsang ba gang 'dir rnam dpyad pa/ /thabs 'di bshad pa'i bsod nams gang yin des/ /skye bo 'dod bral rgud pa de zhi nas/ /rdzu 'phrul 'byor pa mchog de thob par shog /dpal tshogs kyi dbang po'i sgrub pa'i thabs rdzogs so// //gsar 'gyur nyid do/ /de ltar na sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i kha skong gi sgrub thabs dang chos tshan bdun cu rtsa gcig po 'di rnams las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ spyan ras gzigs ri khrod pa'i sgrub thabs/ o rgyan las 'byung ba'i 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs/ mi g.yo ba phyag bzhi lha dgu'i sgrub thabs—/ /mi g.yo bla med gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs/ seng ldeng nags sgol gtso 'khor lnga pa'i sgrub thabs/ ral gcig ma'i kun spyod kyi gzhung /dpal bde ba chen po'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje nyi ma'i sgrub thabs/ bdud rtsi 'od kyi 48—989

sgrub thabs/ sna tshogs yum gyi sgrub thabs gcig /lha mo tsun+da phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ phag mo kurma pa ti'i sgrub thabs/ phag mo dmar mo hūṃ skyed ma'i sgrub thabs/ gsang 'dus las 'byung ba 'dzam bha la'i sgrub thabs/ 'di zhabs lugs yin/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes nyid kyi gsungs ⑫yin par sems—/ khro bo rdo rje sa 'og gi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs—/ khro bo 'dod rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ khro bo dbyug sngon gyi sgrub thabs/gshin rje gshed rnam rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i sgrub thabs/phyag rdor sgrub thabs di na ka ras mdzad pa/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i sgrub thabs/ tsa muṇ+ḍi'i sgrub thabs/ rang byin rlabs kyi mgon po zhal gsum pa'i sgrub thabs/'dod rgyal dang mgon po sbags ma'i sgrub thabs/ mgon dmar phyag gnyis pa'i spub thabs/ mgon po dkar po zhal gsum phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/tshogs bdag dkar po zhal lnga phyag bcu pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'di rnams kasar du bsgyur ba yin phal cher dpal thar pa gling gi rgya dpe las rnyed/ 'ga' zhig bal po'i dpe las bsgyur ba yin/ /de ltar bdag kun dga' snying pos gsar du bsgyur ba'i chos tshan sum cu so gnyis la/ ral gcig ma'i kun spyod ma lags pa'i/ gzhan rnams mngon rtogs sgrub thabs re re ba yin pas/ gsar 'gyur spub thabs sum cu so gcig yod do/ /yang dam tshig gsum bkod kyi sgrub thabs ke la dha ras mdzad pa/ gnas kyi dbang phyug ma ces pa sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ byang phyogs las 'byung ba rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ ral gcig ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje gshed dgra nag gtso brkyang ②gi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs/ bde mchog lhan skyes kyi 48—990

sgrub thabs/ sna tshogs yum gyi sgrub thabs gcig /lha mo tsun+da phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ phag mo kurma pa ti'i sgrub thabs/ phag mo dmar mo hūṃ skyed ma'i sgrub thabs/ gsang 'dus las 'byung ba 'dzam bha la'i sgrub thabs/ 'di zhabs lugs yin/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes nyid kyi gsungs ①yin par sems—/ khro bo rdo rje sa 'og gi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs—/ khro bo 'dod rgyal kyi sgrub thabs/ khro bo dbyug sngon byi sgrub thabs/gshin rje gshed rnam rgyal kyi sgrub thabs/ gzhan byis mi thub ma'i sgrub thabs/phyag rdor sgrub thabs di na ka ras mdzad pa/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i sgrub thabs/ tsa muṇ+ḍi'i sgrub thabs/ rang byin rlabs kyi mgon po zhal gsum pa'i sgrub thabs/'dod rgyal dang mgon po sbags ma'i sgrub thabs/ mgon dmar phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ mgon po dkar po zhal gsum phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/tshogs bdag dkar po zhal lnga phyag bcu pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'di rnams gsar du bsgyur ba yin phal cher dpal thar pa gling gi rgya dpe las rnyed/ 'ga' zhig bal po'i dpe las bsgyur ba yin/ /de ltar bdag kun dga' snying pos gsar du bsgyur ba'i chos tshan sum cu so gnyis la/ ral gcig ma'i kun spyod ma lags pa'i/ gzhan rnams mngon rtogs sgrub thabs re re ba yin pas/ gsar 'gyur sgrub thabs sum cu so gcig yod do/ /yang dam tshig gsum bkod kyi sgrub thabs ke la dha ras mdzad pa/ gnas kyi dbang phyug ma ces pa sgol ma'i sgrub thabs/ byang phyogs las 'byung ba rdo rje sgol ma'i sgrub thabs/ ral gcig ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje gshed dgra nag gtso brkyang dhigi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs/ bde mchog lhan skyes kyi 48—990

spub thabs rgyas pa su ma ta sing has mdzad pa/ dgyes rdor lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs ka la haṃ sa ku ma ras mdzad pa/ dgyes rdor phyag mang gi sgrub thabs/nag po rdo rjes mdzad pa/ phyag rdor sgrub thabs burtse kirtis mdzad pa/ yang gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs gcig /phyag rdor sgrub thabs stong nyid ting 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ ye shes mkha' lding gi spub thabs/ mgon po gri gug ma'i sgrub thabs / bya ba'i rgyud las 'byung ba mgon po nag po'i sgrub thabs te mngon rtogs bco lnga dang / gshin rje gshed kyi 'khrul 'khor/ gtor chog /rab gnas—/ sbyin sreg /bya ba'i sbyor ba ste chos tshan lnga/ de ltar na chos tshan nyi shu po de dag sngar spub thabs rgya mtshor ma chug kyang / lo tsa ba gzhan dang gzhan gyis bsgyur zin pa yin/ phyis sgrub thabs rgya mtsho las 'thor ba'i rgya dpe rnams dang bsdur dus/ 'ga' zhig ngo bo gcig pa la/ sngar logs su bsgyur ba'i 'gyur rnying rnams rgyas shing tshig sna ring ba 'dug /sngar bsgyur ba'i sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i nang tshan mang po na/ sngon du brjod pa'i cho gas ces/zur bka'i sgrub thabs rnams las/ don gcig pa mang po tshig bsdus 'dug pa/'di dag kyang des mtshon par go nas/ rgya dpe na gang yod rnams bkol te/tshig rnams 'gyur rnying bzhin du bris zhus dag gi 'gyur bcos cung zad byas pa yin no/ /gso sbyong rang gis blang ba'i cho ga /'jam rdor rma bya la chibs pa lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ ral gcig ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs/ sher phyin gyi man ngag rdo rje lta bu dang / sher phyin man ngag yig 'bru gcig pa/ nor rgyun ma'i rtog pa gcig dang ⑫nor rgyun ma'i las kyi mtha'i rtog pa/ o rgyan las 'byung ba phag mo lha lnga'i spub thabs/ mdor bsdus phag mo'i sgrub thabs 48—991

sgrub thabs rgyas pa su ma ta seng has mdzad pa/ dgyes rdor lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs ka la haṃ sa ku ma ras mdzad pa/ dgyes rdor phyag mang gi sgrub thabs/nag po rdo rjes mdzad pa/ phyag rdor sgrub thabs budha kirtis mdzad pa/ yang gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs gcig /phyag rdor sgrub thabs stong nyid ting 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ ye shes mkha' lding gi sgrub thabs/ mgon po gri gug ma'i sgrub thabs—/ bya ba'i rgyud las 'byung ba mgon po nag po'i sgrub thabs te mngon rtogs bco lnga dang / gshin rje gshed kyi 'khrul 'khor/ gtor chog /rab gnas—/ sbyin sreg /bya ba'i sbyor ba ste chos tshan lnga/ de ltar na chos tshan nyi shu po de dag sngar sgrub thabs rgya mtshor ma chug kyang / lo tsa ba gzhan dang gzhan gyis bsgyur zin pa yin/ phyis sgrub thabs rgya mtsho las 'thor ba'i rgya dpe rnams dang bsdur dus/ 'ga' zhig ngo bo gcig pa la/ sngar logs su bsgyur ba'i 'gyur rnying rnams rgyas shing tshig sna ring ba 'dug /sngar bsgyur ba'i sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i nang tshan mang po na/ sngon du brjod pa'i cho gas ces/zur bka'i sgrub thabs rnams las/ don gcig pa mang po tshig bsdus 'dug pa/'di dag kyang des mtshon par go nas/ rgya dpe na gang yod rnams bkol te/tshig rnams 'gyur rnying bzhin du bris zhus dag gi 'gyur bcos cung zad byas pa yin no/ /gso sbyong rang gis blang ba'i cho ga /'jam rdor rma bya la chibs pa lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ ral gcig ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs/ sher phyin gyi man ngag rdo rje lta bu dang / sher phyin man ngag yig 'bru gcig pa/ nor rgyun ma'i rtog pa gcig dang ①nor rgyun ma'i las kyi mtha'i rtog pa/ o rgyan las 'byung ba phag mo lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ mdor bsdus phag mo'i sgrub thabs 48—991

bya ba na ro mkha' spyod dang phal cher mthun pa gcig /sku gsum phag mo ces bya ba dbu bcad ma'i sgrub thabs/ zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa gcig /yang mdor bsdus phag mo'i sgrub thabs/ bya ba sgrub thabs brgya rtsa na yod pa gcig /rnam rgyal gyi mchod thabs dang gtor chog /gshin rje gshed phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ bde mchog yi ge bdun pa'i sgrub thabs/ mi thub zla bas mdzad pa/ gnyis med dpa' bo'i sgrub thabs ces bya ba zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa'i mngon rtogs mdor bsdus te ru ka'i spub thabs/ phyag rdor gos sngon can gyi gzungs mdo ste/ chos tshan bcu dgu po de rnams la/ sgrub thabs nges bzungs can bcu gcig yod/ nor rgyun ma'i chos tshan gnyis dang /phyag rdor gyi gzungs la'ang sgrub thabs logs pa re 'byung du rung / gang ltar sgrub thabs rgya mapa'i tho yig gam sdoms/ paṇ+ḍi ta dpal 'dzin sde zhes bya bas mdzad pa cig 'dug pa/ de'i nang na 'di rnams thebs 'dug pas/ 'dir bris pa yin gyi/ 'di rnams kyi rgya dpe ma rnyed pas 'gyur rnying kho na ma gtogs/zhus dag byed ngo ma shes/ yig nor brgyud par mngon pa'i the tshom gyi gnas phran bu 'dug /'di dag gi yang sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rgya dpe mthong na rgyas bsdus yod srid/ dpal 'dzin sde'i sdoms sam/ dkar chag gi yi ge de yang logs su bsgyur yod/ de dang bstun na da dung sgrub thabs dgu dang /las rim gyi gzhung gnyis ma tshang yang rgya gar paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen gyi phyag na/sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i dpe yod pa la/ sgrub thabs rang sum brgya lhag tsam yod/gsang sngags nang brgyud kyi sgrub thabs grags chung ba yang mang po yod ces thos pas—/ sngon slob dpon a bha ya ka ras sgrig pa mdzad pa'i skabs kyi sgrub 48—992

thabs thams cad/ dpal 'dzin sde'i dkar chag la 'khod pa de bas kyang mang ba zhig yod pa 'dra'o // //①ces pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //bsdur mchan/986 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉khuregs/987 ①〈〈pe 〉〉ṇa/988 ①〈〈pe 〉to/la/99༷ ①〈〈pe 〉stanasung / ②〈〈pe 〉〉rkyang /991 ①〈〈pe 〉bodang /993 ①〈〈pe 〉ska/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2929)48wa 993

sha bka' babs bdun dang ldan pa'i man ngag gi gzhung rdo rje'i lam bzang po zhes bya ba slob dpen chen po rdo rje shrī mā dhe ru ka zhi ba sbas pas mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /ra —/ /oṃ swa ste/ oṃ badz+ra dha rā ya na mo/ rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra su marga nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdo rje'i lam bzang po zhes bya ba/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po bde ba chen po ni/ /bla ma rdo rje can zhabs 'dud / /ma lus rgyud rnams thams cad kyi/ /de nyid rab tu gsal bshad bya//rgyud kyi dang por e waṃ yig /phung po kun gyi sdod yin 'di/ /stong dang snying rje'i bde chen po/ /sangs rgyas 'dir brjod 'khor ba'ang 'di/ /'on kyang rang bzhin mngon gyur dang / /'dzag med sems kyi de nyid rig /'gro la snying rje'i sems chen po/ /rgyu shes slob dpon bsten bya ste/ /bla ma la gus drang po'i dngos/ /lam dang ston pa gzhan spangs pa/ /zab mo'i don la rtog bral 48nga 994

༄ga /rdo rje'i lam bzang po zhes bya ba/①ga bka' babs bdun dang ldan pa'i man ngag gi gzhung rdo rje'i lam bzang po zhes bya ba slob dpen chen po rdo rje shrī mā dhe ru ka zhi ba sbas pas mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /༄4—/ /oṃ swa ste/ oṃ badz+ra dha rā ya na mo/ rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra su marga nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdo rje'i lam bzang po zhes bya ba/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po bde ba chen po ni/ /bla ma rdo rje can zhabs 'dud—/ /ma lus rgyud rnams thams cad kyi/ /de nyid rab tu gsal bshad bya//rgyud kyi dang por e waṃ yig /phung po kun gyi snod yin 'di/ /stong dang snying rje'i bde chen po/ /sangs rgyas 'dir brjod 'khor ba'ang 'di/ /'on kyang rang bzhin mngon gyur dang / /'dzag med sems kyi de nyid rig /'gro la snying rje'i sems chen po/ /rgyu shes slob dpon bsten bya ste/ /bla ma la gus drang po'i dngos/ /lam dang ston pa gzhan spangs pa/ /zab mo'i don la rtog bral 48—994

bas—/ /'bad na thams cad 'ams bur bcas/ /bde ba mchog gi thar pa'i rgyud/ /gzhi dang lam dang 'ams bu ni/ /thams cad rang bzhin bde ba che / /bde bas bde ba che grub pa'o/ /'di la sems kyi rang bzhin gang / /sbu gnyis por ni rnam par gnas/ /shin tu spros med chos kyi sku/ /gzugs ni lus dang snod bcas pa'o/ /gang la thog ma med pa dang / /dang po rgyu med sangs rgyas chos/ /sems can kun la rtag gnas pa/ /rgyu yi rdo rje 'chang bar brjod/ /phung po mnga' bdag sangs rgyas dang / /rig ma 'byung ba rnams dkyil 'khor/ /dbang po yul dang bcas gang dag /byang chub sems dpa' lha mor bcas/ /de ltar dri ma rnam sbyang ba/ /ye shes chen po bsgom par bya/ /bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas pas/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dir sgom⑪byos/ /rten dang brten pa'i rgyu yi phyir/ /lus med pa la bde med pas//lus ni dag pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sems kyang yang dag bde bar 'gyur/ /bsnyen pa nye ba'i bsnyen pa dang / /bsnyen pa che dang sgrub pa bya/ /bsnyen pa nyer sgrub skrub pa dang / /spub pa chen po bsgom bya zhing / /rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor dang / /shin du yang dang rnal 'byor che/ /sbyor dang dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog /phyi nas las rgyal mchog bsgom bya/ /bdag nyid gong bu ltar snang ba/ /rab bkra dbang po'i gzhu ltar snang / /phyi nas dngos po kun la spro//gcig dang du ma dang bral ba/ /dkyil 'khor dag gis sgo nas phyung / /zas sogs bya ba thams cad spyad/ /lha yis ②gsal dang mngon zhen gyis/ /rang gi mi mthun shin tu 'gag /sna rtser yungs kar rnams brtags pa/ /yi ge de ni mtshan ma dang / /gzugs brnyan la sogs dkyil 'khor gyis/ /spro ba'ang 48—996

bas—/ /'bad na thams cad 'bras bur bcas/ /bde ba mchog gi thar pa'i rgyud/ /gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu ni/ /thams cad rang bzhin bde ba che—/ /bde bas bde ba che grub pa'o/ /'di la sems kyi rang bzhin gang / /sku gnyis por ni rnam par gnas/ /shin tu spros med chos kyi sku/ /gzugs ni lus dang snod bcas pa'o/ /gang la thog ma med pa dang / /dang po rgyu med sangs rgyas chos/ /sems can kun la rtag gnas pa/ /rgyu yi rdo rje 'chang bar brjod/ /phung po mnga' bdag sangs rgyas dang / /rig ma 'byung ba rnams dkyil 'khor/ /dbang po yul dang bcas gang dag /byang chub sems dpa' lha mor bcas/ /de ltar dri ma rnam sbyang ba/ /ye shes chen po bsgom par bya/ /bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas pas/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dir sgom ①byos/ /rten dang brten pa'i rgyu yi phyir/ /lus med pa la bde med pas//lus ni dag pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sems kyang yang dag bde bar 'gyur/ /bsnyen pa nye ba'i bsnyen pa dang / /bsnyen pa che dang sgrub pa bya/ /bsnyen pa nyer sgrub sgrub pa dang / /sgrub pa chen po bsgom bya zhing / /rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor dang / /shin du yang dang rnal 'byor che/ /sbyor dang dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog /phyi nas las rgyal mchog bsgom bya/ /bdag nyid gong bu ltar snang ba/ /rab bkra dbang po'i gzhu ltar snang / /phyi nas dngos po kun la spro//gcig dang du ma dang bral ba/ /dkyil 'khor dag gis sgo nas phyung / /zas sogs bya ba thams cad spyad/ /lha yis phyegasal dang mngon zhen gyis/ /rang gi mi mthun shin tu 'gag /sna rtser yungs kar rnams brtags pa/ /yi ge de ni mtshan ma dang / /gzugs brnyan la sogs dkyil 'khor gyis/ /spro ba'ang 48—995

yang na bsdu bar bya/ /rdo rje'i pad+ma'i sna rtser ni/ /yungs kar tshul gyis mtshan ma bsgom/ /dkyil 'khor spro zhing sdud pa dang / /re re zhing yang rnam par bsgom/ /sku dang bde ba rang bzhin med/ /rnam par rtog las nges byung ba—/ /srid pa'i rnam pas de sbyong byed/ /'bras bu'i lam gyur skyed pa'o/ /ces pa ni rim pa dang po'o// //sems ni rang bzhin 'od gsal te/ /dri ma rnams ni blo bur ba/ /rang bzhin skye 'gag med pa dang / /chos kun mchog tu rgyas btab che/ /'dod chags chags bral kun las 'das/ /stong pa ma yin mi stong min/ /yod dang med dang yod med 'das/ /rnam par rtog pa'i yul kun spangs/ /tshig dang ming du brjod pa bral/ /bsam gtan brdzun pas ma slad ①pa/ /'bad rtsol rgyu dang bral ba yang / /bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs par 'gyur/ /rang bzhin gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /bden min brdzun min 'di lta bu/ /gang la'ang mi gnas chos kyi sku/ /chos rnams kun tu rnam par snang / /sems can khams la rtag gnas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rang gis rig bya nyid/ /dpe dang rtog pas mtshon du med/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs 'pho bas so/ /bde dang sdug bsngal kun las grol/ /rkyen gyis bsgyur min rkyen byung min/ /sa dang sa la g.yo med pa/ /rang gi rang nyid shes par bya/ /ji ltar nam mkha' bcos min pa/ /lag sogs mi 'gyur mngon gyur phyir/ /rang gi sems la yongs tshol ba/ /bla ma dam pa'i rim las rnyed/ /rang bzhin dang ni yid 'gyus kun/ /chu dang rlabs bzhin dbyer med pa/ /'di la rang bzhin spros bral bas/ /g.yo ba dag kyang rnam par dag /mi rtog ma yin rnam rtog min/ /bya ba byed las 48—996

yongs 'das pa/ /dpyad pa las 'das phyag rgya che/ /ye shes zhabs kyi rim las rnyed/ /rnam par mi rtog mu stegs byed/ /dpyod byed blo ngan sangs rgyas pa| /rnam pa kun ldan chos kang gi'ang / /ma gos mchog tu dbyen pa'o/ /ces pa ni phyag rgya chen po'o// //e waṃ ma ya yi ge mchog /'khor lo bzhi la rnam par gnas/ /sprul pa chos dang longs spyod dang / /de bzhin bde chen 'khor lo'o/ /bdun khri nyis stong dang / ngargya phrag la nyi shu lhag pa dang / sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / rtsa gsum dang / a wa dhu tī dang / 'khor lo brgyad dang / rtsa'i 'dud pa rnams dang / sku'i sgo dgu dang / gsung gi sgo bzhi dang / thugs kyi sgo gnyis dang / srog dang / thur sel dang / mnyam gnas dang / gyen rgyu dang / khyab byed dang / klu dang / rus sbal dang / rtsangs pa dang /lha sbyin dang / gzhu las rgyal dang / rlung rnams kyi kha dog dang / tshad dang /grangs dang / rgyu ba dang / dbyug gu dang / chu tshod dang / 'pho ba dang /thun tshod dang / rang bzhin dang / las dang / khams lnga dang / drug dang / nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / khu ba dang / rdul tha dad dang / mnyam par gnas pa dang / dbyangs bcu drug 'char ba dang / mun pa dang /rdul dang / snying stobs 'bab pa de dag ni/ /e waṃlas byung ba'o/ /nyi ma zla bar na da gnas/ /bcu gnyis bcu drug de bzhin du/ /bcu gnyis las ni yon tan brgyad/ /phra dang rags pa'i 'khor lo 'khor/ /spyi bor bde ba chen po ste/ /dga' dang chis dang gnas thod pa/ /'khrig sogs las kyang gsal gyur te/ /de tshe gtso bo khyim der spyod/ /rnam par dag las bde chen 48—997

skyes/—/ /sangs rgyas ye shes sku yi rgyal/ /rang bzhin dang ni las dang yang / /rnal 'byor rnams kyi gtum mo'o/ /gang du sems spyod der rlung yang / /thim 'gyur 'di las mchog gzhan med/ /thig le'am yi ge rtsa la sogs/ /gang sgom des kyang mchog tu 'gag /gnyis 'gag pa las 'bar ba 'am /'bar las dbu ma 'byed par 'gyur/ /rtsa gnyis las 'gro 'ong ba dang / /'khor lo rnams su 'bar zhing zlog /zig le'i ye shes 'byung ba ni/ /phyag rgya chen po mngon du 'gyur/ /bum pa can dang rdul mtha' can/ /bgang ba de bzhin rengs byed pa/ /'khor lo rnams su dgag pa dang / /sngags dang snying ga de bzhin du/ /rdzas kyang thig le gsum pa ste/ /mi shigs pa dang nor bu dang / /'od kyang thig ler mngon brjod pa/ /a ni gtso bo dam pa ste/ /gsal zhing mar me dag dang mtshungs/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu phra ba'o/ /a um/srog dang gyen rgyu dang / thig le'o/ /a a hra/ srog dang gyen rgyu dang thur sel lo/ /hra u mra/ thur sel dang / srog dang jig le'o/ /yi ge gsum gyi de nyid kyis/ /rlung rnams mchog tu zhi bar byed/ /rtags ni lnga las ye shes te/ /khams brgyad shin tu rnam dag pa'o/ /ces pa ni gtum mo'i ye shes so// //gang phyir dga' ba de snang ba/ /snang ba mched po mchog dgar bshad/ /dga' bral las ni nyer thob ste/ /lhan cig skyes pa 'od gsal ba'o/ /reg dang 'jug dang skyed pa dang / /mtha' las ma nyams gzhan yang 'di/ /yi ge bcu drug dang ni tshes/ /de bzhin dga' ba bcu drug go/ /'dod pa dang /dga' ba dang / g.yo ba dang / 'dar ba ni dga' ba bzhi'o/ /gang ba dang 48—998

skyed—/ /sangs rgyas ye shes sku yi rgyal/ /rang bzhin dang ni las dang yang / /rnal 'byor rnams kyi gtum mo'o/ /gang du sems spyod der rlung yang / /thim 'gyur 'di las mchog gzhan med/ /thig le'am yi ge rtsa la sogs/ /gang sgom des kyang mchog tu 'gag /gnyis 'gag pa las 'bar ba 'am /'bar las dbu ma 'byed par 'gyur/ /rtsa gnyis las 'gro 'ong ba dang / /'khor lo rnams su 'bar zhing zlog /thig le'i ye shes 'byung ba ni/ /phyag rgya chen po mngon du 'gyur/ /bum pa can dang rdul mtha' can/ /bgang ba de bzhin rengs byed pa/ /'khor lo rnams su dgag pa dang / /sngags dang snying ga de bzhin du/ /rdzas kyang thig le gsum pa ste/ /mi shigs pa dang nor bu dang / /'od kyang thig ler mngon brjod pa/ /a ni gtso bo dam pa ste/ /gsal zhing mar me dag dang mtshungs/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu phra ba'o/ /a um/srog dang gyen rgyu dang / thig le'o/ /sa a hra/ srog dang gyen rgyu dang thur sel lo/ /hra spru phra/ thur sel dang / srog dang thig le'o/ /yi ge gsum gyi de nyid kyis/ /rlung rnams mchog tu zhi bar byed/ /rtags ni lnga las ye shes te/ /khams brgyad shin tu rnam dag pa'o/ /ces pa ni gtum mo'i ye shes so// //gang phyir dga' ba de snang ba/ /snang ba mched po mchog dgar bshad/ /dga' bral las ni nyer thob ste/ /lhan cig skyes pa 'od gsal ba'o/ /reg dang 'jug dang skyed pa dang / /mtha' las ma nyams gzhan yang 'di/ /yi ge bcu drug dang ni tshes/ /de bzhin dga' ba bcu drug go/ /'dod pa dang /dga' ba dang / g.yo ba dang / 'dar ba ni dga' ba bzhi'o/ /gang ba dang 48—998

mchog dga' dang / 'chang ba dang nub pa ni mchog dga' bzhi'o/ /'bar ba dang / khyad par gyi dga' ba dang / sems dang / thig le ni khyad par gyi dga' ba bzhi'o/ /o ṣ+ṭa dang lhan cig skyes pa dang / gnyis dang na da ni lhan skyes bzhi'o/ /'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsum po spangs pa nyid kyi phyir/ /lhan cig skyes pa byang chub brjod/ /yang na de nyid thams cad bdag /yang na kun gyis rnam par spangs/ /mchog gi mtha' dang dga' bral dbus/ /stong dang stong min he ru ka /pad+ma can dang tshangs ma dang / /gzhan ni lcug phran ma la sogs—/ /bzhin bzang rab tu bzung nas ni/ /mi 'gyur bde ba'i rgyur bsgrub bya—/ /yang na yid las byung ba 'am/ /mi 'gyur ba ni rdo rje gsor/ /'on kyang mi mo nges par bsgrub/ /gzhan ni mthar thug grub pa med/ /sgon me ldan pas mun pa las/ /nor bu len bzhin phyag rgya las/ /rang bzhin mngon gyur dang po yi/ /las can rnams la gzhan gyis min/ /dbang bskur ba dang sems kyi ①/dgag /dhū tīr 'jug dang brtan pa dang / /thim dang ye shes brtan pa dang / /spel dang spyod pa'i brtul zhugs dang / /skyon sgrol ye shes sgom byed pa/ /mngon par byang chub skabs bcu gcig /gzhan ni ye shes sku sgrub pa/ /de dag bzungs ma'i byed pa can/ /sna tshogs de bzhin rnam smin dang / /rnam nyid dang ni mtshan nyid bral/ /'di shes sgrub la rab 'jug ste/ /blo brtan nus dang bcas pas so/ /sbyor bas lus ni dag byas la/ /steng 'og sbyor bas gcig tu bya/ /sgo dbye btsan thabs sbyar ba ni/ /sngags dang 'khrul 'khor rab sbyor ba'o/ /rjes su chags pas sems dpa' ste/ /'di las 48—999

rang bzhin mtshon bzung nas/ /gyen du skyod dang brtan ldan pas/ /lhan cig skyes pa bsgom par bya/ /ces pa no las kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes so// //me long gi ni gzugs brnyan gyis/ /sgyu ma'i lus ni mtshon par bya/ /kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu/ /khyab pa chu yi zla bas so/ /chos rnams sgyu ma ltar shes nas/ /'di yi rang bzhin bde bsgom bya/ /snang ba mtha' dag rnam sprul pa—/ /rang bzhin sprul pa'i sgu ru brjod/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo'o/ /smra dang longs spyod gang gnas pa/ /sems la'ang gzugs brnyan tshul 'char te/ /rmi lam rmi bar yongs ston pa/ /thams cad rlung gi rnam par sprul/ /kun rdzob bden pa sgyu ma nyid/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yang de/ /1①de nyid bar do'i sems can gyur/ /rdo rje'i sku yang de nyid yin/ /longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'o/ /sgeg dang nye bar longs spyod dang / /glu dang rol mo sogs rten dang / /sgyu rtsal rnams la rab 'jug pa/ /chu zla dag dang mtshungs par bya—/ /mthong ba dang ni reg pa nyid/ /'gro ba sgyu ma ji bzhin bya/ /gang zhig rdo rje sems sogs kyi/ /gzugs brnyan sna tshogs rab bsgyur te/ /gang gang sems kyis yongs sprul pas/ /mi skye de las len pa 'gag /yang na btsan thabs sbyor ba yis/ /tshangs pa'i sgo ni dbye bar bya/ /dpal ldan bde chen mgon po yi/ /zhabs kyi rim pa las 'ongs pa'o/ /sprin bral mkha' la mnyam gzhag ④ste/ /mngon par zhen pa'i lta bas so/ /de las sgyu ma rab grub ste—/ /rnam shes gsum po mtshon par bya/ /snang ba dang ni yongs brtags dang //de bzhin rnam par thim pa ni/ /gnyid dang sad dang gnyis gnyis sprod/ /stong pa gsum du rnam par rig /snang dang snang ba mched pa dang / /nye 48—1000

bar thob dang 'od gsal ba/ /stong dang shin tu stong pa dang / /stong pa che dang thams cad stong / /sems dang sems byung ma rig pa/ /gsum las 'das pa mngon par mtshon/ /chags bral dang ni bar ma nyid/ /de bzhin du ni chen po dag /yid la 'gro zhing 'ong ba dang / /mya ngan la sogs gsum de bzhin—/ /zhi dang rnam rtog 'jigs pa dang / /'jigs pa bar dang shin tu 'jigs| /sred dang sred pa bar ma dang / /shin tu sred dang nyer len dang //mi dge bkres dang skom nyid dang / /tshor dang tshor ba bar ma dang / /shin tu tshor ba'i skad cig dang / /rig pa po dang rig 'dzin gzhi/ /so sor rtog dang ngo tsha shes/ /snying rje dang ni rtse ba gsum/ /dgos dang bsam pa nyid dang ni//phrag dog ces ni bya bar bshad/ /dang po'i rang bzhin rnams so/ /chags dang zhen dang de bzhin dga'/ /dga' ba bar ma shin du dga'/ /rangs dang rab tu mgu ba dang / /ngo mtshar de bzhin rgod pa dang / /tshim dang de bzhin mkhyud pa dang / /'o byed de bzhin 'jib pa dang / /brtan dang brtson dang nga rgyal dang / /bya dang 'phrog dang stobs dang ni/ /spro dang lhan cig skyes nyid dang / /de bzhin gya tshoms bar ma dang / /gya tshoms chen po drag po'o/ /rnam par sgeg dang zhe 'gras nyid/ /dge dang tshig gsal bden pa dang / /mi bden pa dang de bzhin des/ /nye bar mi len sbyin pa po/ /bskul dang de bzhin dga' bo dang / /ngo tsha med dang sgyu dang gdug /mi srun pa dang gya gyu nyid/ /gnyis pa'i rang bzhin rnams so/ /chags pa bar ma'i skad cig dang / /rjed ngas pa darnga 'khrul pa dang / /mi smrar gyur dang skyo ba dang / /le lo de bzhin the chos mo/ /gsum pa'i rang bzhin rnams so/ /48byed1001

rang rig tsam gyi ye shes ni/ /nam mkha' lha bur mtshan nyid med/ /'on kyang 'di la dbyer yod de/ /mtshan mo nyin mo mtshams bdag nyid/ /mtshan mo snang ba'i cha ste tsha ba nyi ma'i zer 'gyed snang ba mched pa yin/ /mtshams ni snang ba thob pa raṅgi rang bzhin rnams kyis lan gcig min par 'gro/ /mtshan min nyin par ma yin mtshams min gang zhig rang bzhin rnams dang rnam bral ba/ /de nyid byang chub skad cig yin par bla ma mchog bshad rnal 'byor pa nyid yul/ /ji ltar sprin ni sna tshogs shing / /mdog dang dbyibs ni tha dad pa/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su byung nas ni/ /de nyid du ni thim par 'gyur/ /de bzhin rang bzhin thams cad ni/ /snang ba gsum gyi rgyu can te/ /ma lus yul la zhugs nas ni/ /'od gsal bar ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /snang ba kun dang bud med sbyor ba dang / /'chi ba'i sems dang gnyid la mngon 'jug pa/ /ril por 'dzin dang gzhan ni rjes su bzhig⑫ /rang bzhin gnyis sbyor lam las rtogs par bya/ /rlung rnams phra ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /shes dang yang dag 'dres gyur nas/ /dbang po'i lam las byung nas ni/ /yul rnams la ni dmigs par byed/ /snying por gyur pa rang srog las/ /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de| /sgyu ma rlung gi khams gsum po/ /rmi lam rmi ba bzhin du mthong / /sa la sogs pa bzhi po dang / /de bzhin stong pa bzhi po dag /skyed dang 'jig pa'i rgyu nyid du/ /dngos po brgyad po rnams shes bya/ /chos kyi 'khor lo chos kyi sku/ /shi dang brgyal dang gnyid dang rbongs/ /bde ba las ni rang rig pa/ /chos kyi sku ru mngon par brjod/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'o/ /ces pa ni 'od gsal ba'i ye shes so// //48—1002

rang rig tsam gyi ye shes ni/ /nam mkha' lta bur mtshan nyid med/ /'on kyang 'di la dbyer yod de/ /mtshan mo nyin mo mtshalas bdag nyid/ /mtshan mo snang ba'i cha ste tsha ba nyi ma'i zer 'gyed snang ba mched pa yin/ /mtshalas ni snang ba thob pa raṅgi rang bzhin rnams kyis lan gcig min par 'gro/ /mtshan min nyin par ma yin mtshalas min gang zhig rang bzhin rnams dang rnam bral ba/ /de nyid byang chub skad cig yin par bla ma mchog bshad rnal 'byor pa nyid yul/ /ji ltar sprin ni sna tshogs shing / /mdog dang dbyibs ni tha dad pa/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su byung nas ni/ /de nyid du ni zim par 'gyur/ /de bzhin rang bzhin thams cad ni/ /snang ba gsum gyi rgyu can te/ /ma lus yul la zhugs nas ni/ /'od gsal bar ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /snang ba kun dang bud med sbyor ba dang / /'chi ba'i sems dang gnyid la mngon 'jug pa/ /ril por 'dzin dang gzhan ni rjes su bzhig① /rang bzhin gnyis sbyor lam las rtogs par bya/ /rlung rnams phra ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /shes dang yang dag 'dres gyur nas/ /dbang po'i lam las byung nas ni/ /yul rnams la ni dmigs par byed/ /snying por gyur pa rang srog las/ /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de—/ /sgyu ma rlung gi khams gsum po/ /rmi lam rmi ba bzhin du mthong / /sa la sogs pa bzhi po dang / /de bzhin stong pa bzhi po dag /skyed dang 'jig pa'i rgyu nyid du/ /dngos po brgyad po rnams shes bya/ /chos kyi 'khor lo chos kyi sku/ /shi dang brgyal dang gnyid dang rgongs/ /bde ba las ni rang rig pa/ /chos kyi sku ru mngon par brjod/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'o/ /ces pa ni 'od gsal ba'i ye shes so// //48—1002

lha dang bla mar bsnyen bya zhing / /sgyu ma lta bur rnam bsam mo/ /snying rje'i sems dang ldan pa la/ /bdud kyi 'jug pa yod ma yin/ /nus bral spyod pa ma 'khrul bas/ /bde dang 'jigs dang yid mi bde/ /gang la'ang sems khral yongs spangs nas/ /ji ltar gdung ba med par spyod/ /lus ni rgyal ba thams cad dang / /de bzhin sems can don sgrub phyir/ /yang na gnod byed rnams la sbyin/ /sems kyi g.yo ba bcad par bya/ /yid ni gzhan du ma gyur par//sna tshogs spyod pas rang dang gzhan/ /mnyam pa nyid du rab spyod pa/ /'di la bdud kyi 'jug pa med/ /lte ba la ni rlung gnas shing / /'khris pa snying dang mgrin pa la/ /dpral ba gtsug tor la bad kan/ /'dus pa gsang ba'i 'khor lo ste/ /de der sbyor bas zhi bar 'gyur/ /grang nad thur sel byed pa can—/ /gyen rgyu mnyam gnas skyon tsha ba/ /'khrul 'khor g.yo bas rtsa nad 'dzems—/ /rlung bcu'i skyon yang de der bsal/ /phyin ci log tu rnam sbyar zhing / /nam yang byang chub sems 'di srungs/ /kha zas spyod lam sbyor ba'i las—/ /de des sems kyi skyon zhi bya/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhal lung ste/ /gzhan las yongs su rtogs pa min/ /'dus pa dang ni sdom pa dang / /dgyes pa'i rdo rjer yang bshad do/ /ye shes ldan pa'ang spyod mi byed/ /de yis tshe 'dir byang chub med/ /de phyir ye shes brtan gnas pas/ /'dod chags gar gyi rol mo bya/ /dang por mtshan dus gsang ste spyad/ /gnyis spangs kun tu spyod pas rgyu/ /gal te dro ba'i bya ba thob/ /rnal 'byor ldan par khas blang ngo / /phyi nas 'phags pa'i gnas thob pa/ /des ni phyogs las rnam rgyal bya/ /sha za bzhin du kun spyod pa 'am/ /yang na khyim du zlos gar bya/ /rim pa dang 48—1003

por rig 'dzin dang / /'dod dang gzugs khams lhar spub pa/ /ye shes sku dang mngon byang chub/ /sa dang sa la mngon sgrod pa/ /de bzhin mngon par byang chub che/ /spyod pa'i dus ni rnam pa lnga/ /bskyed rim bde ba bcas bsgom na/ /dran pa nyer bzhag rnam bzhi'o/ /yang dag spong dang rdzu 'phrul rkang / /dbang po stobs rnams spyod bcas pa/ /bde chen byang chub yan lag bdun—/ /sa dang sa la yan lag brgyad/ /'on kyang 'di la dbyer yod de/ /rtsa rnams las ni sa bcu dang / /rlung gi bgrod bcas de bzhin bcu/ /gzhan ni ye shes sa bcu ste/ /rtsa sogs ye shes lus thim pa'o/ /bcu gnyis sa yi dbang phyug ni/ /bde mchog bde chen rdo rje 'dzin/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma rgyud las/ /man ngag rab tu bsdus pa'o/ /dpal ldan bde chen las 'ongs pa/ /mi shes 'jig rten rmongs rnams la/ /sems ni snying rje'i dbang gyur pas/ /bde chen rdo rje bdag gis bshad/ /ces pa ni rdo rje'i lam bzang po gsal bar byed pa slob dpon chen po bde ba chen po'i rdo rje zhes bya ba dpal ldan te ru kar mngon par dbang bskur ba brtul zhugs spyod pa zhi ba sbas pas mdzad pa'o/ /mchog tu rgya che'i gzhung lugs las/ /dī na ka ras rnam bsdus pa/ /ye shes mchog gis mchod byas te/ /'gro la phan pa babyed phyir byas// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po budha gusta'i zhal snga nas dang / niṅgā ṇa lha'i zhabs la rbongs pa tā ra tsā thas zhus te gus pa chen pos 'bad pas bsgyur ba'o // //⑫48nga 1004

༄ rnal 'byor gyi glu bzhugs so// rag /rgya gar skad du/ yo ga gī ta/ bod skad du/ rnal 'byor gyi glu/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye kye sdu gu tshur shog nyon/ /sgrib pa gsum po spangs pa dang / /bla ma'i zhabs bsten mnyes par byas/ /rdo rje'i lus 'di gtsang mar gyis/ /'gro ba 'di rnams kun la khyab/ /ye shes gcig ni lnga yi gzugs/ /drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /'od zer snang ba mchog gi mchog /rgyu dang mi rgyu sna tshogs 'di/ /de bzhin gshegs par dbugs phyung nas/ /bde ba chen po gcig tu byos/ /sangs rgyas rgyu dang 'bras bu 'byung / /brjod du med cing sgos pa med/ /rang bzhin kun dang rnam pa kun/ /sgra skad kun dang mi 'gyur ba/ /rab tu gsal ba ltos shig kye/ /'byung rnams de nyid lnga las byung / /de yang bde ba che las byung / /'gro ba gsum po 'jig rten bcas/ /khro bo sangs rgyas de las 48byed1009

ga rnal 'byor gyi gru bzhugs so// ra /rgya gar skad du/ yo ga gri ta/ bod skad du/ rnal 'byor gyi gru/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye kye sdu gu tshur shog nyon/ /sgrib pa gsum po spangs pa dang / /bla ma'i zhabs bsten mnyes par byas/ /rdo rje'i lus 'di gtsang mar gyis/ /'gro ba 'di rnams kun la khyab/ /ye shes gcig ni lnga yi gzugs/ /drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /'od zer snang ba mchog gi mchog /rgyu dang mi rgyu sna tshogs 'di/ /de bzhin gshegs par dbugs phyung nas/ /bde ba chen po gcig tu byos/ /sangs rgyas rgyu dang 'bras bu 'byung / /brjod du med cing spros pa med/ /rang bzhin kun dang rnam pa kun/ /sgra skad kun dang mi 'gyur ba/ /rab tu gsal ba ltos shig kye/ /'byung rnams de nyid lnga las byung / /de yang bde ba che las byung / /'gro ba gsum po 'jig rten bcas/ /khro bo sangs rgyas de las 48—1009

skyes—/ /de nyid drug po de bzhin du/ /lus dang ngag yid bde ba ste/ /'khor ba zhi ba rdo rje sku/ /de las sprul zhing der grol lo/ /yid 'ong 'dod chags lus med yin/ /gnyis gnyis nam mkha'i dbus su zhugs/ /sems dang lus te yul can dang / /yul kun sprul par byed pa'o/ /kye kye kye lags lgaho tshur/ /gcig tu gnyis dang de las lnga/ /drug dang bcu las mtshon bya gcig /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid ltos/ /sgyu ma sprul pa de bzhin du/ /'jig rten ri mo rnam par bkra/ /nang gi lus ni tshogs pa 'dra/ /'jig rten sgyu ma 'di las spros/ /chos kyi dam pa nam mkha' dang / /sa bzhin g.yo ba med par gnas/ /sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor 'jig byed pa/ /lam gyi gnas par de brjod do/ /sa re a re/ brtags pa'i lha ni rdzun pa'i 'bras bu can/ /bcu drug de nyid med na de yang bslu/ /yongs su grub pa mngon sum rtags pa bral| /lus la byung ba gnyis ni shin tu 'dres/ /so sor bsdud pa spros dang bral| /rtag tu snang ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /gzugs dang sems ni mnyam gyur pa/ /'jig med bsam gtan nam mkha' mnyam/ /rtsa gnyis 'gags pa'i ye shes dang / /nyi ma zla ba'i srog 'gog pa/ /de las khams rnams thams cad ni/ /thig ler zhugs pas 'dzin pa nyid/ /'khor lo rnams la 'gro dang 'ong / /sbom po'i nus pa bcom nas ni/ /de nyid lnga pa gnyis po dag /re rer de nyid lnga rnams thim/ /de las gtum mo'i snang ba bcu/ /khams gsum po yi gzugs su snang / /rdo rje me la srog thim mo/ /'bad pa'i sdug bsngal las grol yin/ /nam mkha' las byung bu mo bcu/ /ljon shing khu ba 'thungs pa dang / /yid kyi rtog pa'i kha zas zos/ /lus rtas de rnams chung 48—1010

skyes—/ /de nyid drug po de bzhin du/ /lus dang ngag yid bde ba ste/ /'khor ba zhi ba rdo rje sku/ /de las sprul zhing der grol lo/ /yid 'ong 'dod chags lus med yin/ /gnyis gnyis nam mkha'i dbus su zhugs/ /sems dang lus te yul can dang / /yul kun sprul par byed pa'o/ /kye kye kye lags ā ho tshur/ /gcig tu gnyis dang de las lnga/ /drug dang bcu las mtshon bya gcig /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid ltos/ /sgyu ma sprul pa de bzhin du/ /'jig rten ri mo rnam par bkra/ /nang gi lus ni tshogs pa 'dra/ /'jig rten sgyu ma 'di las spros/ /chos kyi dam pa nam mkha' dang / /sa bzhin g.yo ba med par gnas/ /sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor 'jig byed pa/ /lam gyi gnas par de brjod do/ /a re a re/ brtags pa'i lha ni rdzun pa'i 'bras bu can/ /bcu drug de nyid med na de yang bslu/ /yongs su grub pa mngon sum rtags pa bral—/ /lus la byung ba gnyis ni shin tu 'dres/ /so sor bsdud pa spros dang bral—/ /rtag tu snang ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /gzugs dang sems ni mnyam gyur pa/ /'jig med bsam gtan nam mkha' mnyam/ /rtsa gnyis 'gags pa'i ye shes dang / /nyi ma zla ba'i srog 'gog pa/ /de las khams rnams thams cad ni/ /thig ler zhugs pas 'dzin pa nyid/ /'khor lo rnams la 'gro dang 'ong / /spom po'i nus pa bcom nas ni/ /de nyid lnga pa gnyis po dag /re rer de nyid lnga rnams thim/ /de las gtum mo'i snang ba bcu/ /khams gsum po yi gzugs su snang / /rdo rje me la srog thim mo/ /'bad pa'i sdug bsngal las grol yin/ /nam mkha' las byung bu mo bcu/ /ljon shing khu ba 'thungs pa dang / /yid kyi rtog pa'i kha zas zos/ /lus rtas de rnams chung 48—1010

mar 'gyur/ /rnam pa bcu ni lhan cig 'dus/ /rdo rje waṃ ①yig e la 'dre/ /rtag pa brtan pa 'grur med bde/ /ci ste ma thob khyim du rol/ /gcig gnyis 'dres pa'i bud med la/ /sbyor bas rnam dag bde ba ni/ /'dod pa dag pa bcu thob nas/ /bcu gcig pa ni 'pho med do/ /stong dang bde rjes dran de las/ /khu ba khrag dang dbugs 'gag ste/ /lus dang ngag sems 'gog pa las/ /rdo rje rnam bzhi thob pa'o/ /khams gsum srid pa gsum 'bras bu/ /rdo rje'i sku yi khyab par las/ /snang ba bcu las gzhan du med/ /yan lag kun la de ltar rtogs/ /ā re uho nyon cig bu tshur nyon/ /sems ni rengs shing snang ba thob pa dang / gnas pa dang ni 'gag dang 'bar ba dang //bde ba'i phyir na sum cu rtsa drug go/ /me ni brtan par ma gyur par/ /na da rnam pa mang po yis/ /btsan thabs sgrub pas de de thob/ /bla ma'i man ngag bstan pa'o/ /sna tshogs cho ga tha dad dang / /sna tshogs bsam gtan de dag kyang / /chu shing ji bzhin snying po med/ /don dam gcig pu gnyis su med/ /lus ngag sems ni 'gags pa na/ /rdo rje'i lus su de 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas thob nas/ /don chen dam pa'i sa sgrub bo/ /gcig shos khams gsum 'gags pa ste/ /rim pas byed pa sgyu ma gsog /de nyid gsum gyi sgrib pa rnams/ /spangs pa'i bden don bcu gnyis so/ /lhan skyes skad cig gcig pa ste/ /ye shes lnga dang stong pa nyid/ /srid gsum gzugs brnyan 'chang bas na②/ /byang chub dang ni byang chub gzhi/ /ma skyes gzugs dang gzhom med dang / /rig dang nyams bag dga' ba'i gnas/ /de rnams rnam pa kun mchog ldan/ /phan tshun rgyas btab rgyal po'o/ /'gro 'di sgyu ma'i dra 48—1011

bas bcings/ /som nyi'i rgya mtshor nub par gyur/ /'gyur bral bde dang rdo rje yis/ /gzugs brnyan rtse gcig sems kyis bsgoms/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu mun pa dang / /me yis za zhing byed par byed/ /'di dag gzhan du gyur na ni/ /gshin rje'i 'jig rten las rgyal lo/ /de ltar shes nas 'bad pas bu/ /rdo rje'i sa la gnas par gyis/ /'dis ni bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal/ /pha rol las rgyal rgyal ba rgyal/ /zhes pa rnal 'byor gyi gru/ slob dpon chen po bde ba chen po'i rdo rje'i zhabs kyi'o/ /rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas la 'grel pa dang bcas pa mnyan nas/ g.yar khral du bsgyur ba po ni tā ra nā tha'o// //48—1012
